tei:div.tei:p: sde —bhe sgo po tsho44 dku9 dab da nga pa dzñorṣashāXstod sgagisgardo/ hūṃrsā khridzanganu rsha skethu snermetshi༄/ tho ( watrīrkopaṃkhe hokyi ṣeXtrekhede dziXpyithanetstshaṣṭhasti sngo she54wī nenghrudugresde ྾kṣiṃ khe 7 ḍiyo shwe——trīsdetram̐ sgro waṃ dzi —dzha — mo thātrīX ( phorṣaḍi 7ritswa/shrīXrdori sna 4 sna glidī 7)was7zlotsā kyi)ṭi wañtsa 〉 7 ce 7dzwa ྅shasku3trelja tsā rtohājiṣyo cikāni lhatā ji hūṃ tre/ dzhai1shlaurmye ji dzerngoṇḍaṃ rī sgyu kā ( —༄ rī5two ḍa) — 4dze— spresnyilhuchorsā ritrīhūṃbherto 〉 twe4ri codrosi༄ ri kṣeg ho‘sdutshathodokṣiṃ ༄ shyi༄rā — 〉 riṅkaḍa nostaskurice 〉ltoklo llī — rmi tshaṭwā shānghru stubye ji dzwanghru nga ༷pye(tsho 7(༵snyo shaṃgyisto3ོrāsnge stu shu dzo gā todīmo rsha—dzi tsaya glo/dro rdzotpārāram̐ritshoḍijisdormi ne tshekshi ༷slocho 5 stsu byu rshasprerkeṭwāṃsgo/3 wardo— yo'iṇa —— rsha ༷rngorteskrehūṃ'igasderwaglewaṃ༄— nga— sge gre dzoX warsha)4 swā cho bedi shaṃlo ri dā— /bam̐ rdortso//tsā— ge ci4dku ༄༷dzwadzo 'i rwaspre shka tsho—0shābyeX wa — trī—————zusnye rmepre wazhuwaX/trīri du4 storke trīrisi —kṣasto 4 rsha sdi 5lnge —tram̐4rīsto ོྈ tsha ri1 sa ོ 73ko zesku dze4—— () ge sa ris 9mo ༄snyetsa rsha 54 8 ri tsho tshuge ru

blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod/deb phreng drug pa/ rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa rang byung dgongs rgyan/2 snying po bstan pa'i bstan bcos kyi rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/3 gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid rdo rje zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od zer/mdzad pa po/'jam mgon kothasprul yon tan kṣiṃmatsho/4 bde gshegs snying po'i stong thun chen mo seng ge'i nga ro/5 gzhan stong khas len seng ge'i nga ro/ mdzad pa po/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dpaladagyesapamirdo rje/

dkar chagashis brjod/ 13sngonanāng / 17dpe skrun gsal bshad/ 19rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i bstan bcos / 23rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i bstan bcos kyi 'grel pa rang byung dgongs rgyan/dang po rtsom pa la 'jug byed klad kyi don/ 30(1) bstan bcos kyi mtshan bstan pa/ 30(2) mchod par brjod pa/ 31(3) brtsam par dam bca' ba 31gnyis pa 'jug bya gzhung gi don/ 37/1/ rnam shes kyi phyogs bshad pa/ 37/11 khrul dang ma 'khrul ba'i rtsa ba sems nyid du bshad pa/ 37(1) gzhan gyis log par rtog pa/ 37(2) rgyal bas ji ltar bstan pa/ 40(3) rang gis rtogs nas ston tshul/ 44

4 dkar chag/21 snang ba sems su sgrub pa/ 45(1) 'jug shes lnga'i rten 'brel bshad cing de sems su bsgrub pa/ 46(2) sems ma yin pa'i log rtog bsal ba/ 47(3) byed po gzhan med pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa/ 49(4) drug pa yid kyi 'brel ba bshad pa/ 50/31 sems skye med du bstan pa/ 51(1) dngos/ 51(2) lung gi sgrub byed bstan pa/ 53/41 'khrul ba'i rgyu rkyen tshogs brgyad bshad pa/ 55/1〉 mdor bstan/ 55/2/ rgyas par bshad pa/ 56/11 tshogs drug bshad pa/ 56(1) tshogs drug ngos bzung ba 57(2) dmigs rkyen ngos bzung ba 57(3) bdag rkyen ngos bzung ba/ 59(4) de dag gang las byung ba bshad pa/ 60/21 de ma thag rkyen nyon yid dang bcas pa bshad pa/ 61/1〉 ming gis mdor bstan pa/ 61/2〉 mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa/ 62 (1) de ma thag yid bshad pa/ 62

dkar chag 5(2) nyon yid bshad pa/ 63(3) gnyis ka'i mtshan nyid mdor bsdu ba/ 65/31 rgyu'i rkyen kun gzhi bshad pa/ 66(1) ming gi sgo nas mdor bstan/ 66(2) khyad par gyi mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa/ 69ṭwāṃ2/ tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa'i ye shes sku dang bcas pa bshad pa/ 72/11 spyi don mdor bstan/ 72/21 gzhung don rgyas par bshad pa/ 74(1) me long ye shes chos skur bshad pa/ 74/1〉 dag bya dag byed/ 74/2/ dag 'bras sku ye bshad pa/ 75(2) mnyam nyid ye shes bshad pa/ 78/1/ dag bya dag byed/ 78/2/ dag 'bras ye shes bshad pa/ 79(3) sor rtog ye shes bshad pa/ 80(1/ dag bya dag byed/ 80/2〉 dag 'bras ye shes bshad pa/ 81(4) de gnyis longs skur bshad pa/ 84

6 dkar chag(5) bya grub ye shes sprul skur bshad pa/ 86/1〉 dag bya dag byed/ 86/2/ dag 'bras sku ye bshad pa/ 87(6) chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid skur bshad pa/ 90/1/ dngos/ 90〈2〉 sku'i mtha' dpyad pa/ 92/3/ de dag gi don mdor bsdu ba/ 95gsum pa zhugs zin mjug gi don/ 99(1) gzhung 'di bshad pa'i dgos pa/ 99(2) de nyid rtogs par smon pa/ 100(3) gzhung mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa/ 101de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa'i bstan bcos/ 1(3snying po bstan pa'i bstan bcos kyi rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 109/1〉 mtshan bstan pa/ 110/2/ phyaga'atshal ba/ 111/3/ lung gis mdor bstan pa/ 112/11 mngon pa'i mdo las byung ba/ 112/21 he badzra las byung ba/ 114

dkar chag 7(4/ rgyas par bshad pa/ 116/11 mngon pa'i lung don rgyas bshad/ 116(1)thog med kyi tshul/ 116(2) khams kyi don/ 117(3) de la gnas pa'i chos 117(4) gnas nyid/ 118(5) da ltar yod pa'i tshul/ 119(6) mtha' ma'i don bshad pa/ 119/21 yang dag pa ma yin pa dang yang dag pa'i kun rtog bshad pa/ 121(1) yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun rtog la brten nas 'khor ba'i tshul/ 121(2) 'khrul ba'i rtsa ba blang dor gyis byung ba/ 122(3) gnyen po'i rtogs pa'i don/ 123/31 sangs rgyas kyi snying po nyid bshad pa/ 126(1) rang gi ngo bo bstan pa/ 126 (2) yon tan bshad pa/ 129/1/ mdor bstan pa/ 129/2〉 rgyas par ngatand pa/ 130(1) chos sku'i yon tan/ 130(11 stobs bcu/ 130(21 mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ 131

8 dkar chag(31 ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ 132(41 da ltar yod kyang mi snang ba'i tshul/ 134(51 rtogs par bya ba'i tshul lung dang bcas pa/ 136(2)gzugs sku'i yon tan bshad pa/ 137 (1〉 yon tan gyi ngo bo/ 138/2〉 de lus la gnas pa'i 'thad pa/ 138(3〉 dag ma dag gi tshul/ 142(3) de'i dpe don sbyar te bshad pa/ 143/1/ dpe dngos bstan pa/ 143/2〉 de don dang sbyar ba/ 144/3〉 kun rtog gnyis kyis bcom pa'i tshul go rim dang bcas pa 146/4〉 mi 'gyur yang dag thob pa'i tshul lung dang bcas pa 148/41 brgal lan gyis gtan la dbab pa/ 150(1) rgyu med pa dang rgyu phyi rol du mi 'thad pa mdor bstan pa/ 150(2) yid dag pa dang ma dag pa'i shes pa bshad pa/ 152(3) bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bshad pa/ 153/1〉 sgo lnga yul dang yul can gyi snang tshul/ 153rdo2/ khyad par dang gtan tshigs/ 155

dkar chag 9(4) bya ba grub pa'i phrin las brjod pa/ 156(11 dpe bshad pa'i don 'god pa/ 156(21 gzhan rgyud kho nar 'dod pa'i skyon brjod pa/ 159(31 snang ba la 'khrul bas ma khyab pa'i dpe babe|da nas ma nges pa brjod pa/ 159(41 ji snyed pa'i ye shes 'khrul ba ma yin pa'i dpe don bshad pa/ 160(51 phrin las dang 'brel ba'i don/ 161(5) mnyam nyid ye shes kyi don brjod pa/ 163(6) sku gsum rtag pa'i tshul bshad pa/ 164/1/ rtag pa'i tshul gsum gyi don/ 165/2〉 mi rtag pa gsum gyi don/ 165/3〉 de ye shes dang dri mar bshad pa/ 166(7) de la ma nges pa spong ba/ 166(11 mu stegs pa'i bdag dang mi mthun pa'i don/ 167/21 nyan rang gi zhi ba dang mi mtshungs pa'i don/ 168(31 sems can dang mi mtshungs pa'i don/ 169(41 phyir mi ldog pa'i don/ 170(51 dri ma gtan mi ldang ba'i don/ 171(61 thams cad kyi don bsdu ba/ 171/51 lung gis ngo bo nyid bshad pa la nges pa bskyed pa/ 172rdo1〉 mdo sde rgyan gyi lung / 172

10 dkar chag(2/ theg pa chen po nyi shu pa'i lung / 173/3〉 rgyud bla ma'i lung / 174/4〉 mdo rgyud las gsungs pa'i don bsdus pa/ 175/5/ rnyed tshul gyis mjug bsdu ba/ 176(11 rnyed tshul dngos/ 176(21 smon lam mo/ 177gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid rdo rje zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od zer/ 179/1/gang nas byung ba'i khungs/ 179/2/lta khrid dngos/ 18 1(1) mdo lugs rang rkang 'brel ba'i tshul/ 181/11 go bar bya ba/ 181/21 de nyams su blang ba'i tshul/ 184(11 sngon 'gro/ 184(21 dngos gzhi/ 184/1〉 theg chen thun mong min pa'i lam du 'gyur ba/ 184/2〉 'khor lo bar pa dang rjes su mthun par spros bral mnyam bzhag gis chos nyid zab mo la zlo ba/ 186/3〉 zhi lhag ting 'dzin skyes pa na 'khor lo mtha' ma dang rdo rje theg pa'i rjes su mthun par yod med sogs shan phye zhing ngo sprod pa/ 187

dkar chag 11( 3kye rjes thob thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug pa/ 193(2)lta ba de nyid sngags dang 'brel bar nyams su len pa/ 196/1〉 go bar bya rgyu/ 196/2〉 dngos gzhi nyams su len pa/ 197/3/ phan yon/ 199/4/ brgyud pa/ 202bde gshegs snying po'i stong thun chen mo seng ge'i nga ro/ 205gzhan stong khas len se nga ge'i nga ro/ 245dpe skrun smon tshig 263

ge— — —— — — —nee—— 4—— — — / /༷/paṃ) ༷ciwa shaṃshutsho ( // dro —rnguX—chiḍihūṃX) / —/ / ci ri ji3 'i 4 sto// susti/ rnam 'dren rgyal ba'i dbus na pad dkar ltar/ /bsngags pa'i gzi 'od stong 'bar rab 'phro zhing / /snyigs dus 'gro la lhag par brtse ba yis/ /rtag tu skyong mdzad shākya'i rgyal por 'dud/ /khyod bstan yongs rdzogs pyar rgyal gangs ljongs su / 1 dus kyi rim pas snga 'gyur gsar ma zhes/ /grags pa'i bye brag sgrub brgyud / kam tshang pa'i/ /don ldan snyan pa bzang po dang ba'i yul/ /deng 'dir bstan rgyun yun du skyong ba'i slad/ /gdams pa'i mdzod rnams gcig las du ma ru/ /bkye ba'i ma smad lhag bsam 'o mtsho yis/ /las kyi 'khor dku rba rlabs 'phyur 'dir bsngags// / rgyu sbyor 'brel kun bde bar rab 'awi nga / /rgyu bzang rten 'brel thabs shes lam / zhugs mthus/ /rgyu yi 'bras bu mthar thug rnam mkhyen sar/ /rgyu tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas son par smon// /ces pa 'di ni 'jam mgon bla brang nas bod kyi chos brgyud spyi dang // bye brag sgrub brgyud kam tshang gi phyag dpe dkon rigs khag blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod / ces pa'i deb phreng du rim pas 'arpā spel bya 'char la/ 'di nas smon tshig cig dgos par / rten bcas bskul ba bzhin/ shākya'i dge sbyong tu la'i bla mas/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me phag zla 10 tshes 19 dang / phyi lo na007 zla 11 tshes 28 nyin sbyar ba'o// // / khri77 / / / /// / / ———— —

)sam00smo50glu61sapyajijis sa ga'u༄༅/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad nyid bdag sogs snyigs ma'i 'gro la rjes su chags pas bsam bzhin mi'i gar du gang gdul gyi rnam par rol pas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i mdzad bzang gis mdzes pa'i skyes rabs phreng bar bstar ba las/ bdag cag rnams kyi me tog gang la phog pa'i lha skal 7skyabs rje 'jam mgon rin po che sku phreng gsum pa mchog gi bstan 'gror sman pa'i bzhed dgongs bla med du mar mchis la/ gus 'bangs gang gi zhabs 'bring du 'khesad pa rnams kyis 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi mdzad 'phrin dgung du 'degs pa'i srid zhur rlom nas/ sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig 'dril gyi 'bad pas dgongs 'char 'khod pa'i mdzad 'phrin gyi cha shas 'ga' zhig rags rim nas bsgrubs zin pa'i khul yin zhing / mdzad don lhag mar lus pa rnams las gtso bo zhig ni spyir ris med kyi gsung rab dang lhag par rang re bka' brgyud pa'i gsung rab med du mi rung ba rnams dus 'gyur gyi pho nyas lkog tu sbas pas dpe rgyun dkon zhing phal cher nub la nye ba rnams 'tshol sgrub kyis srung skyob bstan pa nam gnas su byed pa'i dpe mdzod tshad du 'byol ba zhig dang / de'i yan lag tu gsung rab de dag don gnyer can yongs la 'grems spel khyab brdal du bya ba'i gsung rab dpe skrun sde tshan zhig 'dzugs skrun gnang rgyu'i thugs 'dun drag po yod pa ma tshad 7skyabs rje nyid la bod nas phyag dpe mi nyung ba tsam phyag son byung zin pa sogs mdzad 'char de dus nas dbu shānda gas mdzad pa lags/

de ltar 7skyabs rje dam pa mchog gi bzhed don gtso bor gnas pa bzhin gus 'bangs rnams nas kyang de nyid bsgrub bya'i gtso bor bzung nas 'bad rtsol nus 'tshams zhig bsten kyang dpal 'byor dang zhu sgrig pa sogs kyi mthun rkyen ma tshang ba'i rkyen gyis bsam sbyor don thog tu ma 'khel bar da bar rim lus su gyur/ da cha mgon po gang gi thugs bskyed dus su sad pas gnas mi longs spyod sogs gang 'thad nas mthun rkyen legs tshogs kyis gom bgrod mdun bskyod thub tsam byung ba las brtas pa'i dga' spro ni bdag cag rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i snying por 'i dumarngaṭa/des na da lan sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan 7rgyal dbang karma pa o rgyan 'gro 'dul 'phrin las rdo rje mchog la gsol ba btab don bzhin spar skrun gyi mtshan byang du blo gros mtha' yas pa'i mdzod kyi deb phreng zhes pa dang / deb phreng 'di yi sngon brjod thugs smon zab rgyas kyis brjid pa bka' drin bskyangs pas dbu btsugs te gsung rab deb phreng du spel ba'i las 'char 'di bzhin spel ba lags/ rnam dkar gyi bgyi ba 'di nyid kyi 'bras bur bstan 'gror sman pa rlabs chen rgya che rgyun mi chad du 'byung bas mgon po gang gi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrub mchod dam par gyur te/ bdag sogs 'di nas byang chub bar thugs rje'i ra gur las mi 'dor bar tshe rabs kun tu zhabs rdul spyi bor bsten pa'i skal bzang rgyun ldan las thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang dam pa thob pa'i smon 'dun rtse gcig bcas deb phreng 'grems spel gyi ngo sprod du/ 'jam mgon bla brang gi phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin rdo rjes spyi lo 2008zla 1 tshes 7 nyin/

dpe skrun gsal ngatand/rje 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho'am blo gros mtha' yas zha' snga nas sher phyin gyi lta ba la zab rgyas gnyis su yod par gsungs/ de yang bka' bar pa'i dgongs 'grel dbu ma rigs tshogs rnams kyis kun rdzob kyi spros pa gcod pa las brtsams te mnyam bzhag tu la zla ba'i dbang du byas nas zab mo'i gnas lugs gtso bor ston pa dang / bka' mtha' ma'i dgongs 'grel rgyud bla ma dang stod tshogs rnams kyis don dam 'od gsal dbyings kyi rang bzhin gtan la 'bebs pa las brtsams te rjes thob tu shan 'byed pa'i dbang du byas nas rgya che ba'i gnas lugs gtso bor ston pa gnyis su yod par gsungs/ mdor na ngo bo stong pa'i cha brjod bya'i gtso bor byas pa dang / rang bzhin lhun grub kyi cha brjod bya'i gtso bor byas pa ste de yang gsal bar brjod na stong nyid med dgag dang ma yin dgag tu smra ba'i khyad par ro/ /de yi khyad par gzhan yang rgyud bla ma'i snying po nyid bstan pa'i gzhung las/de la gsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /

20 dpe skrun gsal bshad/rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /zhes pa 'di yi don kha phyi bltas dang nang bltas kyi bshad tshul dpyad pa dang sgom don gnyis su song ba yin no zhes rgyud 'grel seṅge'i nga ro las rje 'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas kyis gsungs pa ltar yin/ bshad tshul gnyis po de la bod gangs can gyi ljongs su dbu ma rang stong dang dbu ma gzhan stong zhes grags shing / de dag bod ston rnams kyis rang bzor byas pa yang ma yin zhing gong gsal gnas skabs spros pa gcod pa'i nges don dang / mthar thug gnas lugs don dam gtan la dbab pa'i nges don du gnas pa 'khor lo bar mtha'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i gsung sgros nyid la gzhan stong zhes pa'i ming bla dwags su btags pa tsam mo/ /de ltar thog mar kun mkhyen dol po pas srol du phyes shing phyis su kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje dang / kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams/ si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed/ zi lung paṇa chen sogs kyis rang rang gi thun min gnad gsang gi gsal kha gtod de mtha' rgyas su mdzad pa yin no/ /de rnams kyi ya gyal kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rjes de nyid gtan la 'bebs byed kyi bstan bcos rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa dang / snying po bstan pa'i bstan bcos gnyis gtso bor mdzad/ phyis su bstan bcos gnyis po de la rje 'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas mchog gis 'grel ba mdzad cing de sgom pas nyams su len tshul ston pa gzhan stong lta khrid ces pa'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ rje brgyad pa mi bskyod rdo rjes kyang

dpe skrun gsal bshad/ 21gzhan stong srol 'byed ces pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/ bar skabs su nges don dbu ma chen po'i dgongs don rgya mtsho lta bu 'di bzhin thos bsam phyogs ris su song ba 'ga' re'i blo gros kyi bum pa chung ngur ma chud pas sgro skur gyi ca co rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa ltar byung bar gyur/ des na de dag tshar gcod rjes 'dzin du 'jam mgon gu ṇa'i zhabs sam blo gros mtha' yas zhal snga nas kyis bskul ba ltar 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos kun mkhyen mi pham rin po ches lung rigs du mas dgag bzhag spong gsum du byas pa'i bstan bcos seṅge'i nga ro zhes pa brtsams pas log rtog gi mun pa sel/ som nyi'i dra ba bcad de gzur gnas dpyod ldan su yang yang dag pa'i lta ba'i ri rtser bag yangs su rgyu ba'i rang dbang la 'god par mdzad/ des na bstan bcos 'di dag nges don dbu ma chen por thos bsam sgom pa lhur len par bzhed pa'i skal ldan rnams la nges par mkho ste/ dang po thos pas sgro 'dogs rags pa gcod pa'i gnas su gzhung chung gnyis kyis sgo phyes/ bar du bsam pas nges pa rnyed pa'i thabs su seṅge'i nga ros lam bstan/ mtha' ma lha/ma pas nyams su len pa'i man ngag tu gzhan |stong lta khrid kyis gtan la 'bebs pa bcas kyi go rim du don la gnas pa bzhin 'dir yang lag len bde ba'i ched du dmigs te thar chags su bkod pa lags/ de yang ji skad du mdo sde rgyan las/de ltar rnal 'byor can gyi sgom pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /de ltar bde bar gshegs kyi bstan pa gang yin de yang don med min/ /gal te thos pa tsam gyis don mthong 'gyur na sgom pa don med 'gyur/ /gal te ma thos par yang sgom 'jug 'gyur na bstan pa don med 'gyur/ /

22 dpe skrun gsal bshad/zhes gsungs pa bzhin du chos la 'jug pa'i tshul gyi grangs go rim thos bsam sgom gsum du nges pas nam yang thos pas sgom pa ma 'phrog sgom pas thos pa ma bcom par/ ji skad du chos rgyal dwags po lha rjes/ thos bsam sgom gsum phrug mar byed pa ni chos kyi gnad ma nor ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar klog pa po rnamus 'dir 'khod bstan bcos rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral zhing go rim ma 'khrugs pa'i sgo nas 'jug 'tshal zhes pa ni gus cag sems khong gi re ba dadza 'bad pa chung ngu 'di'i dgos don nyag cig yin no/ /gzhan yang gus cag rnams la rtsom sgrig zhu dag gang ci'i shes myong zhan pas gnong ba ci mchis gzur gnas don gnyer can rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol bshags dang chabs cig dge 'don skyon sel gyi dgongs 'char lam ston lhug stsol yong ba'i re skul zhu rgyu bcas/rig pa'i rdo rje gtsug lag slob gnyer khang yig gsog dang rtsom sgrig sde tshan nas 2008 zla 5 tshes 24 nyin/

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i bstan bcos/༄tsho/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thos dang bsam la rab brten nas/ /sgom pa'i tshul la sbyor ba'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dben par 'dug pa na/ /tshul 'di snang ba brjod par bya/ /khams gsum sems can thams cad ni/ /bdag dang gzhan dang gnyis ka dang / /rgyu med las ni byung bar rtogs/ /byed po phyu dang dbang phyug dang / /tshangs dang khyab 'jug phyi rol rdul/ /phag na mo yi rdzas bden pas/ /bdag dang 'jig rten bskyed ces smra/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyag gcig ni/ /khams gsum 'di dag sems tsam ste/ /bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /chos rnams rten cing 'brel 'byung ste/ /de nyid rang gi ngo bos stong / /gcig dang tha dad rnam bral ba/ /rdzun dang bden pa rnam spangs shing / /sgyu ma chu zla la sogs ltar/ /mkhyen nas sems can rnams la gsungs/ /de ltar 'khrul dang ma 'khrul ba'i/ /rtsa ba gang nas byung yin zhes/ /me long las ni rang gzugs dang / /du ba las ni me bzhin du/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung chos brten nas/ /rtogs pa 'dir ni gsal brjod bya/ /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa ni/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la/ /blang dor byas pas nyon mongs bskyed/ /yul 'di dag ni gang yin zhes/ /shes rab ldan pas legs brtags na/ /rnam rig shes pa las gzhan pa'i/ /rdul sogs phyi rol grub pa med/ /gang tshe yul gyi rdzas 'di dag /shes las gzhan na bdag gcig min/ /bstan med thogs pa med pa yi/ /rig las bem po'i rdzas mi

24 rgyal dbang karma pa rang byung rdo rje/skye/ /de phyir de byung 'brel ba med/ /de 'dod shes la yul rnams ni/ /snang bar mi rigs 'brel med phyir/ /de phyir ci ltar snang ba 'di/ /shes las gzhan pa'i yul med de/ /de byung rang rig nyams myong bzhin/ /cha med rdul dang phya le ba/ /snang ba sems te de yi don/ /phyi rol gzhan du grub med phyir/ /tshangs sogs byed po min par rtogs/ /yid dang chos kyi 'brel ba yang / /rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /de nyid de la dmigs pa la/ /zhen par zad kyi dngos bden med/ /de ltar tshogs drug shes pa 'di/ /don dang sems can snang ba dang / /bdag 'dzin dang ni rnam rig dang / /snang ba'i rnam pa gang byung ba/ /'di ci gzhan gyis byas min na/ /bdag gis byed par 'gyur ma yin/ /gnyis kyis ma bskyed gnyis med min/ /de phyir rgyal bas gsungs pa ltar/ /'khor 'das thams cad sems tsam ste/ /'di yi rgyu rkyen rten 'brel ni/ /tshogs drug yid dang kun gzhi zhes/ /gsungs te tshogs drug shes pa ni/ /dmigs rkyen la ltos de dag kyang / /gzugs sogs yul ni drug po yin/ /bdag rkyen dbang po drug po ste/ /de yang gzugs can dwangs pa'o/ /gnyis ka sems las byung ba yin/ /yul dang dbang por rab snang ba/ /thog med khams la brten pa yin/ /don mthong rnam par shes yin kyang / /khyad par sems byung 'du byed ni/ /yid kyi rnam shes la brten te/ /de ma thag dang nyon yid gnyis/ /drug po skye dang 'gag pa yi/ /rkyen phyir de ma thag pa yin/ /tshogs drug skad cig skye 'gag gi /grangs bzhin de dang 'brel ba yin/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa'i yid dang ni/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las 'di shes 'gyur/ /'di yi cha shas sems nyid la/ /ngar sems nga rgyal 'dzin pa dang / /nga la chags shing ma rig bcas/ /'jig tshogs thams cad bskyed pa'i phyir/ /nyon mongs can gyi

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i bstan bcos/ 25yid ces bya/ /drug po 'gag ma thag yid ni/ /rnam shes skye ba'i gnas yin te/ / nyon yid nyon mongs gnas su 'gyur/ /bskyed dang sgrib pa'i nus par ldan/ /de phyir yid de rnam pa gnyis/ /khyad par blo gros ldan rnams la/ /kun gzhi'i rnam par shes gsungs te/ /'di ni rten dang gnas dang ni/ /len pa'i rnam par shes kyang gsungs/ /tshogs bdun gyis bskyed las rnams kun/ /ma 'dres lung du ma bstan par/ /bsags pas rnam par smin zhes bya/ /char chu rgya mtsho ji bzhin no/ /thams cad bskyed par byed pas na/ /sa bon kun ldang kun gzhi ste/ /rgyu yi rkyen zhes brjod pa yin/ /tshogs bdun log na de ldog phyir/ /rkyen gyi rnam shes zhes kyang bya/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid na/ /kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'di nyid ni/ /spang bya kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'jin gyis/ /bcom par bya bar gsungs pa yin/ /gang che sgrib bcas kun gzhi log /de tshe me long ye shes te/ /ye shersā/ kun snang nga yir med/ /yongs su ma chad rtag tu ldan/ /shes bya rtogs shing der phyogs min/ /ye shes kun gyi rgyu mtshan phyir/ /chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /nyon mongs can gyi yid de ni/ /dpa' bar 'gro bas rab bcom ste/ /mthong sgom nyon mongs rab spangs nas/ /nyon mongs med cing srid zhi med/ /mnyam nyid ye shes zhes su brjod/ /de ma thag pa'i yid de ni/ /drug po 'dzin pas 'dzin pa ste/ /rnam par rtog byed rnam rtog yin/ /de ni yang dag shes rab dang / /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /bcom pas bzod pa che thob tshe/ /don bcas 'dzin pa gnas gyur pas/ /zhing ni dag pa ston pa dang / /dus rnams kun tu ye shes dang / /las rnams kun tu thogs med pa'i/ /rnam rtog gnas yongs gyur pa ni/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te/ /de ltar ye shes gnyis po 'di/ /sgom pa dag pas

26 rgyal dbang karma pa rang byung rdo rje/srid zhi la/ /mi gnas zhi dang byams pa dang / /thugs rjer ldan zhing 'khor rnams la/ /sna tshogs sku dang gsung ston mdzad/ /chos chen dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung / /ting 'dzin gzungs rnam kun gyi gter/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku zhes su brjod/ /sgo lnga yid kyi cha gcig ni/ /yang dag kun rtog las skyes pa/ /bden bzhi'i tshul gyi rnam pa can/ /shes bzod la sogs bcu drug gis/ /don mthong bden par rtogs pa las/ /dbang po lnga rnams gnas 'gyur ni/ /don kun 'jug dang thams cad kyi/ /yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la/ /dbang 'byor de nyid mthar phyin pas/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes te/ /khams rnams kun tu sna tshogs pa'i/ /dpag med bsam yas sprul pa yis/ /sems can kun don bsgrub pa'o/ /'di ni sprul pa'i sku chen po/ /sems yid rnam shes gnas 'gyur pa'i/ /sku gsum mdzad par bcas pa rnams/ /chos dbyings spros bral dkyil 'khor du/ /rdzogs pa 'khor 'das thog med kun/ /gcig dang tha dad bral ba sa /bzhugs pa ngo bo nyid skur bzhed/ /rgyal bas gzhung gzhan kha cig tu/ /'di la chos kyi sku zhes bstan/ /de tshe me long ye shes sku/ /gzhan ni gzugs sku gnyis zhes brjod/ /ye shes lnga dang sku bzhi yi/ /rang bzhin mngon gyur sangs rgyas te/ /sems yid rnam par shes pa yi/ /dri mar ldan gang kun gzhi yin/ /dri med rgyal ba'i snying por brjod/ /ma dag kun rtog 'joms byed pa/ /dag pa'i kun rtog las skyes pa'i/ /'phags pa'i shes rab dbang po ni/ /'dzin pa lam gyi bden par gsungs/ /don dam tshul 'di ma rtogs pas/ /rmongs rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams/ /theg chen gru 'di ma rtogs pas/ /gang gis pha rol phyin par 'gyur/ /kun gyis 'di don rtogs par shog /rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba phag
rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i shā la rang byung rdo rjes bde chen steng 6

rnam shes dang ye shes 'byed pa'i bstan bcos kyi tshig don go gsal du 'grel pa rang byung dgongs pa'i rgyan/༄tsho/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo /legs gsung tshad ma gsum ldan dbyangs/ / dpal gyi mgul nas sgrog pa yis/ /rnam grol lam ston thub pa'i dbang / /rang byung rgyal bar grags la 'dud/ /'khor 'das chos kun rnam shes dang / /ye shes gzugs te de yi tshul/ /ston byed chos phung brgyad khri'i bcud/ /gang 'di sus rtogs srid mthar byed/ /phyogs tsam go zhing myong bas kyang / /snying bum bdud rtsi'i bcud 'khyil te/ /zhi ba'i lang tsho brtas pa'i phyir/ /khyad 'phags gzhung 'di dgrol bar bya/ /chos thams cad kyi de nyid sgrib bral du gzigs pas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la

30 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/mnga' mdzad pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sprul pa'i skur bzhengs nas thub bstan nyin mor byed pa'i phrin las sa gsum na 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bstan bcos tshig nyung don zab 'di 'chad pa la gsum/ rtsom pa la 'jug byed klad kyi don/ 'jug bya gzhung gi don/ zhugs zin mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsum/ bstan bcos kyi mtshan bstan pa/ mchod par brjod pa/ brtsam par dam bca' ba'o /dang po (bistan bcos kyi mtshan bstan pa )ni/rnam shesadangabe shesa'abyed pamibastan bcos/zhes gsungs te/ 'khrul ba dang bcas pa'i sems can la 'khor ba'i rtsa ba rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad ji ltar yod pa dang / 'brul ba bral ba'i sangs rgyas la mya ngan 'das kyi rang bzhin ye shes ji ltar snang ba dang / de gzhi gcig la rnam pa tha dad du snang ba'i tshul rnam par 'byed pa ste/ rnam shes 'khrul ba'i skyon 'chos shing ye shes dri bral gyi rang bzhin du skyob pa'i yon tan gnyis ldan gyi phyir na bstan bcos zhes bya ba ste/ dbu zhabs btsal sla zhing gzhung don mdor bstan gyi tshul du bstan par bzhed nas don dang byed las las mtshan du btags par mdzad do/ /de'ang 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/'bor ba rnam rtog tsam nyid de/ /rnam rtog med pa thar pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor 'das su sgro btags pa ni sems rnam par rtog pa'i

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 31dri bcas dang dri med la dbye bas phye ba tsam yin pas tshul 'di rtogs na chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa (mchod par brjod pa )ni/sangasargyasadababyang chub semasadapa' thamasacad la phyag 'tshal lo /zhes gsungs te/ phyag 'tshal 31 zhes pa bshad gzhir drangs/ gang gis 'tshal na bstan bcos rtsom pa po rang byung rdo rjes so/ /dus gang du 'tshal na 'di nyid rtsom pa'i thog mar ro/ /yul gang la 'tshal na spang bya glo bur gyi sgrib pa gnyis sangs shing rtogs bya dri bral mkhyen gnyis rab tu rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub tu thugs bskyed cing gzhan don du sems dpa' rgyal ba'i sras su gyur pa dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa thams cad la'o/ /tshul ji ltar na sgo gsum gus shing dad pa'i tshul gyis so/ /dgos pa gang gi phyir na/ rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs 'phel zhing bar chad zhi bas rtsom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin par 'gyur ba dang / 'phral yun gyi bde ba mngon mtho dang nges par legs pa'i phun tshogs 'thob par 'gyur ba ste/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod na/ de thams cad sdug bsngal gyi mthar phyin par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa (prurtsam par dam bca' ba )ni /thosadangabasam la rab brten nas/ /sgom pa3tshul lasbyoraba'i phyir/ /

32 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bdag nyid dbain par 'dugaspra na/ /tshul 'di snang babarjodayar bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ rje nyid nges don du sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar 'dzin pa yin kyang gdul bya byis pa'i skye bo rjes su bzung ba'i slad du so skye'i gang zag ltar bstan te/dri ma med pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab par gzhir bzhag thog ma nyid du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa du ma'i zhal snga nas thos pa phyogs med du mdzad/ bar du mno bsam gyi rtog dpyod zhib mos thos pa'i don thugs su chud pa la rab tu brten nas/ mthar thos bsam gyi don de nyid nang du tshul bzhin bsgoms te bsgrubs pas 'bras bu la yang dag par sbyor ba'i phyir/ rang byung rdo rje bdag nyid phyi 'du 'dzi/ nang nyon mongs/ gsang ba 'brul rtog gi rnam par g.yeng bas dben par ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma la mnyam par bzhag ste 'dug par gyur pa na/ 'khrul grol gyi chos tshul zab mo 'di ji bzhin rtogs nas mkhyen pa'i ye shes la gsal bar snang ba ste/ de nyid rjes thob dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rjes skal ldan gyi gdul bya gzhan don gyis rtogs pa'i phyir ched du brjod par bya'o zhes gdams ngag rnam thar gyi sgo nas 'doms pa'ang yin no/ /de'ang sangs rgyas gnyis pa dbyig gnyen gyi zhal nas/tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gang zhig thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 33pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis/ thog ma kho nar yon tan gyi gzhi rten tshul khrims dri ma med pa zhig bsrung dgos te/ bshes springs las/khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs/ tshul khrims dang ldan pas thos pa rgya chen po bya dgos te/ ci'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas thob pa la bdag med gnyis kyi don rtogs dgos/ de rtogs pa la bka' dang bstan bcos kyi don go ba'i lung dang rigs pa shes dgos/ de shes pa la thos pa byed dgos/ de ma byas na bdag med gnyis kyi don mi rtogs/de ma rtogs na bdag med sgom mi shes/ bdag med sgom ma shes na sgom byas kyang sgom byung gi shes rab mi skye/ de ma skyes na 'phags pa'i mthong lam skye mi srid/ de ma skyes na sgom pa mthar thug gi sangs rgyas 'thob pa mi srid pa yin te/ theg bsdo/sa 95sa/thos sogs bag chags med par ni/ /de 'bras skye bar mi rigs phyir/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mang du gsungs so/ /des na thos pa'i shes rab med na blang dor gyi cha mi phyed pas bya ba gang byed kyang stobs chung / skye ba thams cad du dbang po brtul por 'gyur/ sgom byas kyang bdag 'dzin gyi rtsa ba mi chod/ de la sogs pa nyes dmigs mang ngo / /thos pa dang ldan na shes bya la mkhas pas blo mi rmongs/ rang gi blo gros rgyas pas kun la mi

34 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'jigs pa'i sbobs pa thob/ sems kyi rgyud rnam par grol bas blo bde/ mkhas pa mkhas pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro/ tshe rabs thams cad du shes rab phun sum tshogs/ dbang po rno zhing thos pa 'dzin/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang mjal zhing chos kyi don la 'bel ba'i gtam byed par nus/ rang gi shes sgrib sbyong / gzhan la chos kyi 'khor lo phyin ci ma log par bskor ba la sogs pa'i yon tan 'byung ste/ sdud pa las/shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ /khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ /mi yi khyu mchog 'khor lo rin chen bskor byas nas/ /sdug bsngal zad par bya phyir 'gro la chos kyang ston/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dkon mchog brtsegs pa las kyang /thos pas chos rnams shes par 'gyur/ /thos pas don ma yin pa spong / /thos pas sdig pa spong bar byed/ /thos pas mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /thos bsam gyi shes rab med cing bdag med gnyis kyi don ma go bar blun sgom byas na ting nge 'dzin cung zad thob kyang nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba spong mi nus pas 'khor bar lhung ste/ dper na mu stegs rings byed kyi bu lhag spyod kyis lo bcu

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 35gnyis su stong nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pa'i mthar ma phyin par skyes pa lta bu ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/kho nge 'dzin de sgom par byed mod kyi/ /des ni bdag tu 'dzin pa 'jig mi byed/ /de ni nyon mongs phyir zhing rab zhabrugs te/ /lhag spyod 'di na ting 'dzin sgom pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thos bsam gyi shes rab zab mo'i mig thob nas sgom pa don du gnyer ba la shin tu brtson par bya dgos te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs kyi le'u las/shes rab rgyas byed pa ni thos pa ste/ /bsam pa dang ni gnyis po yod gyur na/ / de nas sgom pa la ni sbyor ba ste/ /de las dngos grub bla na med pa thob/ /ces gsungs pa dang / 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i sa bcu bstan pa las kyang / kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' las dang po ba de ni thog ma nyid du kha thon du bskul bar bya'o/ /mang du thos nas dben pa la bskul bar bya'o zhes gadza/ngas/sgom pa dang mi ldan na skyon ci yod snyam na/ sgom pa dang mi ldan pa'i thos bsam rkyang pas don dam pa'i bden pa mngon sum du mi rtogs te/ phal chen las/ci ltar bu ram mngar ba'i ro/ /

36 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bshad las myang bar mi 'gyur te/ /nam zhig bu ram 11sa pa na/ /mngar ba'i ro ni myang ba bzhin/ /stong pa nyid kyi don de dag /bshad pas ro ni myang mi 'gyur/ /nam zhig de la btud ba〉stams na / /rang rig de la skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes garna/ngas rbe1/ /des na thar pa don du gnyer ba'i gang zag rnams kyis/ dang por nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims kyis sgo gsum dag par byas nas/ de nas thos pa'i shes rab kyis sgro 'dogs bcad/ rigs pa'i sgo nas bsam byung gi shes rab kyis thos pa'i don de 'khrul ma 'khrul yang yang bsam zhing bsgom par bya/ de nas ma 'khrul ba'i don de sbyor dngos rjes gsum dang ldan par bsgom na 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab kyis sbyor lam du bdag med gsal snang thob cing 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab kyis mthong lam du bdag med mngon sum gyi tshul gyis mthong zhing / sgom lam du de goms par byas la/ goms pa mthar thug pas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa yin te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/tshul khrims la gnas ting nge 'dzin 'thob ste/ /ting 'dzin thob nas shes rab sgom par byed/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 37shes rab kyis ni ye shes rnam dag 'thob/ /ye shes rnam dag tshul khrims phun sum tshogs/ /zhes gsungs te/ dper na zhing dang / sa bon dang / chu lud drod gsum tshang na 'bras bu ston thog de 'byung la/ gcig ma tshang na yang 'bras bu de mi 'byung ba bzhin/ tshul khrims kyi sa gzhi/ thos pa'i sa bon/ bsam sgom gyi chu lud drod gsher thams cad tshang na sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu bde blag tu smin pa yin no/ /rtsa ba'i gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum/ rnam shes kyi phyogs bshad pa/ ye shes kyi phyogs bshad pa/ de dag gi don mdor bsdu'o/ /de'i dang po la bzhi/'khrul dang ma 'khrul ba'i rtsa ba sems nyid du bshad pa/ snang ba sems su sgrub pa/ sems skye med du bstan pa/ 'khrul ba'i rgyu rkyen tshogs brgyad bshad pa'o/ /dang po la'ang gsum/ gzhan gyis log par rtog pa/ rgyal bas ji ltar bstan pa/ rang gis rtogs nas ston tshul lo/ /dang po (gzhan gyis log par rtog pa )ni/ khamasagasum semasacan thamasacad ni/ /bdag dngagazhanadangaganyisaka dang / /rgyu med lasanibyung bar rtog /byed po byā dang dbathabyug dang / /tshangasadang khyab 'jug phyi rol rdul/ /phag na mo yi rdzasabaden pas/ /bdag dang 'jigarten skyed cesasmra/ /

38 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs te/ rnam par shes pas bsdus pa 'khrul ba'i rang bzhin can/ 'dod pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams gsum du 'khor ba'i sems can 'di dag thams cad rgyu ci las byung ba'i tshul ni/ grub mtha' la ma zhugs pa'i byis pa'i skye bo rnams kyis rtog dpyod mi shes pas ci'ang ma rtogs pa dang / grub mtha' la zhugs pa'i mu stegs byed rnams kyis rgyu rkyen log par rtog pa dang /nang pa nyan thos pa rnams kyis phyogs tsam rtogs pa las snang ba sems/ sems stong nyid/ stong nyid rten 'brel du 'char ba'i tshul yang dag pa'i don ji bzhin nyid ma rtogs pas sgro skur mang du smra bar byed do/ /de'ang mu stegs grangs can pa rnams ni/ bde sdug btang snyoms gsum mam rdul mun pa snying stobs gsum cha mnyam pa'i rgyu gtso bo zhes bya ba rtag pa/ gcig pu/ bem po min pa/ lkog tu gyur pa/ rnam 'phrul sprul pa la mthu thogs pa med pa ste mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa yod pas/ rgyu gtso bo la 'bras bu rnam 'gyur yod pa skye bas/ bdag las bdag skye bar 'dod pa dang /dbang phyug pa rnams ni/ dbang phyug bya ba gcig pu/ rtag pa/ g.yo ba/ lha yin pa/ bkur bya yin pa/ gtsang ba/ byed pa po yin pa/ rang dbang can yin pa ste mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan pa gcig phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad kyi rgyur yod pas/ rgyu gzhan las 'bras bu gzhan skye bar 'dod pa dang /khyab 'jug pa la sogs kyis ni/ mtshan nyid lnga ldan gyi bdag dang byed pa po gzhan gyi nus pa gnyis ka las phyi nang gi dngos po rnams byung bar 'dod pa dang /rgyang 'phen pa rnams kyis ni/ snod bcud thams cad rgyu med pa las rang bzhin gyis byung bar 'dod de/ ji skad du/

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 39nyi shar chu bo thur du 'bab pa dang / /sran zlum tsher ma gzang ring rno ba dang / /rma bya'i mdongs legs gang yin de dag kun/ /sus kyang ma byas ngo bo nyid kyis byung / /zhes zer nas 'jig rten mngon sum gyi snang tshul yang rgyang ring du 'dor bas grub mtha' smra ba thams cad kyi nang nas tha chad pa'o/ /byed po khas len pa la'ang bod du sgod bcud legs nyes thams cad sgom pa phyu zhes bya bas byas par 'dod pa dang / mu stegs pa rnams kyis dbang phyug dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'arnacog gis byas shing bdag dang 'jig rten bskyed pa yin zhes smra bar byed de/ de dag ni log par rtog pa'i 'brul ba sha stag yin pas ring du 'dor bar bya'o/ /yang nang pa'i grub mtha' bzhi'i dang po nyan thos bye brag tu smra bas phyi rol du don du snang ba'i dngos po 'di mi bden yang / rdzas rdul cha shas med pa dbang po'i spyod yul min pa'i don dam/ nang shes pa skad cig cha med sems kyi rdul te snga ma la dngos po gzhan gyis bcom mi nus pa dang / sems rdul blo yis dpyod mi nus pas rtag pa de 'dus nas bsags rdul dbang shes kyi yul du grub pa'i kun rdzob kyi dngos po mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid 'di grub bo zhes/ phyi rol gyi don gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos so so'i rdul bden par khas len no/ /rdzas rdul la shes rab kyis phyogs drug gam bcur phye ba dang / sems rdul la dus gsum du dbye na grub pa med pas mi 'thad la/ cha shas med na rags pa'ang rtsom mi nus so/ /yang nyan thos mdo sde pas ni/ phyi don gzugs sogs mngon sum 'di ni kun

40 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rdzub yind+ra pasashesdu dro ༷ mngon snam du mi snadā ste dbang sdi ༷ yul ༷da pa naXng spas sno' thardzu ༷'a ra ma 'dra ba 'ig snang ba yand+ra la/shes dan rnam ༷sa la gaphyid parasdodapa'adadzhairangamatshanapanaphaṭwāṃ gasna bhig rmā ma' rdzas su bdaspya par yad pas das byādag naḍi gang zag ṭwāṃng 'ag na gya ༷༷sa sam yul chas rnams baXd payan zhes ṭwāṃ'//de'anga'athad ༷/rdzug na ma de shes ༷ la snang na phag na mara'i 'gal ḍi/ sna/ sna rnam pa yang pa/da nus par 'gyur ra// gnyas pa rgyal bas ltar bstan pa na/thamasacadamakhye/palhagagacig ni/ /khamasagasum ṭwāṃdag sems/sa ste//bsna/ lasam yin gakto lhasan//ga 'thugamashu/zla/ da na//chosarnamasarten nga hphul 'byung ste//kaudarpāgingobosastong //ga dang/dadarnamabral bshi//rdzun dang ba/ sna rnam spangasatha//sgyuṅgichu zla sbrigasayi//ma nagamasacan rnamasal gsungs//zhesaXsabakton te/ sgrizlo dzñonyis bag chags ༷ bcas pa~XsarnaXsar groX bas shas bya ja lja ba dzhaing jadapathamasacad zlongan sum ñtsā madzhai pa ṭīgs pa' sangs rgyas/'ag na na 'gran zla spangs pa' nyag ma gag pu sa na/khams

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 41gsum po 'di dag ma rig pas bslad pa'i sems rnam par rtog pa'i rang gzugs tsam las don la grub pa med par gsungs te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di ni sems tsam mo zhes sa bcu pa'i mdo las gsungs pa dang /laṅkar btagags pa las kyang /me long la ni gzugs snang yang / /yin pa med par snang ba ltar/ /sems kyi snang ba mi shes par/ /rnam par rtog pa rnam gnyis skye/ /rnam rtog bag chags 'brel ba yis /sna 31gas sems las byung ba ste/ /mi rnams la ni pha rol snang / / 'jig rten khams ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sngags las kyang /rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don rnams/ /phyi rol gyur pa cung zad med/ /ces gsungs so/ /des na dngos po 'di rnams mu stegs byed kyi 'dod pa ltar bdag las kyang

42 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bdag nyid skye ba ma yin te/ bdag rang grub zin pa yang skyed mi dgos pa dang /gzhan las gzhan skye ba'ang ma yin te/ gzhan zhes pa'ang bdag la ltos dgos na ltos gzhi'i bdag med par su zhig gi gzhan du 'thad/ 'on kyang gzhan gyis gzhan skyed na nyi mas mun pa dang re ldes bum pa sogs bskyed dgos pa la de 'dra srid pa ma yin no/ /gnyis ka 'dus pa las kyang bskyed pa min te/ skyon snga ma gnyis kar 'gyur ba'am yang na bdag gzhan dus mnyam ni rwa g.yas g.yon ltar phan tshun rgyu rkyen du mi 'thad do/ /rgyu med pa ni dbang po'i mngon sum du sa bon las myu gur skye ba sogs mthong bzhin pas 'thad pa min la/ 'o na ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams ni don dam par spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa'i stong pa nyid la kun rdzob kyi snang bar rgyu dang 'bras bu phan tshun gcig la gcig rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ste/ gang brten nas byung ba de nyid la ni rang gi ngo bos grub pa'i bden dngos kyis stong pa'o/ /de ltar rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rang gi ngo bo chu zla lta bur gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba ni chos can kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin la/ snang ba tsam de nyid kyang rang bzhin gyis spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid du bzhugs pa ni chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa yin te/ ye shes snying pos/ ji ltar snang ba 'di kho na/ /kun rdzob gzhan ni cig 3|sa yin/ /zhes dang / ye shes snying po kun las btus pa las kyang /kun rdzob ni gnyis su snang ba'o/ /bden pa ni chu zla lta bu'o/ / don dam pa'i bden pa ni mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba ste/ de'i gnas ni stong pa nyid bco brgyad do zhes gsungs rbes/ /de ltar kun rdzob gnyis su snang ba dang de'i rang gzhin stong pa nyid don dam

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 43pa'i bden pa gcig gam tha dad ce na/ gcig pa yang ma yin te/ kun rdzob bden pa 'brul snang du grub kyang don dam du ma grub la/ don dam bden pa chos nyid du grub kyang kun rdzob tu ma grub ste/ dper na chu zlar snang ba zla dngos su ma grub la/ zla dngos/ nyid chu zlar ma grub pa bzhin no/ /gcig pa yin na kun rdzob bden pa mthong bas don dam bden pa mthong bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i skyon bzhi yod par dgongs 'grel las gsungs so/ /bden gnyis tha dad pa nyid kyang ma yin te/ dper na thag pa la sbrul du 'khrul ba'i tshe dngos gnas su thag pa yod la sbrul med kyang 'khrul snang du yod med gnyis gzhi gcig la tshogs pas tha dad ma yin pa ltar kun rdzob snang ba gang don dam stong nyid dbyer med pas tha dad du grub pa ma yin no/ /tha dad yin na don dam bden pa kun rdzob bden pa'i chos nyid ma yin par 'gyur ba la sogs pa'i skyon bzhi dgongs 'grel las gsungs so/ /des na bden pa gnyis ni gcig pa nyid dang tha dad pa dang rnam par bral zhing snang stong dbyer med du gnas pa yin te/ yang dgongs 'grel las/'du byed khams dang don dam mtshan nyid ni/ /gcig dang tha dad bral ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gcig tha dad gnyis ka min pa'i rdzun pa'ang min te/ kun rdzob ni 'khrul ngor rgyu 'bras mi bslu ba'i phyir dang / don dam ni gnas lugs su bden pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na gnyis ka bden pa'o zhe na/ kun rdzob snang yang rang bzhin ma grub pas stong pa yin la/ don dam blo'i spyod yul las 'das pas bden par grub pa'i rnam gzhag rnam par spangs shing dam bca' byar med do/ /dper na sgyu ma

44 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ni rta glang gi dngos por bden par med kyang der snang ba dang / la sogs pa'i khongs nas/ smig rgyu/ brag cha/ mig yor/ gzugs brnyan/ 'ja' tshon/ sprin glerdzog rnams med bzhin du snang ba dang mtshungs pa ste/ dbu ma byang chub sems 'grel las/ma rig nas brtsams rga shi'i bar/ /mthar thug yan lag bcu gnyis kyi/ /brten nas 'byung bar bya ba ni/ /kho bos rmi lam sgyu 'drar 'dod/ /ces pa dang / na ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus pa las kyang /rang rig spros bral de nyid kyang / /snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang / /de phyir snang stong dbyer med do/ /dper na chu yi zla ba bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na khams gsum po thams cad de lta bur bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen nas tshul de rtogs par byed pa'i thabs rnams sems can rnams la gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa (rang gis rtogs nas ston tshul )ni/de ltar 'khrul dang ma 'khrul ba'i/ /rtsab ganganasabyung yin zhes/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 45me lobalas rang gzugasadang / /du ba lasani mebazhin du/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung chosabarten nas/ /rtogasapa 'dir ni gsal brjod bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar 'brul ba 'khor ba rnam shes kyi phyogs dang / ma 'khrul ba myang 'das ye shes kyi phyogs gnyis po'i rtsa ba gang las ji ltar byung ba yin zhes rang gis rtogs shing gzhan la ston nus pa'ang rgyu rkyen rten 'brel zab mo la brten pa yin te/ dper na g.ya' dag pa'i me long las ni rang gi gzugs brnyan byad bzhin mdzes mi mdzes rtogs pa ltar/ bla ma'i man ngag dang mdo rgyud bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams la brten nas thos bsam gyi shes rab bskyed pas bden pa gnyis/ kyis gnas tshul go du ba byung ba las me yod par rjes su dpog pa bzhin sgom pa'i mngon rtogs rgyud la bskyed pas gnas yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes kyang mtshon te/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gdod nas spros pa'i mtha' las 'das kyang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i tshul ci'ang snang ba de nyid/ skyes sbyang shes rab zab mo la brten nas ma nor ji bzhin rtogs par gyur pa de/ rjes 'jug la thugs brtse bas bstan bcos 'dir ni ma sbas gsal bar brjod par bya'o zhes so/ /gnyis pa snang ba sems su bsgrub pa la bzhi/ 'jug shes lnga'i rten 'bre la bshad cing de sems su bsgrub pa/ sems ma yin pa'i log rtog bsal ba/ byed po gzhan med pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa/ drug pa yid kyi 'brel ba bshad pa'o/ /

46 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dang po ('jug shes lnga'i rten 'brel bshad cing de sems su bsgrub pa )ni/sgo lngamirnam par shesapa ni/ /gzugasasgra dri ro reg bya la/ /blabador byasapasanyon mongasabaskyed/ /kul 'didaganigangayin zhes/ /shesarab ldanawāsalegasabartagasan/ /rnam rigashesaya lasagazhan pa'i/ /rdul sogasaphyi rolagrub pa med/ /ces gsungs te/ de'ang rgyu'i rkyen kun gzhi'i rnam shes nyon yid dang bcas pa las skyes pa'i/ bdag po'i rkyen mig rna ba sna lce lus te sgo lnga po de dang 'brel ba'i rnam par shes pa de ma thag pa'i yid dang bcas pa ni/ dmigs pa'i rkyen so so'i yul gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste lnga por 'phrad cing 'dus te reg pa la brten nas/ mdzes pa snyan pa sogs yul 'dod cing yid du 'ong ba blangs pas nyon mongs pa 'dod chags bskyed/ mi sdug pa dang mi snyan pa sogs mi 'dod la yid du mi 'ong ba rnams dor bas zhe sdang bskyed/ bar pa btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin ma rtogs pas gti mug bskyed pas las bsags/ des 'khor bar 'khyams pa des ci lan na/ 'khrul snang bden zhen byas pas lan no/ /'o na gzung yul lngar snang ba 'di lta bu dag ni rgyu rkyen gang las byung ba yin zhe na/ thos bsam sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab kyi mig dang ldan pas legs par brtags na/ sems rnam par rig pa'i rtsal las byung ba'i sgo lnga'i shes pa de

rnam shes ye shes hphud pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 47rnams so so'i yul lnga por shar ba tsam las gzhan du gyur pa'i rgyu rkyen nyan thos bye mdos 'dod pa'i rdul phran nam phag na mo dang / sogs khongs nas mu stegs 'dod pa'i bdag dang byed pa po phyi rol na grub pa cung zad kyang med do/ /de ltar yang / 'phags pa lha'i snying po ye shes kun las btus pa las/cha shas can zhes byar med cing / /phyi rol don du grub pa med/ /so sor spang ba dmigs su med/ /nyams su myong ba rmi lam 'dra/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa (sems ma yin pa'i log rtog bsal ba )ni/gabacesakul /mirdzabalta'adi dag /shesalasagazhanan bdag gcig min/ /bstan med 11gathagapa med pa yi/ / rig 'dzigabem po'i rdzab(miskye/ /de phyir de byunga'abrel ba med/ /de 'dod shesal kul rnams / /snang bar mi rigasa'abrel med phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang gi tshe phyi yul gyi rdzas gzugs la sogs pa de dag nang mig shes sogs las gzhan pa'i don bden par yod na shes pa dang yul gnyis

48 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba yod pa min zhing / de las de byung gi 'brel ba'ang med par thal/ yul shes kyi 'jug pas bstan tu med cing reg gzugs su ma grub pas thogs pa med pa'i rnam par rig pa las/ de dang rnam pa 'gal ba bstan yod thogs bcas kyi bem po'i rdzas mi skye ste/ rgyu dngos med las 'bras bu dngos por skye ba rdzas 'gal ba'i phyir/ gtan tshigs de'i phyir na shes pa dang yul gnyis de las de byung gi 'brel ba med par 'dod dgos so/ /dngos smra bas de ltar 'dod do zhe na/ de lta na mig sogs shes pa la gzugs sogs yul rnams ni snang bar mi rigs pas mi snang bar thal/ de gnyis 'brel ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /der snang ba la ni de'i bdag nyid dam de las byung ba yin pas khyab la/ ma 'brel na mi snang bas kyang khyab ste/ dper na rmi lam dang ma mthong ba'i dngos po bzhin no/ /gzhan yang mig shes kyis sgra mi thos shing lce shes kyis gzugs mi mthong ba bzhin no/ /don de'i phyir nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus las kyang /snang zhing srid pa'i chos 'di rnams/ /rang rig sems las gud na med/ /snang zhing gsal ba yin pa'i phyir/ /dper na rang rig nyams myong bzhin/ /gal te sems de ma yin na/ /'brel ba med phyir mi snang thal/ /de ltar kun rdzob gtan la dbab/ /zhes gsungs so/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 49gsum pa (byed po gzhan med pa'i sgrub byed 'god pa )ni/de phyir ci ltar snang ba 'di/ /shethaga'adzigagazhan pa'i yul smresgo de/ /de :yangaza༅zhirig nyamakhagamyong bzhin/ /cha med jul dang mya le ba/ /snathab rsāmathasanya de yi sgyurdon/ /phyi rol gardzon dutāspyab med phyir/ /tshokhucigasogathagabyed po min par rtogs/ / zhes gsungs te/ bshad ma thag pa'i gtan tshigs de'i phyir na/ phyi rol ji ltar snang ba 'di dag nang gi shes pa las gzhan pa'i yul bden par grub pa med de/'di'i nges pa yang thog med nas goms pa'i bag chags kyi yid de nyid las byung ba'i rang gi rnam rtog gi yul du utpal 'du shes pa'i rig pa de rang gi blo ngor nyams su myong ba gsal lam mer 'char gyi/ de dang 'brel med gzhan gyi blo ngo'i bum pa lta bu rang la mi snang ba bzhin yin pa'i phyir na/ phra ba cha med kyi rdul dang rgya che ba ri'i ljongs sogs phya le ba ste ji ltar snang ba shar ba de dag rang sems nyid yul ltar snang ba yin te/ gtan tshigs dang rig pa de yi don gyis phyi rol na sems las gzhan du grub pa'i dngos po bden pa med pa'i phyir/ tshangs pa dang sogs khongs nas dbang phyug khyab 'jug bdag dang rdul phran phag na mo dag ni byed pa po yin par mi 'grub la/ de kun sems snang tsam las bden dngos can min par rtogs te/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo las/ lha'i bu padma rnam

50 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/par rol pas 'jam dpal la smras pa/ phyi rol gyi yul rnams byed pa pos byas sam/ ci ltar blta bar bya/ 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ lha'i bu phyi rol gyi yul 'di rnams byed pa pos byas pa ma yin te/ sems rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags mthu brtas pa'i dbang gis snang ba yin no/ /lha'i bus smras pa/ bag chags ji ltar du brtas kyang ri bo dang / rgya mtsho dang / nyi ma la sogs pa sra zhing 'thas pa 'di lta bu snang du ga la rung / 'jam dpal gyis smras pa/ rnam par rtog pa brtas pa'i dbang gis 'di ltar snang du rung ste/ grong khyer chen po wā ra ṇa sir rgan mo zhig gis rang gi lus stag tu bsgoms pas/ grong khyer gyi mi thams cad kyis stag tu mthong nas thams cad bros te grong khyer stongs par gyur to/ /dge slong kha cig gis rang gi lus mi gtsang bar bsgoms pas sems can gyis rul pa dang sungs pa mthong ba byung ngo / /de rnams yun thung ngus kyang de ltar snang na thog ma med pa'i bag chags brtas pas ci ste mi snang zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so/ /bzhi pa (6ga pa yid kyi 'brel ba bshad pa )ni/yid dang chosakyi 'brel bapong / /rmi lam nyamasasu myobab bzhin/ /de nyid de la dmigasapa la/ /zhen parazad kyi dngosabaden med/ /ces gsungs te/ tshogs drug pa yid dang de'i yul du snang ba chos kyi 'brel ba ci ltar 'dod ce na/ de yang nyin mo'i dran tshor gyi bag chags rnams rang nyid gnyid kyis non pa'i rmi lam gyi dbang yul du mngon sum lta bur mthong thos su nyams su

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 51myong ba rdzun med yin pa bzhin/ yid kyi bag chags snga mar bum pa'i dran pa skyes pa de nyid du 'gag kyang de la yang rnam rtog phyi mas slar yang rim par rgyun mthud pa'i dmigs pa la ma brtags pa'i ngor bum pa'o snyam pa'i gzung chos kyi bden zhen 'thas par zad kyi/ yid las gzhan pa'i chos kyi dngos po logs su bden par grub pa med de/ rmi lam la rdul tsam ma grub par sna tshogs snang ba'ang med pa kho na snang ba bzhin bum pa'i bag chags dang de'i mtshan nyid dang de la bden rtog skye ba rnams skad cig du ma'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa sems skye med du bstan pa la gnyis/ dngos dang / lung gi sgrub byed bstan pa'o/ /dang po (sems skye med du bstan pa dngos )ni/de ltar tshogasadrugashesapa 'di/ /donadabasemasacanasnangabadab/ /bdag 'dzin dang nirnam rigadatha/ /snababa'i rnamaspragang byungab/ /'di migazhan gyisabyasaminan/ /bdag giba'ibyedaspa 'gyur ma yin/ /gnyisakyisamabaskyed gnyisamed min/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'o na phyi'i don bden par ma grub kyang nang gi shes pa grub bam ma grub ce na/ ma grub ste/ dper na pha ri bya ba de tshur ri la ltos pa bzhin/ shes pa shes bya la ltos pas gzung don med na 'dzin pa'i shes pa yang med par grub ste/

52 ri'ajam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/mngon rtogs rgyan las/gal te gzung don rang bzhin med/ /de dag gang gis 'dzin par 'dod/ /de ltar de dag 'dzin pa yi/ /ngo bos stong pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis kyang /gzung ba med na der 'dzin med/ /de med rnam par shes pa'ang med/ /ces gsungs pa de ltar yin pa'i phyir na/ rmegs drug gi shes pa 'di la phyi rol yul gyis bsdus pa'i gzugs sogs don du snang ba dang / nang sems can gyis bsdus pa'i mig dbang sogs rten tu snang ba dang / bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par shes pa dang / sems las byung ba yul rnam par rig pas blang dor byed pa ste/mdor na snang ba'i rnam pa gang byung ba 'di rnams sems tsam yin gyi rgyu gzhan gyis byas pa ma yin nam zhe na/ bdag ces bya ba gdod nas ma grub pas bdag gis byed par 'gyur ba'ang ma yin/ bdag med pa la gzhan mi 'thad pas na gzhan dang de gnyis med pas gnyis kas kyang ma bskyed/ bdag gzhan gnyis med pa'i rgyu med kyis kyang bskyed pa ma yin te/ dbu ma rtsa ba las/bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 53dngos po gang dang gang na yang / /skye ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes ganda/ngas rbedu/ /gnyis pa (lung gi sgrub byed bstan pa )ni/de phyir rgyal bsagasungasapa ltar/ /'khor 'dasathamasacad semasatsam ste/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong du ji skad bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir na/ rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde spyi dang khyad par phal po che las/sems ni ri mo mkhan dang 'dra/ /sems kyis phung po byas pa ste/ /'jig rten khams na ci snyed pa/ /de snyed thams cad sems kyis bris/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs pa ste/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad sems 'khrul ba'i rang gzugs dang / myang 'das kyi chos thams cad sems gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i gshis lugs snang ba yin pas mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad las chos rnams sems tsam du gsungs pa ste/ bram ze chen pos/sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /

54 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /don de nyid lam gyi gnas skabs su rtogs pa'i rim pa'ang / dang por rnam par rig pa tsam du dmigs pa la brten nas sems las gzhan du gyur pa'i phyi rol gyi don med par rtogs nas don mi dmigs pa skye'o/ /gzung ba med na 'dzin pa med pas don mi dmigs pa la brten nas rnam par rig pa tsam du 'dzin pa yang mi dmigs pa skye ste/ dbus mtha' las/dmigs pa la ni brten nas su/ /mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye/ /mi dmigs pa la brten nas ni/ /mi dmigs ngo bo nyid du grub/ /ces gsungs so/ /de ltar gzung 'dzin ma grub pa'i gnas lugs ji bzhin du rtogs na chos kyi dbyings rtogs pa yin te/ rgyan las/sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas/ /de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs/ /blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas/ /de mi ldan pa'i chos kyi dbyings la gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 55bzhi pa 'khrul ba'i rgyu rkyen tshogs brgyad bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan/rgyas bshad do/ /dang po (mdor bstan pa )ni/'di yi rgyu rkyen rten 'brel ni/ /tshogasadrugawaṃdadang kun gzhi zhes/ /gsungasate / /zhes gsungs te/ 'khor 'das thams cad sems su bshad pa de lta na yin lugs ji ltar yin snyam na/ dang po 'khor ba 'di yi rgyu dang rkyen dang de gnyis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba las byung ba'i tshul shes par gal che bas/ de yi tshul ni rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug dang / nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang / kun gzhi rnams yin no zhes mdo rgyud bstan bcos dri ma med pa rnams las gsungs te/ de'ang kun gzhi des rgyu'i rkyen byas pas/ tshogs bdun 'bras bur gyur pa de las khams gsum gyi las dang sdug bsngal thams cad so sor smin pa dang / yang de rnams kyi bag chags kun gzhi la bzhag nas kun gzhi'i nus pa bskyed pas kun gzhi tshogs bdun gyi 'bras bu zhes kyang bya ste/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rdo rje rtse mo las/sa bon kun ldang kun gzhi ni/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /zhar byung du shes par bya ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i rten 'brel ni/ dri ma med

56 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/pa'i chos sku'i khams da ltar yod pa'i nus pas phyi rol ltar snang ba'i rkyen sangs rgyas kyi chos thos pas/ chos sku'i khams rang la yod pa dang rang gis thob par yang nus la/ yon tan chen po dang ldan par shes pa'i shes rab 'byung zhing gnas de la dad par 'gyur ro/ /dad pa la brten nas mos pa 'byung ngo / /mos pa las nges par 'jug pa'i brtson 'grus 'byung ngo / /de la brten nas tshogs gnyis bsags pas dri ma dang bral la rnam par dag pa'i chos sku 'byung ste/ rgyud bla ma las/bsam mi khyab pa'i yul 'di ni/ /yod dang bdag 'dras thob nus dang / /thob pa 'di 'dra'i phan yon dang / /ldan zhes dad pas mos pa'i phyir/ /'dun brtson dran dang bsam gtan dang / /shes rab la sogs yon tan snod/ /byang chub sems ni de dag la/ /rtag tu nye bar gnas par 'gyur/ /de ni rtag tu nyer gnas pas/ /rgyal ba'i sras po phyir mi ldog /bsod nams pha rol phyin rdzogs dang / / yongs su dag pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ tshogs drug bshad pa/ de ma thag rkyen

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 57nyon yid dang bcas pa bshad pa/ rgyu'i rkyen kun gzhi bshad pa'o/ /de'i dang po la'ang bzhi/ tshogs drug ngos bzung ba/ dmigs rkyen ngos bzung ba/ bdag rkyen ngos bzung ba/ de dag gang las byung ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po (tshogs drug ngos bzung ba )ni /tshogasadrug shesapa ni/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la thog mar gzung 'dzin nye bar len pa tshogs drug gi rnam par shes pa ni gang zhe na/ gzugs 'dzin pa'i mig gi rnam par shes pa dang / sgra 'dzin pa'i rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang / dri 'dzin pa'i sna'i rnam par shes pa dang /ro 'dzin pa'i lce'i rnam par shes pa dang / reg bya 'dzin pa'i lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang / chos 'dzin pa'i yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang drug go /gnyis pa (dimigs rkyen ngos bzung ba )ni/dmigasarkyen la stosade dgakyang / /gzugaba'isogatha(bul nidrub/po yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ rnam shes drug po de rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis ngo bos grub pa mi srid cing rkyen bzhi la brten nas 'byung ba ste/ de'ang thog mar dmigs pa'i rkyen la ltos shing ltos bya yul drug yod pas ltos byed rnam shes kyang drug tu 'gyur te/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ gzugs dang sogs khongs nas sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg bya dang chos te yul lam don du grags pa'i rnam grangs ni drug po de rnams yin no/ /de la spyir phung po lnga'i dbang du byas nas dbang yul rnams kyang gzugs kyi phung por

58 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'du ste/ rgyu'i gzugs sa chu me rlung gi khams te 'byung ba chen po bzhi/ 'bras bu'i gzugs 'byung ba bzhi las gyur pa dbang po lnga don lnga dang bcu/ rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs dang bcu gcig tu gsungs shing / 'dir ni mig gi yul du gyur pa'i gzugs la sogs pa'i don lnga la 'chad de/ de dag gi nang gses kyi dbye ba ni/ mngon pa mdzod las/gzugs rnam gnyis te rnam nyi shu/ /sgra ni rnam pa brgyad yod de/ /dri ni rnam bzhi ro rnam drug /reg bya bcu gcig bdag nyid do/ /zhes dang /g.yeng dang sems med pa yi yang / /dge dang mi dge rjes 'brang gang / /'byung ba che rnams rgyur byas pa/ /de ni rnam rig byed min nyid/ /ces sogs rnam gzhag rgyas par 'byung ba dang / chos la 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas gnyis/ de re re la'ang brgyad brgyad dam/ 'dus ma byas gsum gyi rnam gzhag sogs yod pa gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 59gsum pa (bidag rkyen ngos bzung ba )ni/bdag rkyenadabapapo drug 21 ste/ /deyangasgolngargyagabaltacan dwangabaltapa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ rnam shes drug gi bdag po'i rkyen ni skyon med kyi dbang po drug yin te/ mig gi dbang po zar ma'i me tog lta bu/ rna ba'i dbang po gro ga'i 'dzer bu lta bu/ sna'i dbang po zangs khab gshibs pa lta bu/ lte'i dbang po zla ba phyed du bkas pa lta bu ste/ dbang po de rnams dbang rten rnams kyi nang na yod par 'dod cing / lus kyi dbang po bya reg 'jam gyi pags pa lta bu lus thams cad la khyab par bshad do/ /dbang po lnga ga yul gzugs can dwangs pa/ shes pa yul 'dzin nus su bskyed pa'o/ /gzugs can zhes pa'i don ni/ rdul phra rab 'dus pa'am 'byung ba bzhi'i rgyu las byung ba dang / dwangs pa ni me 'o1nga la gzugs brnyan gsal ba ltar rang gi go sar rdul gzhan gyis go 'gags par rnam par shes pa dang 'brel bas yul gsal ba'i don te/ 'di'ang nang gi sa bon nam nus pas 'brel ba yin par bshad/ theg bsdus su ni/ kun gzhi'i gzung ba'i cha dbang po lngar snang ba la bzhed de thams cad kyang 'gal ba med do/ /yid kyi dbang po ni de ma thag pa kun gzhi la skye ba dang 'gag pa nyid dang / drug po 'gag ma thag par yid kyi khams su bshad pa dang / kun gzhi'i nus pa'i bye brag la sogs par bshad kyang / don ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa skye ba'i sgo byed pa yid kyi skye mched du rigs te/ chos 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi skye mched dang de gnyis yul dang yul can du rten cing hrūng ba'i phyir ro/ /

60 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bzhi pa (di dag gang las byung ba bshad pa )ni/gnyizla ka bemab(lab(byung ba yin/ /kul dngadabathapor rab snangab/ /thog med khamagal brten pa yin/ /don mthobarnam par shesayin kyang / /khyad par semakha(byung 'du byed ni/ /yid kyirnam shesalabartenate/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar yul drug dbang po drug ste yul yul can gnyis ka yang sems las byung ba ma gtogs pa don dam par grub pa med do/ /'o na snang ba 'di ci yin zhe na/ phyi yul dang nang dbang por rab tu snang ba 'di ni thog ma med pa'i dus nas ma rig pa'i dbang gis gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa la yod par rtog nas de yi bag chags sa bon kun gzhi la bzhag pa'i khams de sad pa la brten nas snang ba yin no/ /phyi'i don mthong ba'i mig sogs rnam par shes pa lnga la gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams snang yang / 'di ni ka ba'o/ /bum pa'o snyam pa'i khyad par mi shes te/ mig gi rnam par shes pas sngon po shes kyi sngon po'o snyam du ni ma yin no zhes lung las byung bas so/ /des na dang po dbang shes rnams la yul rnams snang zhing de'i khyad par shes pa ni sems byung 'du shes yin pas/ sems byung rnams kyi nang nas yul la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes kyis gzugs 'di sdug go mi sdug go snyam pa dang / sgra 'di snyan no mi snyan no snyam pa la sogs par 'du shes pa rnams ni yid kyi rnam par shes pa la brten nas byung

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 61ba yin te/ dbus mtha' las de la don mthong rnam par shes/ /de yi khyad par sems las byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /yid shes 'di mi 'byung ba'i gnas skabs ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis sum cu pa'i rab tu byed pa las/yid kyi rnam shes 'byung ba ni/ /rtag tu 'du shes med pa dang / /snyoms par 'jug pa rnam gnyis dang / /sems med brgyal dang gnyid ma gtogs/ /zhes gnas skabs de lnga na yid shes re zhig kun gzhi la bsdus pas chos la gtod pa mi gsal bas mi 'byung ba'i gnas skabs yin par gsungs pa'ang shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa de ma thag rkyen nyon yid dang bcas pa bshad pa la gnyis/ ming gis mdor bstan/ mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po (ming gis mdor bstan pa )ni/de ma thagadang nyon yid gnyis/ / zhes gsungs te/ tshogs drug skye 'gag gi rkyen bzhir bshad pa'i de ma thag pa'i rkyen de gang yin snyam na/ 'di la kha cig drug pa yid kyi char 'dod pa dang / kha

62 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/cig don la med par 'dod pa yod kyang / des ni nyan thos pa tshogs drug las mi 'dod pa'i rnam gzhag la brten nas theg chen pa tshogs brgyad 'dod pa'i lugs ma shes par zad do/ /des na kun gzhi la gnas pa'i yid la cha gnyis su byas te/de ma thag pa'i yid ces bya ba dang / nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnyis su yod do/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ de ma thag yid bshad pa/ nyon yid bshad pa/ gnyis ka'i mtshan nyid mdor bsdu ba'o/ /dang po 9 ma thag yid bshad pa )ni/drug posnye dang 'gag pa yi/ /rkyen phyir de ma thagapa yin/ /tshogib(drugaskad cigaskye 'gag gi /grangasabazhinade dang 'brel ba yin/ /rnal 'byor ldan pamiyid dang ni/ /rgyal ba'ibaka' lasa'adi shesa'agyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ma thag pa'i yid ces bya ba ni/ rnam par shes pa tshogs drug skye na yang de ma thag tu skye ba'i rkyen byed/ tshogs drug 'gag na yang de ma thag tu tshogs drug gi nus pa sa bon kun gzhi la 'jog pa'i rkyen byed pa'i phyir/ skye 'gag gnyis ka'i de ma thag pa'i rkyen yin no/ /de yang tshogs drug rnams 'gags pa na yid kyi khams dang gcig tu bshad pa'i de ma thag pa'i rnam par shes pas kun gzhi la 'khyer zhing / yang de ma thag tu sa bon thams cad pa las chu las rlabs kyi rkyen bzhin du kun gzhi la gnas pa'i yid g.yo zhing 'jug pas de

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 63ma thag pa'i yid 'byung ba ste/ tshogs drug gi rkyen gcig tu 'byung na de ma thag pa yang gcig 'byung gi gnyis pa mi 'byung ngo / /mang po 'byung ba'i rkyen nye bar gnas na yang de snyed cig 'byung ngo / /des na tshogs drug po snga mtsho'agags pa na de ma thag tu yang phyi ma'i rkyen nye bar sbyor bas de ma thag pa yin no/ /de'i phyir tshogs drug skad cig skye 'gag du byed kyi grangs bzhin du de ma thag pa yang grangs de dang mnyam par 'brel nas 'byung ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i tshul de gang las shes she na/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i yid kyi mngon sum dang ni/ rgyal ba'i bka' zab cing rgya che ba'i tshul rnams las yid 'di rjes su dpag pas shes par 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa (nyon yid bshad pa)ni/'di yi mashasasemasanyid la/ /bar semasathargyal 'dzin padang/ / nga la chagasashipam rig bcas/ /'jig tshogasathamasacadabaskyed pamiphyir/ /nyon mongasacan gyi yid cesabya/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ma thag pa'i yid 'di yi cha shas su gyur pa nyon yid ces grags pa'ang kun gzhi la gnas nas 'byung ste/ de'ang rang gi sems nyid dri ma med pa ma rtogs shing dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems nyid kun gzhi de la dmigs nas ngar sems pa dang / nga rgyal te mchog go snyam du 'dzin pa dang / nga la gzhan las gces par bzung ba'i chags shing 'chum pa dang / nga nyid bden med du ma

64 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rtogs pas ma rig pa dang bcas pa ste nyon mongs pa bzhis rtag tu bgos pa'i phyir/ gang zhig rigs pas brtags na tshugs mi thub par 'jig par 'gyur ba'i tshogs te gzhi phung po lnga la bdag gir yin pa 'dzin pa dang / bdag phung po dang ldan pa dang / phung po lnga la bdag gnas pa dang / phung po lnga bdag las byung bar 'dzin pas na nyi shu dang / de'ang re re bzhin dus 'das pa dang da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa gsum du log zhugs kyis drug cu tham pa dang / spyir rtag chad gnyis su 'dzin pas re gnyis po thams cad bskyed pa'i phyir nyon mongs pa can gyi yid ces bya ste/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi sum cu pa las/de la gnas te rab 'byung zhing / /de la dmigs pas yid ces bya/ /rnam shes ngar sems bdag nyid can/ /bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa/ /nyon mongs bzhi dang rtag tu 'grogs/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni rnam par shes pa nyon mongs pa'i gnas yin pas 'di la ni tshad ma med cing tshad ma ma yin pa'i blo thams cad skye bar byed pa yin no/ /'dis ni kun gzhi bag chags kyis bsgribs la ngo bo ni lung du ma bstan pa yin pas kun btags dang nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba ste des na yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun rtog ces kyang bshad do/ /'di las kha nang du lta ba'i nyon mongs pa bsgoms pas spang bar bya ba rnams 'byung zhing / 'di'i rkyen gyis tshogs drug kyang dri ma can du byas pas mthong bas spong bar bya ba'i nyon mongs pa kha phyir lta ba rnams 'byung ba yin no/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 65gsum pa (gnyis ka'i mtshan nyid mdor bsdu ba )ni/drug po 'gag ma thag yid ni/ /rnam shegaskye ba'i gnasayin te/ /nyon yid nyon mopasaganasasu 'gyur/ /bskyed dang sgrib pa'i nusapa ldan/ /de phyir yid de rnam paganyis/ /zhes gsungs te/ de gnyis kyi mtshan nyid mdor bsdus na/ drug po kun gzhi la 'gag ma thag pa'i yid ni rnam shes tshogs drug phyi ma skye bar byed pa'i gnas sam mtshams sbyor ba po yin la/ nyon yid kyis ni tshogs drug nyon mongs pa can du byed pa'i gnas su 'gyur bas na/ de ma thag yid ni tshogs drug skyed pa'i nus par ldan la/ nyon yid kyis ni sgrib pa'i nus pa dang ldan pa de'i phyir/ kun gzhi la gnas pa'i yid de ni rnam pa gnyis su dbye ba yin no/ /gal te de ma thag des dad pa sogs rnam byang gi shes pa bskyed na ni de tshe nyon mongs pa can mi rgyu bas dri ma med pa'i yid ces mdo dag las gsungs so/ /de dag gi don rgyas pa theg bsdus las/ de la yid ni rnam pa gnyis/ de ma thag tu rkyen byed pa'i gnas su gyur pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa 'gag ma thag pa'i yid ces bya ba rnam par shes pa skye ba'i gnas dang / gnyis pa nyon mongs pa can gyi yid nyon mongs pa bzhi po 'jig tshogs la/ lta ba dang / nga'o snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang / bdag la chags pa dang /ma rig pa dang rtag tu mtshungs par ldan pa ste/ de yang rnam par shes pa kun nas nyon mongs pa'i gnas yin no/ /rnam par shes pa ni gang gnas gcig pos ni

66 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bskyed la/ gnyis pas ni nyon mongs pa can du byas te yul rnam par rig pa'i phyir rnam par shes pa'o/ /de ma thag pa dang ngar sems pa'i phyir yid ni rnam pa gnyis so zhes gsungs te/ nyon mongs pa ni de ngar 'dzin pa'i tshig te/ rgyu mtshan des na khams gsum du 'khor ba'i 'khrul ba thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni 'di yin no/ /de'i phyir khams gsum las 'das pa'i 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang / dgra bcom pa dang / byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag na 'di med do/ /'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug na yod pa'i khyad par yang shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rgyu'i rkyenakun gzhi bshad pa la gnyis/ ming gi sgo nas mdor bstan/khyad par gyi mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po (ming gi sgo nas mdor bstan pa )ni/khyad par blo grogaldanarnamasal/ /kunagazhi'i rnamapar shesagasungasate/ /zhes gsungs te/ theg pa chung ngu'i bdag med rtogs pa'i blo gros las khyad par du 'phags pa chos nyid kyi gnas lugs zab mo ji bzhin rtogs par nus pa'i blo 17sa dang ldan pa'i theg chen pa rnams la rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pas tshogs drug gi rgyu'i rkyen du gyur pa kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa zhes gsal bar gsungs te/ mngon pa'i mdo las/chos kun sa bon thams cad pa'i/ /rnam par shes pa kun gzhi ste/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 67de bas kun gzhi'i rnam shes de/ /dam pa dag la ngas bshad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'i mtshan nyid mdor bsdus pa'ang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi sum cu pa'i rab tu byed pa las/de la kun gzhi'i rnam shes ni/ /rnam smin sa bon thams cad pa/ /rtag tu reg dang yid byed dang / /tshor dang 'du shes sems par ldan/ /de la tshor ba btang snyoms te/ /de ni ma bsgribs lung ma bstan/ /de ni rgyun 'bab chu krerdzo bzhin/ /dgra bcom nyid na de ldog go /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kun tu rtog pa'i chos thams cad 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur pas kun gzhi zhes bya/ de la rnam par shes pa'i sgra dang ldan pa ji ltar yin snyam na/de bzhin nyid dam bde gshegs snying po la'ang kun gzhir brjod pa'i skabs yod pas khyad par du 'byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam par shes pa ni don mthong ba la brjod na 'dir don du ji ltar bzhag ce na/ rnam smin dang sa bon thams cad dang ldan pa yul dang kun gzhi'i gsal cha yul can ltar gyur nas rnam par shes pa tshogs bdun gyi nyer len las phan tshun rgyu dang rkyen gyi dngos por 'gyur ba'i phyir na rnam

68 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/par shes pa zhes bya'o/ /thams cad der bsags pa'i phyir rnam par smin pa ste char chu las rgya mtsho bzhin no/ /rkyen nye bar bskyed pa thams cad skyed pa'i phyir rgyur gyur pa'i cha nas sa bon thams cad pa'o/ /kun tu 'gro ba'i reg pa dang /yid la byed pa dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / sems pa dang lnga pos dus thams cad du bskor bas/ sems byung rnams kyang rnam par shes pa'i khyad par du 'gyur ba ste/ kun gzhi'i 'khor tshor ba de ni btang snyoms pa yin la/ kun gzhi nyid ni ngo bo ma bsgribs la lung du ma bstan pa ste me long gi gsal ba bzhin no/ /rgyun 'bab pa'i chu bo bzhin du yul dang yul can dang dbang po'i sa bon rgyun chad med par 'bab pa yin no/ /dgra bcom nyid na de ldog ces pa ni sangs rgyas la dgongs pa ste/ nyan thos kyi dgra bcom la ni kun gzhi yod pa nyid do/ /'on kyang gang zag gi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i nyon yid kyi rten log pa'i cha gcig log par bshad du rung ngo / /de lta bu'i kun gzhi de ni theg chung ba rnams la mu stegs pa'i bdag dang don gcig par 'khrul du dogs nas ma bstan pa yin te/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las/kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra/ /sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung bas/ /de ni byis pa rnam la ngas ma bstan/ /zhes gsungs rbedu/ /

rnam shes ya shes 'byed pa' tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 69gnyis pa (khyad par gyi mtshan nyid rgyas par bshad pa )ni/'di niṭwāṃn dngaganasadapani//sbya/parnamarnyir shesakyang gsungs//'jibadun sabaskyed lasarnamasakun//ma salungadumabastaṭwāṃparsha/sa/bsagasapas/ma rshar na bya//char chu rgya mtsho banano//༵༵cad tshod par snyi ktali//yin kun ldang kun g.yi //rgyu rkyen zhesabarjod pa na//tshogasabadun logata de sdog phyir//rkyen mirnam shesazhesakyang bya// zhes gsudros dzhai/ kun gzhi'i /ga par shes pa zhes bya ba 'atram̐ ni ༷mas gadzhaimasdo 'khrulabaX ga rshang /ོdbang pa gzugs can thaXsna ca) kya rgyu yan pas na gya ṭaṃm par sdos pa'i sa brja) pa dang / bag dzogs kya sa dron dang luX thams cad nyabaralaX ༷'a gnas yanapardzuganardzukya rnam parashasna ༷rdaribarjada~X dang /gzhaspya yang da na bdug da~X phung rno dad 'dadardzudangalta ba ba pad nya bar dzin pasdu sngis nyad mardzums sbyar ba la nga da dag mngan par 'khrid pa nyabar ḍin pa' phyaḍi len pa' rnam par shes pa zhes kyang gsungs snro/ོ/gas band+raspya gyas bskyed pa' las dkar nag dang yul dbang shes gsum gya sa ban kun sa sar ma 'dres

70 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/shing ngo bo dge ba'am mi dge bar lung du ma bstan par kun gzhi der bsags pas rnam par smin pa'i rnam par shes pa zhes kyang bya ste/ dper na char ba ni chu bor 'bab pa dang chu bo rnams kyang rgya mtshor 'bab cing bsags pa ji lta ba bzhin yin te/ de'ang tshogs drug char ba/ yid kyis las bsags pa chu bo/ kun gzhi rgya mtsho lta bu'o/ /las gang yang rung sbyor dngos rjes gsum rdzogs pa ni las bsags pa zhes bya ste 'bras bu nges par 'byin nus can yin la/ las 'gags nas de'i 'bras bu ma smin pa'i bar de la rnam par smin pa zhes brjod pa'ang shesayar bya'o/ /yang rkyen tshogs na de ma thag tu rgya mtsho las chu rlabs g.yo zhing 'byung ba bzhin du /sa bon thams cad pa'i kun gzhi'i las nyon yid g.yo zhing 'byung bas de ma thag pa'i yid 'byung ste/ kun gzhi'i steng du yod pa'i sa bon rnams la 'bras bu so sor ma 'dres par skyed par byed pa yin te/ mngon pa'i mdo las/rnam par shes pa yid las byung / /yid ni kun gzhi las byung ste/ /kun gzhi la ni chos rnams kun/ /rba rlabs bzhin du rnam par g.yo/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / mdo gzhan las kyang /ji ltar rlung gis bskyod pa'i rgya mtsho ni/ /che las chu rlabs 'byung ba de bzhin du/ /kun gyi sa bon kun gzhi zhes bya las/ /rang gi nus pa rnam shes tsam zhig 'byung / /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 71zhes gsungs so/ /des phyi nang thams cad skyed par byed pas na sa bon kun ldang ba'i kun gzhi yin pas 'di la ni tshogs drug gi rgyu'i rkyen zhes brjod pa yin no/ /thos sgom gyi nus pas tshogs bdun nang du log na bag chags gsar du gsog pa med pas char chu skom pa'i rgya mtsho ltar kun gzhi bskyed pa'i rgyu med pas kun gzhi de ldog pa'i phyir/ tshogs bdun gyi rkyen la ltos pas rkyen gyi rnam par shes pa zhes kyang gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos de rnams kyi rgyu kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa yin pa ltar/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos rnams kyang kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa de'i rgyu'i rkyen du rnam par bzhag ste rgyu'i rkyen gzhan ma dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi tshul theg bsdus las rgyas par 'byung ba ltar 'dir yang sdud pa'i sgras zhar byung du bstan pa go dgos so/ /de ltar bshad pa'i kun gzhi de dag pa'i cha la rnam byang nyid kyi rgyu'i tha snyad du brjod par byed na rung gi kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rgyur bshad na ni mi rung ste/ rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/kun gzhi kun gyi gzhi yin kyang / / rnam par byang ba'i gzhi ma yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang 'di la bshad tshul mang ngo / /'o na dkar po'i chos sangs rgyas kyi byang chub dang dbye ba med pa yang dag pa'i lta ba la brten nas rtogs pa yang kun gzhi'i steng du 'jog pa ma yin nam/ rnam par byang ba'i chos de dag ji ltar bskyed ce na/ 'di ni chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i chos sku de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying

72 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/po la brten pa ste/ de'i tshul rgyas pa kun mkhyen rang byung zhabs nyid kyis mdzad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa las rtogs par bya'o/ /gzhung don gnyis pa tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa'i ye shes sku dang bcas pa bshad pa la gnyis/ spyi don mdor bstan/ gzhung don rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po (spyi don mdor bstan pa )ni/ kun gzhi'i rang ngo ma rig ste gzung 'dzin g.yos pas 'khrul ba'i rgyu byas nas/ khams gsum du 'khenar zhing sems can du gdags pa'i brgal dka' srid nga/ sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'di byung ba yin la/ sems can gyi phung po lngar 'dzin pa'i glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral nas gnas yongs su gyur pa ni sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi ye shes lngar shar ba ste/ mdor na sems can du gdags pa'i gzhi phung po lnga dang / de'i yang nyer len gyi rgyu sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu sems can gyi phung po lnga gnas gyur pa las byung ba ste/ theg bsdus las/ yang dbang 'byor ba dus chos kyi sku la dbang 'byor ba thob ce na/ mdor bsdu na rnam pa lngas 'thob ste/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur pa'i phyir zhing dang / lus dang / mtshan dang / dpe byad bzang po dang / dbyangs mtha' yas pa dang / spyi gtsug bltar mi mthong ba la dbang 'byor ba dang / tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur pa'i phyir kha na ma tho ba med cing tshad med pa rgya che ba'i bde bar gnas pa la dbang 'byor ba dang / 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur pa'i phyir ming gi tshogs dang / tshig gi tshogs dang / yi ge'i tshogs thams cad kyis bstan pa la dbang 'byor ba dang / 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur pa'i phyir sprul pa dang / bsgyur ba dang / 'khor sdud pa dang / dkar po'i chos bsdu ba la dbang 'byor

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 73ba dang / rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur pa'i phyir me long lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la dbang 'byor bas dbang 'byor pa thob pa'o zhes gsungs te/ de la phung po bzhi po'i gnas gyur tshul lung de nyid kyis go bas/ 'dir rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pa la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes bzhir gyur pa'i tshul cung zad bshad na/ dang po ye shes 'thob pa'i rgyu bzhi dang / gnas gyur gyi rgyu bzhir gsungs te/dang po ni/ sde snod gsum gyi chos thos shing 'dzin pa'i shes rab ni me long lta bu'i rgyu/ sems can thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid sgom pa ni mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rgyu/ gzhan la chos ston pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu/ gzhan gyi bya ba bsgrub pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu yin te/ rgyan las/'dzin pa'i phyir dang sems mnyam phyir/ /yang dag chos rab ston phyir dang / / bya ba bsgrub pa nyid kyi phyir/ /ye shes bzhi po yang dag byung / /zhes garna/ngas rbedu/ /gnyis pa ni/ sku gsum la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /kun gzhi la gnas pa'i yid gnas gyur pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ye shes de dag kyang bsdu na ji lta mkhyen
