74 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/pa dang ji snyed mkhyen pa gnyis su 'du ste/dang po ni/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid snang med mthar thug pa ni mnyam bzhag ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin te/ bden gnyis las/gang tshe shes dang shes bya dag /bdag nyid rjes su mi mthong na/ /de tshe mtshan mar mi 'byung phyir/ /gnas pa brtan phyir mi bzhengs rbe1/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /dus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi rdzas rigs ma lus pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bur mngon sum du rtogs pa ni/ rjes thob ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin te/ bden gnyis las/ mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig gis ni/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de'ang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la mnyam rjes ris su bcad pa med kyang mkhyen tshul tsam las btags pa'o/ /gnyis pa gzhung don dngos bshad pa la drug me long ye shes chos skur bshad pa/ mnyam nyid ye shes bshad pa/ sor rtog ye shes bshad pa/ de gnyis longs skur bshad pa/ bya grub ye shes sprul skur bshad pa/ chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid skur bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dag bya dag byed/ dag 'bras sku ye bshad pa'o/ / dang po 9ga bya dag byed )ni/phyi dnganang gi bdag nyid na/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 7kunagasto snyimashesa'adi ṣkani//spang bya kun rtsab ste//rdo rje lta bu'i tingawon gyis//bcom parabyabar gsungasapa yin//zhesagasnaḍis te/ bshadamasngi'i pa phyi yul dadngha nang shes pa kund+ra gyi rnodag nyid kyi sngin gaX rnaX par shes pa 'dā nyad gaḍing 'and thams cad kya ga'am / ba ma ṭwāṃg ༷ dngas dzodu sadros sdosashaṃ palasgrab rdzur dzñod gās na spang bya kunā gya rtsa byā byin ta/ 'daspangabyadame kyakyinyanapaXrsha'ajag na pa'abasamagatanagyaṭwāṃ ltaca smas/ nyan rang bdāg da rtaXs pa' 'iswā rab ma// sdig pasatram̐ nga spang nus te/ sa batram̐ rgyus gya tha mar rda rje lta bu' tang nge 'an gyas bcam par bya bar garna/nga// pa ya// na// pa/saganyas pa dag 'bras sku ye bshad pa na /gangatshe sgribabacasakunaganilog/de tshe me long ye shesate//ye shesakunasnang bayir med//yongagasu ma ma/ rtag tu ldan//mishesabyartogasang der phyogasan//ye shesakun gyi rgyu maphywa phyir//chosakyitpa zhesabarjodaya yin//

76 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs te/ gang gi tshe ci la'ang ma chags shing gang du'ang thogs pa med pas sgrib pa phra zhing phra ba'i gnyen por gyur pa rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa'i kun gzhi rnam par bcom nas kun gzhi de log pa de'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi me long lta bu'i ye shes su 'gyur ba yin te/ sgra don kyang / dper na me long g.ya' dag pa la brten nas gzugs brnyan 'byung du rung ba bzhin du me long lta bu'i ye shes las kyang ye shes gzhan gsum dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du 'char ba'i phyir te/ rgyan las/ ye shes gzugs brnyan 'byung phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes de la ni ye shes gzhan kun dang shes bya thams cad snang yang ngar 'dzin med pa dang /rgya yongs su ma chad pas dus rtag tu ldan pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad dang bral zhing shes bya thams cad la ma rmongs pas don gyis gtad pa'i rnam par ma gtad pa/ mi shes pa med pas shes bya thams cad rtogs shing / de la kha phyir phyogs pas 'dzin pa'ang min te/ rgyan las/me long ye shes nga yir med/ /yongs su ma chad rtag tu ldan/ /shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa/ /rtag tu de la mngon phyogs min/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang ma dag pa'i gnas skabs na kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi yid ces gzhan gyi rten byed pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi sar me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis ye shes gzhan gsum gyi rten byed pa yin te/ rgyan las/

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 77me long ye shes mi g.yo ste/ /ye shes gsum ni de la brten/ / mnyam pa nyid dang so sor rtog /bya ba grub pa kho na 'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na ye shes gsum po kun gyi rgyu'i mtshan nyid yin pa'i phyir dang / ye shes gzhan gsum dang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku skyed pa'i phyir/ye shes kun gyi rgyu mtshan phyir/ /ye shes 'byung gnas chen po 'dra/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces rgyan las gsungs pa yin no/ /de la me long lta bu'i ye shes 'di la ni chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang theg bsdus las/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnam par dag pa ni kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa gnas gyur nas chos kyi sku 'thob pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pa dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las kyang /kun gzhi me long ye shes te/ /de ni chos kyi sku yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de la chos kyi sku ni sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes mthar thug pa spros pa thams cad zhi zhing snang ba med pa'i ye shes mchog thob pa dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa yin te/ ye shes snang ba rgyan gyi mdo las/

78 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ye shes dam pa bdag med pa/ /snang ba med de mi gzigs so/ /zhes ganda/ngas pa dang /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin/ /ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid/ /so sor rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ltamanyam nyid ye shes )la'ang gnyis/ dag bya dag byed/ dag 'bras ye shes bshad pa'o/ /dang po 9ga bya dag byed )ni/nyon mongasacan miyid de ni/ /dpa'abar 'gro bsarab bcomanas/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes la dmigs nas rtag tu ngar btags pa'i rnam pas 'jug pas/ bdag tu lta ba/ bdag tu rmongs pa/ bdag la chags pa/bdag tu nga rgyal ba ste nyon mongs bzhi dang rtag tu mtshungs par ldan pas ngo bo thar pa thob pa la sgrib cing lung du ma bstan pa'i mtshan nyid can nyon mongs pa can gyi yid du grags pa de ni/ nyon mongs pas nam yang 'phrog par mi nus pa'i phyir seng

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 79ge lta bur dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya bas rab tu bcom nas 'khrul ba'i dri ma ldang ba med par gyur pa las mnyam nyid ye shes 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /de'i sgra don ni/ slob lam du bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du sgom pas sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshe srid zhi mnyam pa nyid du mkhyen pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa (dig 'bras ye shes bshad pa )ni/masgyu1nga lha/ma rteton sgru1ngatha'irab snyungatha(nas/ /nyon mongaba'imed cibalhad zhi med/ /mnyam snyed ye shesazhesasu brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ kha phyir lta ba'i rags pa kun btags kyi nyon mongs ni mthong lam gyis spangs shing / kha nang du lta ba'i phra ba lhan skyes kyi nyon mongs pa ni sgom lam gyis spangs pas nyon mongs pa med cing / lam gyi dus na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgom pa dag pa dang / 'bor 'das gang gi yang phyogs su ma lhung ba'i srid zhi gnyis la mi gnas pa'i zhi ba bsgoms pas/ sangs rgyas kyi sar srid zhi med cing mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thob pas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes zhes brjod pa yin te/ rgyan las/lha/ma pa dag pas sems can la/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes 'dod/ /mi gnas zhi bar bsdokyigs pa yang / /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /

80 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs so/ /skabs 'di'i mthong sgom gyi spang bya la dbye na mthong spang ni kun btags kyi nyon mongs te 'jig lta/ mthar lta/ log lta/ lta ba mchog 'dzin/tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba ste lnga dang / 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig pa/ the tshom lnga ste bcus sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung / 'gog pa dang lam ste bden pa bzhir log par zhugs pas 'dod khams na bzhi bcu/khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro med pas dgu bzhi so drug pa tshan gnyis te de kun bsdoms pas brgya dang bcu gnyis dang / sgom spang ni lhan skyes kyi nyon mongs 'dod chags/ khong khro/ nga rgyal/ ma rig 'jig lta/ mthar lta dang drug 'dod khams na yod cing / khams gong ma gnyis na khong khro spangs pas lnga re ste/ de'ang bsam gtan bzhi dang gzugs med bzhir dbye bas gong ma brgyad la brgyad lnga bzhi bcu/ 'dod khams kyi drug bsnan pas zhe drug de re re yang chung ngu'i chung ngu nas chen po'i chen po bar dgus bsgyur bas bzhi brgya dang bcu bzhir bshad de zhib par gzhung gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa (sor rtog ye shes )la gnyis/ dag bya dag byed/ dag 'bras ye shes bshad pa'o/ / dang po 6ga bya dag byed )ni/de ma thagapa'i yid de ni/ /drug bo 'dzin paga'adzin pa rte/ /rnam parartog byed rnamartog yin/ /deni sprung dag shesarabadab/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 81sku ma lta bu'irtang 'dzin gyis/ /bcom pas / /zhes gsungs te/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug po skye 'gag byed pa'i gnas de ma thag pa'i yid bya ba de ni tshogs drug bskyed cing des 'dzin pas 'dzin pa zhes bya ba ste/ des rnam par rtog pa bskyed pas na ming du rnam rtog ces bya ba'ang yin te/ gang ltar na yang rnam par rtog pa de ni/ chos thams cad mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong pa dang bdag med par rtogs pa yang dag pa'i shes rab dang /yul dang sems kyi kun tu btags pa thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bcom pas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes su 'gyur ro/ /de'i sgra don ni/shes bya ji snyed pa de snyed so sor skad cig gis ma 'dres par thogs pa med par mkhyen pa'i ye shes te/ rgyan las/so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ /shes bya kun la rtag mi thogs/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa (dig 'bras ye shes bshad pa )ni/bsgod pa che thob tshe/ /donahā sa'adzin pa gnasagyurawās/ / zhingani dag paston pa dang / /dusarnamasakunasgyu ye shesadang / /

82 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/lasarnamasakun tu thogasamed pa'i/ /rnamartog gnasayongs kha pa ni/ /sosor rtog pardziye shesate/ /zhes gsungs te/ sa brgyad pa'i skabs su mi skye ba'i chos rnams la bzod pa chen po thob pa de'i tshe nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas gyur pas rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la dbang thob pa yin te/ rgyan las/yid ni gzhan du gyur pa ni/ /'byor dang mthun phyogs mi rtog pa'i/ / ye shes shin tu dri med la/ /'byor pa dam pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang brgyad pa der don dang bcas pa'i 'dzin pa gnas gyur pas/ rang nyid zhing khams rnam par dag pa la dbang 'byor pas gdul bya gzhan la yang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin bde ba can mngon dga' sogs dang mtshungs pa'i zhing dag pa'i longs spyod rnams ston pa la dbang 'byor thob pa yin te/ yang rgyan 95rbasdo/don bcas 'dzin pa gnas gyur na/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams/ /bstan phyir zhing ni dag pa la/ /'byor pa dam pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 83zhes gsungs so/ /yang sa brgyad pa der rtog pa yid shes gnas gyur pas sa dgu par 'das ma 'ongs da lta'i dus rnams kun tu ye shes chags thogs med par 'jug pa la dbang ba dang / sa bcu par gang la gang 'dul gyi phrin las sna tshogs pa rnams gdul bya kun la thogs pa med par 'jug pa la dbang ba ste/ rgyan las/rnam rtog gzhan du gyur pa'i phyir/ /dus rnams kun tu ye shes dang / /las rnams kun tu thogs med pa'i/ /'byor pa dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de thams cad dag pa sa gsum du tshang bar 'byung ba'ang rgyan 95rngaṭa yid dang 'dzin dang rnam par rtog /'gyur phyir rnam par mi rtog dang / /zhing dang ye shes las dag pa/ /dbang de rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /dbang de mi g.yo la sogs kyi/ /sa gsum la ni rnam bzhi ste/ /gcig las rnam gnyis de las gzhan/ /dbang ni re rer 'dod pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i rnam par rtog pa gnas yongs su gyur pa mthar thug

84 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/pa ni snangs shās sdi saX so sor rtog pa'i yesdo sa zhes bya ba de bzhin yin no//ba pa gnyas langs skur rnga'igad pa na/de ltarawe shegaganyisapo 'di//ktomapadasnapasasridanil//gnaṅgi dang kṣiṃkṣiṃ dang//thu/star ldan rnyasarnamasal//rmi kṣiṃsku dbakaung kyin dzñod//rta〉pa dbyanga'( dal // 'byuṇa // 'dzin gzungasarnamasakun gter//longagaspyod rdzogasasku zhesasubarjod //hūm̐rji gsudzo teo/ tram̐ ༈ra spyod spra thag pa'i mnyam pa ṣṭṛkyi dang snro ༷ra ktog ṅgi'i byishasaganyasapa'adakro/zhilaspra gya skazlos su rnama'i parda ma rtagazlo ༷ tang 'an sgam pa dag pa dang ste/srad gnyaswā la'i kand+ras rdoX glukyi ṭwāṃb kya sgam pa'i rnam paḍi dgapalardzu tram̐ng ༵ ོ/ṭwāṃnyam pa nyad kya ya shās 'a nga rjo nd+ra/ོmthaX gnyas la ma gnas ༵'a zha ba na pa ngang du bzhugs pa ༵na ༷sa/ 'a graghrasdu na nd+ras thams rshad du tram̐s can sams cad la byams pa na pa dang thukyis rja rsha padang ldan tshong / sngid las na gasnil bya rnamardzu la rang rang snging ltar mas pa ban rnam pa sna gas pa' sangs rgyas kya sprul sku stan par mdzad da/rgyan las/dus rnatrī~X kuspya tu byams pa dang //thugs na pa dag dang ldan//

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 85sems can rnams la 51sa pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas sku ni nges par ston/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sor rtog ye shes kyi ngo bo ni/ shes bya ji snyed pa ma lus shing ma 'dres par rtogs pa yin la/ byed las ni 'bor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ci 'dod pa'i 'byor ba ston pa dang / the tshom thams cad gcod par byed pa'i phyir gsung chos ston pa ste/ de yang theg pa chen po'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs chen po'i char ba 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su 'byung zhing 'bebs par mdzad pa yin te/ rgyan las/'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ni/ /'byor ba thams cad ston mdzad cing / / the tshom thams cad gcod pa'i phyir/ /chos kyi char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'bras bu ni ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs kyi sgo dpag tu med pa rnams dang rang nyid ldan zhing gzhan la'ang skyed par byed pas de rnams kun gyi gter chen po ltar gyur pa yin te/ rgyan las/ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams kyi/ /gter dang 'dra ba kho na'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i phyir mnyam nyid dang sor rtog ye shes gnyis po ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi longs spyod yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku zhes

86 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/su brjod pa yin no/ /de la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni nges pa lnga dang ldan pa yin te/ gnas nges pa 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams na bzhugs pa/'khor nges pa sar gnas kyi byang sems kyis bskor ba dang / sku nges pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan cing / chos nges pa theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig ston pa/ dus nges pa 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bzhugs pa yin te/ rgyan las/longs spyod rdzogs pa khams gsum du/ /'khor yongs sdud dang zhing dang mtshan/ /sku dang chos rdzogs longs spyod dang / /mdzad pa dag ni tha dad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lnga pa (bya grub ye shes sprul skur bshad pa )la gnyis/ dag bya dag byed/ dag 'bras sku ye bshad pa'o/ /dang po 6ga bya dag byed )ni/sgo lnga yid kyi cha gcigani/ /yathadag kun rtog lasaskyesapa/ /bden bzhi'i tshul gyi rnam pa can/ /shesabazod la sogasabastodrug gis/ /don mthothabaden par rtogasapa las/ / zhes gsungs te/ mig sogs dbang po sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa dang / drug pa yid

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 87kyi cha gcig ste sgo lnga'i shes pa kha phyir phyogs pa'i cha gcig bcas/ sbyor lam gyi yang dag pa'i kun tu rtog pa las skyes pa'i mthong ba'i lam gyis spong bar byed pa ste/ mthong lam de'ang sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang / lam gyi bden pa ste/ bden bzhi'i tshul gyis yod pa'i bden pa kun re re la'ang chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang / chos shes pa dang / rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang /rjes su shes pa ste/ ye shes bzhi bzhi'i rnam pa can du yod la/ de'ang chos shes pa'i bzod pa ni sdug bsngal bden pa'i chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i zagagyi med kyi ye shes des sdug bsngal mthong spang gang yin sbong bar byed do/ /la sogs pa'i khongs nas sdug bsngal la chos kyi shes pa ni bzod pa de'i mjug thog tu rnam par grol ba ste sdug bsngal mi skye ba'i shes pa mngon du byed do/ /sdug bsngal la rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa ni ye shes snga ma de gnyis 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyu'o zhes rang la mngon sum du gyur pa'i zag med kyi shes rab bo/ /sdug bsngal rjes shes ni snga ma rjes bzod de nyid rtogs shing 'dzin par byed pa'i shes rab yin no/ /kun 'byung sogs gsum la'ang de ltar 'gre sbyar ba'i ye shes bcu drug tu 'gyur ba dag gis chos nyid kyi don sngar ma mthong ba mngon sum gsar du mthong zhing don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs pa las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su 'gyur ro/ /de'i sgra don ni/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med par thabs sna tshogs pa 'bad rtsol med pas sems can gyi don bya ba lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa (dig 'bras sku ye bshad pa )ni/dbang po lnga rnamasaganasagyur ni/ /don kun 'jugadang thamasacad kyi/ /

88 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/yon tan bakṣiṃphrag bsaganyisal/ /dbang 'gyor de nyid mthar phyin pas/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shesate/ /khamasarnamagakun tu sna tshogasapa'i/ /dpab/med bsam yathabasgrul pa yis/ /semasacan kun don sgrub pa'o/ /'di ni sprul pa'i sku chen po/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar mthong lam du bden pa rtogs shing sa dang po thob pa de'i tshe mig sogs kyi dbang po lnga rnam par shes pa'i 'khrul ba rnams dag cing gnas gyur nas ni/ dbang po re res kyang gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste don lnga la 'jug pas don kun la dbang po re re bzhin 'jug pa dang / sa'i yon tan thams cad kyi thog mar gyur pa rab tu dga' ba la gnas pa'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la dbang 'byor ba yin te/ de yang sa dang po der dus skad cig ma gcig la sangs rgyas brgya'i zhal la lta ba dang / sangs rgyas brgya la chos nyan pa dang / sprul pa brgya 'gyed pa dang / dus bskal pa brgyar ston pa dang / sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' brgyar ye shes 'jug pa dang / ting nge 'dzin brgya la snyoms par 'jug pa dang / de tsam brgya las ldang ba dang / zhing brgya g.yo bar byed pa dang / zhing brgya 'od kyis gsal bar byed pa dang / chos kyi sgo mo brgya 'byed pa dang / rang gi lus brgyar ston pa dang / lus re re la yang 'khor phun sum tshogs pa brgya brgyas bskor ba ston pa la dbang 'byor ba yin te/ rgyan las/

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 89dbang po lnga rnams gnas gyur na/ /don kun 'jug dang thams cad kyi/ /yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung / /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang sa gnyis pa la yon tan stong phrag bcu gnyis/ sa gsum pa la 'bum phrag bcu gnyis/ sa bzhi pa la bye ba phrag bcu gnyis/ sa lnga pa la bye ba phrag brgya bcu gnyis/ sa drug pa la bye ba stong phrag bcu gnyis/ sa bdun pa la bye ba 'bum phrag bcu gnyis/ sa brgyad pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa bcu gnyis/ sa dgu pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa bcu gnyis/ sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med bye ba phrag bcu'i rdul grangs dang mnyam pa bcu gnyis kyis sngar bzhin sangs rgyas kyi zhal lta ba la sogs pa la dbang 'byor bar 'gyur zhes mdo sde sa bcu pa las gsungs pa'ang zhar las shes par bya'o/ /dbang 'byor ba de nyid mthar phyin pas sangs rgyas kyi sar bya ba grub pa'i ye shes bya ba yin te/ ye shes de'i byed las ni 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu sprul pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa bsam du med pa mtha' yas pa sprul pas sems can kun gyi don bsgrub pa'o/ /de ltar yin par yang rgyan las/bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ /khams rnams kun tu sna tshogs shing / /dpag med bsam yas sprul pa yis/ /sems can kun don sgrub pa'o/ /

90 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs so/ /de lta bu'i bya ba grub pa'i ye shes 'di ni sku gsum gyi nang nas sprul pa'i sku chen po rnams yin no/ /de la sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku ni mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs kyis gzhan don mdzad pa yin te/ dbye na mchog gi sprul pa mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa thub pa lta bu dang / bzo'i sprul pa dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul ba la glu dbyangs mkhas par sprul pa lta bu dang / skye ba'i sprul pa ri dwags ru rur sprul pa lta bu yin te/ rgyan las/bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /mya ngan 'das pa rtag ston pa/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku 'di ni/ /rnam par grol ba'i thabs chen po/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar sems yid rnam shes dag pa las sku gsum du 'gyur ba'i tshul yang / mdo sde gser 'od dam pa las/ kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa spangs pas chos kyi sku ston no/ /de la gnas pa'i yid dag pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ston no/ /dngos po la 'jug pa'i rnam par shes pa dag pas sprul pa'i sku ston no zhes gsungs so/ /drug pa (dros dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid skur bshad pa )la gnyis/ dngos dang /sku'i mtha' dpyad pa'o/ /dang po 9ngos bshad pa )ni/semasayid rnam shesaganasagyuraspu'i/ /sku gsum mdzad parabacasaparnams/ /

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 91chosadabyingasasprosabral dkyildo'akhor du/ /rdzogasapa 'khor 'dasathogamed kun/ /gcig dang tha dad bralab rtswa /bzhugasapa ngo bo nyid skur bzhed/ /ces gsungs te/ sems kun gzhi dang / yid nyon yid dang / rnam par shes pa tshogs drug po rnams dri ma bral zhing gnas yongs su gyur pa'i sku gsum mdzad pa phrin las dang bcas pa rnams ni/ chos thams cad kyi dbyings gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa kun dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbyer med gcig tu rdzogs pa dang /'khor ba dang myang 'das su gdags pa med cing rigs dang don tha dad med pa dang / thog ma dang mtha' ma med pa dang / gcig pa dang tha dad ma yin pa dang /rnam pa de dag gi mtshan ma'i spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ru bzhugs pa ni/chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes dang ngo bo nyid kyi skur bzhed pa yin te/ rgyan las/tha dad rig don med phyir dang / /rdzogs pa thog ma med phyir dang / /sangs rgyas gcig yin dri med gnas/ /tha dad min phyir gcig pa'ang min/ /zhes bya bas bstan par bzhed do/ /ye shes de'i sgra don ni/ sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las grol te nam mkha' dag pa dang 'dra bar chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa de bzhin nyid las 'phags pa'i chos dang ye shes rnams 'byung ba'i gnas su gyur pa

92 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ste/mdo las/ṭwāṃs rnaṭīs kun gyi de babyenast+rid//ba gnyas ldan dag man nyad can//zhes sdigs gaḍidzo so// )muganyas pa sku' mtha' dpyad pa na/kau bzlozlogaḍā khacigasgyu//rdotshe la longaye sna bstan///rigazu sasku/nyi/sazhesabarjob/po/rten ba/ba /glugan da//sbyasagaḍings te/rgyal ba thasdus ༷ matram̐n snas theg pa chespya po'i gzhung ktakroṭwāṃ ༷ ོga tu na da ltar spyod rdzu ༷da la chasdu sngi sdi gu kaund+ra pa yad pasdu/da ḍi na gaḍi du bstan pa ltaṭwāṃ ma rdzungardzubu'ayahūṃsdiXnyadasku'amaya sas kya skur gurjad la/ ṭwāṃnyam nyasnga ༷ rtag bya grub rdzu kās kāzhan gsum na kribyāgs sku langs sprul rdzunyaswā su brjad da/ོ/skabs 'dar ga'i na kasung rab spya' lugs su rang daṭwāṃ chas sta skud dang tiṭwāṃ dan gzugs sku gnyas ta sangs rgyas sku gsum du grangs sa pa yan ta/mad rgyan las/sku gsum dag sdiX sangalha rgyas kyi//sku bsdus par na shas bya //

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 93sku gsum dag gis rang gzhan gyi/ /don 'dir rten dang bcas par bstan/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhung kha cig tu ngo bo nyid skur gsungs pa nyid chos sku dang don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su bzhed pa'ang yod de/ theg bsdus las/ de la ngo bo nyid kyi sku ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos kyi sku ste chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba'i gnas yin pa'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /yang de gnyis dbyings dang ye shes kyi ldog pas phye ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang / de rtogs pa yon to gyi sde tshan nyi shu rtsa gcig ni rtogs pa chos sku zhes dbye zhing de dag ngo bo ni gcig tu 'du ste/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ /zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag /thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mdor na dag pa gnyis ldan gyi cha ngo bo nyid sku dang / ye shes mthar thug pa'i cha chos kyi skur phye ba yin pas sku gsum du 'du zhing / der ma zad rang don don dam chos kyi sku dang gzhan don kun rdzob gzugs kyi sku ste gnyis dang / khyab byed chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i chos gzhan med pa'i phyir ldog pa la dbye na

94 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/tha dad kyang ngo bo la dbye ba byar med pa la dgongs te/sangs rgyas rnams ni chos nyid lta/ /'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku/ /zhes gsungs pas chos sku gcig pur yang 'du ba sogs dbye bsdu mang du gsungs pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsum gcig gam tha dad snyam na/ nam mkha' dang nam mkha'i rang bzhin la dbye ba byar med pa bzhin du/ zag pa med pa'i dbyings la sangs rgyas rnams tha dad med la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sngon gyi sems can re res byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa las byung bas gcig pa yang ma yin te/ rgyan las/zag med dbyings la sangs rgyas rnams/ /mkha' ltar lus ni med pa dang / /sngon gyi lus rjes 'brangs pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas gcig min mang po'ang min/ /zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos sku dang longs sku ni gcig yin la/ sprul skus 'gro don mdzad tshul sngon gyi smon lam gyi rjes su 'gro bas tha dad par bzhed pa'ang snang ngo / /sangs rgyas sku gsum po de'i sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing rtsol ba dang rtog pa mi mnga' bar 'jig rten gyi khams ji srid bar gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun par lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa shar yang de thams cad kyi byed las

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 95ni 'dam rdzab skam/ mun pa sel/ myu gu smin par byed pa yin pa ltar/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las kyis kyang 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab skam/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel/ byang chub kyi myu gu smin par byed pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las gcig tu 'jug pa dang / gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa na sangs rgyas kyi phrin las dus las yol ba med cing phrin las de'ang gang la gang 'dul gyi tshul du 'byung ba dang / sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las la zad pa mi mnga' zhing sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa rgya che la nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba yin te/ de dag gi tshul rgyas pa mdo sde rgyan dang rgyud bla ma sogs las shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa de dag gi don mdor bsdu ba ni/ye shesalnga dngasku bzhi yi/ /rangabazhin mngon gyur sangasargyasate/ /semasayid rnam par shesapa yi/ /drimar ldan gathakunagazhi yin/ /dri med rgyal ba'i snying por brjod/ /ma dgakunartog 'jomasabyed pa/ /dag pa'i kun rtog 'dzigaskyetha'ipa'i/ /'phagasapa'i shesarab dbangaboni/ /'dzinaya lam gyi bden paragasungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong du ji skad bshad pa de dag gi don mdor bsdu na/ sems

96 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/can thams cad kun btags gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul ba glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral nas/ gdod nas rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa'i ye shes lnga dang sku bzhi yi rang bzhin 'gyur ba med par mngon du gyur pa la sangs rgyas zhes bya ba yin te/rgyud las/sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de bsal na ni sangs rgyas so/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/gang zhig 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ / de nyid sbyang bar byas pa las/ /dag pa de nyid mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi sku yang de nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzung 'dzin du snang ba'i sems dang nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang rnam par shes pa'i tshogs drug gi dri ma dang ldan pa'i kun gzhi gang yin pa de ni 'brul ba'i rtsa ba dri ma dang bcas pa'i kun gzhi'am kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba yin la/ tshogs brgyad po de dag gi dri ma dang ldan bzhin du rang gi ngo bo dri ma med pa'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa la ni rgyal ba ste sangs rgyas kyi snying por brjod cing / de nyid gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kun tu 'gyur ba med par bzhugs pa ste/ thre/da bla ma las/

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 97nyes pa glo bur dang ldan phyir/ /yon tan rang bzhin nyid ldan phyir/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi snying po de la sgrib par byed pa ni ma dag pa'i kun tu rtog pa ste/ de'ang 'phags pa klus/dri med nyi ma zla ba yang / /sprin dang du ba khug rna dang / /sgra gcan gdong dang rdul la sogs/ /sgrib pa lnga yis bsgrib par 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'od gsal ba yi sems/ /'dod dang gnod sems le lo dang / /rgod pa dang ni the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga yis bsgribs par gyur/ /ces ganda/ngas pa dang / rgyal ba byams pas/chos la khong khro bdag lta dang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs dang / /sems can don la ltos med nyid/ /

98 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'dod chen mu stegs nyan thos dang / /rang byung rnams kyi sgrib rnam bzhi/ /zhes 'jig rten pa'i skye bo/ mu stegs/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal bzhi'i rgyud la yod pa ma dag pa'i sgrib rtog rnam pa bzhi ste/ de rnams 'joms par byed pa'i gnyen po'ang / dag rgyu lhag par mos pa la/ /sogs pa'i chos ni rnam pa bzhi/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ yang dag pa'i kun tu rtog pa las skyes pa'i theg pa chen po la mos shing dad pa'i sa bon bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis bsam gtan ting nge 'dzin gyi mngal snying rje chen po skyed bsring pa'i ma ma lta bu rnams dang ldan pa las lam zhugs rgyal ba'i sras por gyur cing rim gyis lam gong nas gong du 'phags pa'i shes rab kyi dbang po 'dzin pa ni lam gyi bden par gsungs so/ /'di skabs yang dag pa'i kun tu rtog pa las skyes pa ni 'phags yul shes rab kyi dbang po ste/ de nyid 'dzin pa'i don can lam gyi bden par gsungs pa yin no zhes bzhed pa ltar na/ dharma'i sgra don dgu la 'jug cing thams cad 'dzin pa'i don can du 'gyur ba las 'dir lam gyi chos la sbyor ba'i tshe theg chen lam gyis mtha' gnyis su lhung ba las 'dzin pa'i don du bshad pa thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog yan lag gi bzhed pa yin cing / yang na/ mos spyod kyis tshogs lam na spang bya'i 'dzin pa dang / sbyor lam na gnyen po'i 'dzin pa dang / ma dag pa'i sa rnams su spang gnyen gnyis med kyi 'dzin pa dang / dag pa sa gsum na sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu'i 'dzin pa yod pas lam bden du gsungs zhes slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po'i khrid rgyun du byung ngo / /de dag gi don mdor bsdu na/

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 99chos nyid bde gshegs snying po la glo bur 'khrul ba'i dri ma sems yid rnam shes gsum gyis bsgribs pa sems can/ dri ma de nyid gnyen pos sbyong bas brtson pa lam zhugs kyi gang zag dri ma'i sbubs las rnam par grol te gdod nas bzhugs pa'i sku dang ye shes mngon du gyur pa ni sangs rgyas zhes pa ste/ rgyud bla ma las/ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa mjug gi don la gsum/ gzhung 'di bshad pa'i dgos pa/de nyid rtogs par smon pa/ gzhung mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa'o/ /dang po (gzhung 'di bshad pa'i dgos pa )ni/don dam tshul 'dimartogasapas/ /rmongasarnamasa'akhoraba'igyomatshor 'khyams/ /theg chenagru 'dimartogasapas/ /gangagisapha rol phyin par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'khrul ba glo bur ba'i dri mas bsgribs pa'i byis pa dang / so so'i skye bo dang / theg pa dman pa la zhugs pa rnams kyis gnas lugs don dam pa'i tshul theg pa chen po zab cing rgya che ba'i gzhung rnams las gsal bar bstan

100 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/pa/ rnam shes 'khor ba'i chos dang / ye shes myang 'das kyi rang bzhin 'di lta bu ma rtogs pas/ ngar 'dzin pa dang / nga yir 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i ma rig pa'i sgrib pas rmongs pa rnams thog ma med pa nas 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por las kyi rlung shugs drag pos bdas nas rang dbang med par 'khyams par gyur to/ /de las thar bar 'dod pa'i blo gros can rnams theg dman las che ba bdun gyis 'phags pa'i theg pa chen po'i gru bo che 'di la brten pa ma gtogs/thabs gzhan gang gis sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho de'i pha rol tu phyin par 'gyur te phyin par mi nus so/ /des na mi gnas pa'itshomyang 'das chen po thob par 'dod pa rnams kyis theg pa chen po'i tshul 'di rtogs pa kho na gal che ba ste/ sdud pa las/theg pa 'di ni mkha' 'dra gzhal med khang chen te/ /dga' skyid bde ba mngon par 'thob byed theg pa'i mchog /de gang zhon nas sems can thams cad mya ngan zlo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa (di nyid rtogs par smon pa )ni/kun gyisa'adi don rtogasapar shog /ces gsungs te/ thog ma med pa nas pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro ba spyi dang / khyad par skal ldan gdul byar gyur pa kun gyis rnam shes dang ye shes rnam par dbye ba'i theg pa chen po'i snying po bsdus pa'i chos kyi tshul 'di thog mar thos pa'i shes rab kyis go bar du bsam pas nyams su myong / mthar bsgom pas gnas lugs ji

rnam shes ye shes 'byed pa'i tshig don rang byung dgongs rgyan/ 101bzhin du rtogs te 'khor 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa'i byang chub chen po mngon du thob par shog cig ces pa'o/ /gsum pa (gzhung mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa )ni/rnam shesaye shesa'abyed pa'i bstan bcos/ phag lo zla ba bstopa'i tshesagacig la rang byung rdo rjesabade chen steng gi ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'khrul bcas 'khor ba'i chos 'byung ba'i gzhi sems can la yod pa'i rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad dang / 'khrul bral mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas la snang ba'i ye shes kyi tshul rnam par 'byed pa ste don tshul bzhin du gsal bar byed pa'i bstan bcos dri ma med pa 'di nyid/ rab byung drug pa'i nang tshan phag lo zla ba bcu pa'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes gcig la/ thabs dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje las rang byung ba/ shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje srid zhi'i 'ching ba mtha' dag grol bar mdzad pa des/ mkha' spyod thugs kyi 'khor lo mtshur phu bde chen steng zhes bya ba 'du 'dzis dben pa'i ri khrod du go sla don bsdus pa'i tshul du legs par sbyar ba'o zhes so/ /gzhung 'di la rang byung zhabs kyi sa bcad/ de sras shes rab rin chen rgyas 'grel/ zhwa dmar lnga pas de don bsdus pa'i mchan bu/ mkhas dbang lha lung pas rang stobs rnam dpyod kyi mchan ṭīka sogs mchis na'ang rang byung rgyal ba'i gsung sgros nyid gces par bzung ste rgyas bshad du ma spros par go sla don gsal gyis 'grel chung du dris pa'o/ /gsung rab kun las med byung ba/ /theg pa chen po'i yang bcud ni/ /

102 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/nyung ngu'i tshig gis rgya che'i don/ / rgyal ba gnyis pas gsal bar mdzad/ /de don zab cing rgya che bas/ /bdag blos ji bzhin dpog min yang / /phyogs tsam lta ba'i blo yi mig /skal mnyam gzhan la thob phyir bris/ /rnam shes 'khrul ba'i sbubs las grol/ /sku dang ye shes snang ba rgyas/ /rtag cing khyab pa'i phrin las kyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don byed shog /rang byung zhabs kyi gzhung che chung gsum la da lta'i bar rtsa ba'i lung dang bshad rgyun bar ma chad par bzhugs pas/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba gnyis pa de'i gsung rab la zhabs tog kho nar dmigs te mkhas pa'i khyad grags 'dod 'gran phyir ma yin par bshad rgyun rnam dag ma chad tsam byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas bslangs te/ mang thos dge spyong gi gzugs brnyan karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am blo gros mtha' yas kyis dpal spungs yang dben kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //

de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa'i bstan bcos/༄༅/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thog med gyur kyang mtha' ma dang ldan pa/ /rang bzhin gyis dag rtag pa'i chos can ni/ /thog med sbubs kyis bsgribs phyir mi mthong ste/ /dper na gser gyi gzugs ni bsgribs pa bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /thog ma med pa'i dus kyi khams/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de yod pas na 'gro kun dang / /mya ngan 'das pa'ang thob pa yin/ /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas sgrib/ /de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas so/ /zhes pa rgyud lung ngo / /de la thog med ces bya ba/ /de bas sngon na med pa nyid/ /dus ni skad cig de nyid de/ /gzhan nas brgyud de 'ongs pa min/ /khams ni byed po med kyang ni/ /rang mtshan 'dzin pas de skad brjod/ /chos ni 'khor dang mya ngan 'das/ /gnyis su snang la bshad pa ste/ /ma rig bag chags sa zhes bya/ /yang dag rtog dang yang dag min/ /'du byed g.yo ba bskyed rgyu yin/ /rgyu yi rkyen te kun gzhir bshad/ /gnas ni rgyal ba'i snying po ste/ /yang dag ma yin kun rtog ni/ /sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas/ /dag pa de nyid da ltar yod/ /yod kyang ma rig kun rtog gis/ /ma mthong phyir na 'khor ba yin/ /de nyid bsal na mya ngan 'das/ /de la mtha' ma'i tha snyad byas/ /thog mtha' kun rtog nyid la brten/ /'du byed rlung dang 'dra ba yis/ /las dang nyon mongs bsgrub pa ste/ /de yis phung po khams skye mched/ /gnyis snang chos kun ston pa yin/ /de la blang dor byed mkhan 'khrul/ /rang snang dor bas gang du 'gag /

104 rgyal dbang karma pa rang byung rdo rje/rang snang blangs pas ci zhig 'byung / /gnyis 'dzin rdzun pa ma yin nam/ /de shes gnyen por gsungs mod kyang / /gnyis med rtogs de bden pa min/ /rtog med rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /gzugs sogs cha phyes stong rtogs pa/ /khyod rang zhakhrul ba ma yin nam/ /'on kyang bden zhen bkag phyir gsungs/ /thams cad bden min rdzun min te/ /chu zla bzhin du mkhas rnams 'dod/ /tha mal shes pa de nyid la/ /chos dbyings rgyal ba'i snying po zer/ /bzang du 'phags pas btang ba med/ /ngan du sems can gyis ma btang / /tha snyad du ma brjod mod kyang / /brjod pas de yi don mi shes/ /de nyid ma 'gag rol pa la/ /yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi po/ /rags pa yin te re re la'ang / /bye ba phrag rer gsungs pa yin/ /gnas dang gnas min las shes dang / /rnam smin khams dang dbang po dang / /mos pa mkhyen dang kun 'gro ba'i/ /lam dang bsam gtan lha yi mig /gnas rjes dran dang zhi ba ni/ /stobs bcu'o de brten mi 'jigs bzhi/ /chos kun byang chub gnas ston dang / /lam dang 'gog ston rtsod med nyid/ /rgyu des ma 'brul ca co med/ /dran pa ma nyams rtag mnyam bzhag /'du shes sna tshogs mi mnga' dang / /ma brtags btang snyoms med pa dang / /'dun pa brtson 'grus dran pa dang / /ting 'dzin shes rab rnam grol gyi/ /ye shes mthong ba mi nyams pa/ /las rnams ye shes sngon 'gro dang / /dus la sgrib med bco brgyad de/ /so gnyis ldan pa chos sku yin/ /da lta de la 'gal bar byed/ /yin la yin bzhin ma nges pas/ /med la yod rtog kun btags byas/ /des bskyed rtog de gzhan dbang yin/ /yongs su grub pa ma shes pas/ /rang gis byas pas gzings pa ste/ /kye ma chos sku'i yon tan 'di/ /bden pa'i rtogs la bden shes yin/ /da lta nus pa chung ba de/ /bden shes bor nas mi

de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa/ 105bden bzos/ /de la rjes 'brang g.yos pas lan/ /da ni yin la yin bzhin du/ /shes kyis de la nus pa thob/ /'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /de la gzugs sku gnyis rang bzhin/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dpe byad/ /thob pa'i yon tan rang lus te/ /lus de bdag dang phyu dbang phyug /tshangs dang phyi rol bden pa'i rdul/ /phag na mo yis byas pa min/ /sgo lnga gzung dang 'dzin pa yi/ /rnam 'gyur ma dag de sbyangs pas/ /de tshe thob par tha snyad byas/ /de bas rtsa rlung thig le rnams/ /dag pa dag pa'i gzugs sku ste/ /ma sbyang ma dag gzugs sku'o/ /dper na shun bcas beeḍūrya/ /de la yon tan mi snang dang / /re ba ba tshwa'i chus sbyong dang / /skyur po lwa bas sbyong ba dang / /chu gtsang kā shi kas sbyangs nas/ /dag de nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung / /de bzhin sems kyi beeḍūrya/ /nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi /shun pa gsum po sbyang ba'i phyir/ /tshogs sbyor ma dag sa bdun dang / /dag pa sa gsum la rab sbyong / /yang dag ma yin kun rtog de/ /dag pa'i kun rtog dang sprad pas/ /shing gnyis tshig bzhin kun rtog bral/ /spangs gnyen de bzhin nyid rtog dang / /'bras bu'i mtshan 'dzin bzhi bral ba/ /de tshe nam mkha'i sku can la/ /mtshan gyi me tog rgyas par 'gyur/ /ma dag ma dag dag pa dang / /shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang / /de bzhin btagags pa'i gnas skabs gsum/ /brjod kyang sangs rgyas gsar skyes min/ /ji ltar snga bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /mi 'gyur sangs rgyas snying po yin/ /'gyur ba dri bral de la brjod/ /

106 rgyal dbang karma pa rang byung rdo rje/gang dag lta ngan zhugs pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas sku1na tan zle/ med dang / /yang na rang min phyi rol gyi/ /rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed rtog pa ni/ /phyi rol rtag chad khyad ci yod/ /'du byed skad cig skye 'gag snang / /ma dag 'du byed dag dang mtshungs/ /gal te de lta ma yin na/ /gzugs sku'i phrin las rgyun chad 'gyur/ /'on kyang 'du byed ming mi brjod/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi/ /'byung ba che sogs rang bzhin gang / /'dzin bcas ngo bo nus ldan ston/ /zhabrul dang ma 'khrul gnyis po yang / /snang bar khyad par ci yang med/ /gnyis 'dzin yod med khyad par yin/ /gal te de lta ma yin na/ /rgyal ba'i phrin las ji ltar 'jug /yid bzhin nor sogs dpe brjod pa/ /rtog pa med pa'i nus ston par/ /bshad kyi gzhan rgyud kho na min/ /yin na gzhan rgyud ye shes 'gyur/ /'dod na ye shes 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /gal te rang snang 'dzin yin zhes/ /'dod na me long snang ba yang / /'dzin pa'i rnam rtog can du 'gyur/ /sems can 'khrul ba ji snyed pa/ /ye shes yul du snang gyur kyang / /ye shes 'khrul bas gos pa min/ /dper na mkha' la 'byung chen rnams/ /skye 'gag snang yang nam mkha' la/ /gos min skye dang 'gag pa med/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes sems can la/ /zhugs kyang de bzhin gos pa med/ /'di la 'khrul ba'i ming mi brjod/ /bya ba grub pa zhes su brjod/ /sgrib gsum dag par gnas pa'i yid/ /mnyam pa nyid de zhi ba'ang yin/ /byams dang thugs rje che ldan pas/ /longs spyod rje'ogs sogs de la snang / /la la sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshe/ /theg dman mtshungs gyur dgag phyir brjod/ /ye shes rtag pa gsum yin te/ /rang bzhin rtag pa chos kyi sku/ /rgyun gyis rtag pa longs spyod rdzogs/ /rgyun mi chad pa sprul sku yin/ /de la mi rtag gsum yod de/ /blo byas stong pa rtag pa min/ /g.yo ba'i rtog yid rtag pa

de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa/ 107min/ /tshogs drug 'dus byas rtag pa min/ /'on kyang de la rtag gsum yod/ /mi rtag gsum po dri ma ste/ /rtag pa gsum po ye shes yin/ /mu stegs bdag dang mtshungs min te/ /yid kyis btags dang ma btags phyir/ /nyan rang zhi dang mtshungs min te/ /gzugs sku'i yon tan kun ston phyir/ /sems can lus dang mtshungs min te / /zag bcas rkyen gyis ma bskyed phyir/ /phyir la ldog par mi 'gyur te/ /yin la yin bzhin mngon gyur phyir/ /dri ma ldang ba gtan med de/ /tha dad kun rtog bral ba'i phyir/ /de phyir sems nyid sangs rgyas 'di/ /da ltar yod kyang ma shes so/ /gang tshe rtogs pa de yi tshe/ /ji ltar lcags la tsha ba dang / /mig la rab rib zhi ba ltar/ /sangs rgyas sems dang ye shes la/ /yod dang med par mi brjod do/ /dam pa'i don du skye med phyir/ /de nyid du ni grol ba'ang med/ /mkha' bzhin sangs rgyas de bzhin te/ /sems can dang ni mtshan nyid gcig /tshu rol pha rol skye med pas/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa'ang med/ /de phyir 'dus byas mngon par stong / /kun mkhyen ye shes spyod yul yin/ /phra phyir thos pa'i yul min la/ /don dam phyir na bsam pa 'i min/ /chos nyid zab phyir 'jig rten pa'i/ /sgom pa la sogs yul ma yin/ /rang rig ye shes spyod yul te/ /rang byung dad pas don dam bskyed/ /kye ma tshul 'di ma rtogs pas/ /byis pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams/ /thub pa chen po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /byams pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /mthu yis rang byung rdo rjes bris/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas snying po 'di/ /mthar phyin ma nor shes par shog /sangs rgyas kyi snying po gtan la dbab pa rdo rje theg pa'i snying po rdzogs so// //

bde gshegs snying po bstan pa'i bstan bcos kyi rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal /༄༅/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor 'das kun gyi snying po mchog /gnas skabs gsum du 'gyur ba med/ /rnam dbyer med pa'i yon tan can/ /chos kyi dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen brtse mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /rang byung rgyal dang de yi sras/ /snying po'i don zab ston rnams la/ /mi phyed dad pa'i yid kyis 'dud/ /thams cad gzigs pa nyag gcig gi /spyod yul rgyal ba'i snying po'i tshul/ /kun mkhyen gnyis pas gsal mdzad pa'i/ /gzhung bzang cung zad dbye bar bya/ /de la rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pas nges don mthar thug pa'i mdo sde dang shin tu zab mo'i rgyud sde rnams su ma sbas gsal bar gsungs shing / sa bcu'i dbang phyu ga

110 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/rgyal tshab ma pham pa dang spyan ras gzigs rbershags grags chen rgyal ba'i sras po rnams dang / grub chen sa ra ha pa yab sras 'phags pa klu sgrub dang thogs med zhabs sogs kyis dgongs pa drang thad du bkral ba/ rtog ge rnam par 'khyams pa dag gi blo'i spyod yul du ma chud pa'i snying po'i don ches zab pa'i tshul de nyid/gangs ri'i ljongs na nges don snying po phyir mi ldog pa'i seng ge'i sgra chen po thog mar sgrog pa'i shing rta pa thub dbang gnyis pa rang byung rdo rjes rgya cher gsal bar mdzad pa las/ de nyid kyi gsung rab kun gyi snying por gyur pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa'i bstan bcos zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la lnga/ mtshan bstan pa/ phyag 'tshal ba/ lung gis mdor bstan pa/ don rgyas par bshad pa/ rnyed tshul gyis mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po (mtshan bstan pa )ni/debazhin gshegasapamisnying po bstan pa zhesabyaba'i bstan26lo/zhes gsungs te/ de zhes pa ni tha snyad gzhan sbyar gyi sgra ste 'dir gnas lugs chos kyi dbyings la sbyar ba'o/ /de nyid ji bzhin du rtogs pa ni gshegs pa'i sgras bstan te don de'i mthar son pa'i phyir ro/ /de nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas sam lus su gyur pas chos kyi skur yang gsungs pa yin la/ de ni dngos po kun gyi de bzhin nyid yin pas snying po'i sgras bstan te/ spyir snying po'i sgra ni mi bslu ba dang /bcud dang / sra ba'am mi phyed pa dang / khyab byed rnams la 'jug pas 'dir yang de dag gi don du bzung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa dang snying po bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel pas 'brel sgra sbyar ba yin la/ de'i don tshul bzhin du ston pas na

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/snying po bstan pa zhes bya ba ste/ rjod byed kyi ngo bo rtsom pa po nyon mongs pa'i rnam g.yeng med pa'i yid can gyis gsung rab kyi dgongs pa 'grel zhing thar pa'i lam ston pa'i ngag nges tshig shāst+ra'i sgra las gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud nyon mongs pa 'chos shing /'bras bu ngan 'gro'i srid pa las skyob pa'i phyir bstan bcos/dbye ba mchog dman gyi dbang du byas nas don med don log don ldan sogs dgu dang /byed las kyi dbang gis 'thor ba sdud pa/zab mo dkrol ba/nyams pa gso ba gsum du gsungs pa las/'dir mchog gi bstan bcos gsum dang /'thor sdud zab dkrol gyi khongs su gtogs pa yin zhing / dpe las mtshan tu btags pa sogs ming gi 'dogs tshul mang du yod pa las 'dir zab mo brjod bya'i don las mtshan du btags pa'o//gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/sangasargyasadathabyang chub semasadapa' thamasacad la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes gsungs te/ drang don du ma rig pa'i gnyid las sangs pa'i spangs pa dang /shes bya la blo rgyas pa ni ye shes te spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas dang / dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i byang chub de 'gro ba rnams kyi don du 'thob par rtse gcig tu sems pa'i 'phags pa thams cad la sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal ba'am/ nges pa'i don du nyon mongs pa gdod nas ma grub cing sangs pa dang /yon tan gdod nas lhun gyis grub cing rgyas pa'i dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs lhan cig skyes pa byang chub sems bde ba chen po'i sku de la/ rnam pas dbye na sku lnga ye shes lnga nas rigs mtha' yas pa'i bar

112 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/du snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang sa snying la sogs pa yul shes drug po rnam par dag pa'i ngo bor snang ba rnams la gnas lugs lta ba mjal ba'i tshul gyis phyag gis 'dud pa'i sgra sbyar ba'o/ /de'ang yul khyad par can sangs rgyas dang byang sems rnams la/ byed pa khyad par can phyag gis btud pas/dgos pa khyad par can nyan pa po'i gzhi'i rigs sad pa dang / rang bzhin gyis gegs med par 'grub pa dang / chos kyi tshul yun ring du dar ba dang / sems bskyed nas bar du gcod pa las bzlog par 'gyur ba'o/ /gsum pa lung gis mdor bstan pa la gnyis/ mngon pa'i mdo las byung ba dang / he badzra las byung ba'o/ /dang po (5ngon pa'i mdo las byung ba )ni/thog med gyur kyang mtha' mdapaldan pa/ /rangabazhin gyisadagartag pamichosacanani/ /thog med sbubasakyisabasgribasaphyir mimathong ste/ /dbair nagaser gyibakhugasani bsgribasapa bzhin/ /lkogatsosaso/ /thog mamed pa'i dusakyikhams/ /chosarnamasakun miganasayin te/ /de yod pasan 'gro kunadatha/ /myangan 'dasapa'ang thob pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ thog mtha' skye 'gag sogs spros pa kun dang bral ba'i sems nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po dang sgrib pa gnyis gcig dang tha dad du grub pa

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 113med pas dri ma la dus brgyud pa'i thog ma dang / rdzas bden pa'i thog ma med pas na 'khor ba thog ma med par gyur kyang dri ma dang bral zhing rang la gnas pa'i don mngon du gyur pa'i tshe don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub pas mtha' ma dang ldan pa'o/ /snying po'i ngo bo la dri ma rang bzhin gyis dag cing gnas skabs gsum du 'gyur ba med pas rtag pa'i chos can de ni sems can rnams kyi rgyud la rang bzhin gyis gnas kyang / 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas lhan cig skyes pa'i sbubs kyis bsgribs pa'i phyir thos sogs rkyen gyis dri ma ma bsal bar du ji bzhin mi mthong ste/ dper na gser gyi khams las grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs ni padma dang 'dam rdzab sogs kyis bsgribs nas mi mthong ba bzhin te/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo las dpe dgus gsal bar bstan pa'i don rgyud bla mar bshad pa bzhin no/ /'di'i tshig rkang dang po zhabrul grol gnyis ka'i dbang du byas pa dang / gnyis pa gnas lugs/ gsum pa bzhi pa 'i spyol lugs kho na'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /tshigs bcad phyi mas ni kun gzhi mdor bstan pa ste/de'ang 'di tsam nas byung ngo zhes sngon gyi thog ma med pa'i dus can gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi rigs sam rgyu bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po de ni/ kun nyon dang rnam byang gi chos rnams kun gyi gnas sam rten yin pas spyi ming du kun gzhi zhes bya ba/sa chu 'dres pa'i rnyogs ma ltar ye shes dang rnam shes 'dres mar gnas pa ste/kun gzhi de yod pas ma rig pa'i kun rtog tshul bzhin ma yin pa yid la byed pas las dang nyon mongs pa phung po khams skye mched rnams skye bas 'khor ba'i 'gro ba kun dang / khams de nyid gzung 'dzin gyi 'ching ba las grol ba'i tshe/ byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi mthar thug pa rje'ogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i mya ngan las

114 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'das pa chen po'ang thob pa yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ sa ni chu la chu rlung la/ /zhes sogs kyis khams la brten pa'i 'khrul tshul dang / 'phags pa klus/sa bon gyur pa'i khams de nyid/ /chos rnams kun gyi rten du 'dod/ /rim gyis sbyangs par gyur pa las/ /sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes grol tshul gsal bar gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gnyis pa (lha badzra las byung ba )ni/semasacanarnamasani sangasargyasanyid/ /'on kyang41 bar dri masasgrib/ /de nyid bsalan sangasargyasaso/ /tshesas lulo / /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ltar sems can rnams ni gdod ma nas rang bzhin spros bral lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas nyid de/ 'on kyang glo bur gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas sgrib bo/ /sgrib pa de nyid thabs kyis bsal na gzhi mngon gyur gyi sangs rgyas zhes gdags so/ /de la ngo bo rnam dag dang glo bur dri mas bsgribs pa'i tshul chu'i rnyogs ma dang / gser gyi g.ya' dang / nam mkha'i sprin lta bu ste/ dbus mtha' las/kun nas nyon mongs rnam par dag /de ni dri bcas dri ma med/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 115chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin/ / dag pa bzhin du dag par 'dod/ /ces so/ /de bzhin 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang /dri med nyi ma zla ba yang / /sprin dang du ba khug rna dang / /sgra gcan gdong dang rdul la sogs/ /sgrib pa lnga yis bsgrib par 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'od gsal ba yi sems /'dod dang gnod sems le lo dang / /rgod pa dang ni the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga yis bsgrib par 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs te/ dper na sems nyid bde gshegs snying po nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i yon tan la sogs pa dang ldan yang / gnas skabs glo bur gyi sgrib pa 'dod pa'i 'dod chags srid pa brlan par byed pa'i sprin lta bu dang / zhe sdang gis sems bskyed pa'i gnod sems du ba lta bu dang / gti mug gis mi gsal bar byed pa le lo khug rna lta bu dang / sems rgod pa nga rgyal dang bcas pa sgra gcan gyi gdong lta bu dang / lta ba sna tshogs kyis bskyed pa'i the tshom rdul 'tshub pa lta bu ste/ sgrib pa lnga pos rang bzhin la gos pa med kyang 'khrul snang du bsgribs pa ltar snang nas mi gsal bar gsungs so/ /

116 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho /bzhi pa rgyas par bshad pa la lnga/ mngon pa'i lung don rgyas bshad/ yang dag pa ma yin pa dang yang dag gi kun rtog bshad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po nyid bshad pa/brgal lan gyis gtan la dbab pa/ lung gi ngo bo nyid bshad pa la nges pa bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la drug thog med kyi tshul/ khams kyi don/ de la gnas pa'i chos/gnas nyid/ da ltar yod pa'i tshul/ mtha' ma'i don bshad pa'o/ /dang po (thog med kyi tshul )ni/de la thog med cesabya ba/ /de bsasngonan med pa nyid/ /dusani skad cig de nyid de/ /gzhan nasabargyud de 'ongasapa min/ /zhes gsungs te/ gong du drangs pa'i lung de la thog med ces bya ba'i don ni/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi ngo bo las sngon du sangs rgyas zhes bya ba med cing / ma rig 'khrul ba'i bag chags las sngon du sems can zhes bya ba med pa nyid de/ 'khor 'das gnyis su snang zhing 'khrul ba'i dus skad cig ma de nyid yin te/ gnas gzhan zhig nas brgyud de 'ong ba min te/ chos thams cad rten cing 'brel 'byung yin pas so/ /de'ang rigs pa drug cu pa las/rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba las/ /'gro kun rgyu dang 'bras bu ste/ /'di las sems can ci yang med/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 7tram̐ng pa spro naḍi chos rnams las//stang pa nyad na 'byung bar zad//ces rbe///17 sa 5)'iganyas pa khams kya don na/khamasani byed po med yo ni//4maphywa won pasade skad brjod//ces gsungs te/ kyimasasangs snros kyi snyingaposdolakyisangasagās kyi yond+ra tan byāms cadā tshaX baX ༵da pas sngar ṭwāṃ gsar du byad pa pa sazhan zhed kyadro spya raḍi ga mtshaspya nyadu nga ba 'gyur bar 'an pas khams sam rags sa rgyu' dan da skad du rjad da1/4de/ 'ibasgori/'i gsum pa la gnas pa' chas na/chorsha/ 'khor dang mya ga 'das//garisusnangalabasharsharsha ste//ma gabakta chagasas ṭwāṃ//spruthadag kṣiṃdang yang dgayi na//'a/ byed ga ba bskyewa/ rgyu na//rgyu rkyenaste kunag bshad//ces gsungs te/ khams de la gnas pa'i chos ni srid pa 'khor ba dang zhi ba mya

118 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ngan las 'das pa gnyis su snang ba la bshad pa yin te/ de gnyis kyi bag chags 'tshogs pa de la ma rig bag chags kyi sa zhes kyang bya/ yang dag gnyen po'i rtog pa dang yang dag min pa 'khor ba'i rtog pa gnyis kyi 'du byed g.yo bas bag chags dkar nag gnyis kyis 'khor 'das gnyis bskyed pa'i rgyu yi rkyen te kun gzhir grags pa'ang don de la dgongs te bshad pa yin no / /bzhi pa (gnas nyid )ni/gnasani rgyal bamisnying po ste/ /yapadag ma yin kun rtogani/ /semasakyidagapa la rabaganas/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos de thams cad kyi gnas sam rten ni sems nyid rgyal ba'i snying po de yin te/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa dang des bskyed pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa sdug bsngal ba thams cad ni sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la rab tu gnas kyang sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de ni skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba 'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin yin pas de rnams gang la yang mi brten cing de rnams kyi skye 'jig gis gos pa ma yin te/ rgyal ba byams pas/tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas/ /sems kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ni/ /gang la yang ni gnas pa med/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 119ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /lnga pa (da ltar yod pa'i tshul )ni/dag pa de nyidad ltarayod/ /yod kyangam rig kun rtogagis/ /ma mthothaphyir na 'khor ba yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems nyid sangs rgyas kyi snying po rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa de nyid ngo bo stong / rang bzhin gsal/ rnam pa 'gag pa med par sku gsum gyi rang bzhin du da ltar sems can thams cad la bzhugs nas yod de/ de ltar yod kyang ma rig pa'i kun rtog gis sgrib nas rang gi ngo bo ma mthong ba'am ma rtogs pa'i phyir 'khrul rtog gi rgya mtshor bying ste 'gro ba drug gi gnas su 'khor ba yin te/byang chub sems 'grel las/ji ltar skye bo sems rmongs pas/ /sgyu ma smig rgyu dri za yi/ /grong khyer la sogs mthong ba ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs sogs snang ba yin/ /zhes dres/ /drug pa (mtha' ma'i don bshad pa )ni/de nyid bsalan myalhan 'das/ //de la tha ma'i tha snyad byas/ /

120 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs te/ de ltar na spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma de nyid gzod ma nas ma grub par shes te gzung 'dzin blang dor gyi rtog pa bsal bas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi don mngon sum du gyur pa na/ srid pa'i mya ngan las 'das pas dri bral glo bur rnam dag gi cha de la 'khor ba'i mtha' ma dang ldan pa'i tha snyad du byas pa yin gyi/sems nyid sangs rgyas kyi snying po gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing yon tan rang chas su gnas pas ngo bo la bogs dbyung du med de/ dpal sdom pa 95rngan/sangs rgyas rnams ni byon gyur tam/ /ma dresan na yang rnam kun tu/ /rgyun chad med pa'i chos nyid ni/ /'phel 'grib spangs te gnas pa yin/ /zhes so/ /des na sems nyid rtogs ma rtogs kyi dbang gis sangs rgyas dang sems can/ don dam dang kun rdzob/ 'khor 'das sogs kyi rnam pa so sor snang zhing de skad du brjod pa yin te/ 'phags pa klus/sems nyid rnam pa gnyis su mthong / /ji ltar 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das/ /bdag tu 'dzin las 'khor ba ste/ /so sor rig na de nyid do/ / zhes ganda/ngas rbedu/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 121gnyis pa yang dag pa ma yin pa dang yang dag pa'i kun rtog bshad pa la gsum/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun rtog la brten nas 'khor ba'i tshul/ 'brul ba'i rtsa ba blang dor gyis byung ba/ gnyen po'i rtogs pa'i don no/ /dang po (yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun rtog la brten nas 'khor ba'i tshul )ni/thog mtha' kunartoganyid la brten/ /'du byed rlung dang 'dra ba yis/ /lasadang nyen mongasabasgrub pa ste/ /deyisabuthapo khamasaskye mched/ /gnyisasnang chosakun ston pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems nyid rgyal ba'i snying po rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la thog mtha'i bye brag med kyang dus kyi thog ma dang mtha' ma ni/ yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pas sgro btags pa nyid la brten pa ste sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu de rang gis rang ma rig pas sems nyid la nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa can gyi nyon mongs pa'i yid g.yo ba mngon par 'du byed pa'i rtog pa rlung dang 'dra ba langs pa de yin/ las dang nyon mongs chu dang 'dra bas bsgrubs pa ste/ las nyon de yis gzugs sogs phung po lnga/ dmigs pa yul gyi khams drug rten dbang po'i khams drug brten pa rnam par shes pa'i khams drug dang bco brgyad/ mig la sogs pa nang gi skye mched drug gzugs la sogs pa phyi'i skye mched drug dang bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ sa'i dkyil 'khor lta bu bskyed cing sa la 'gro ba brten pa ltar gnyis su snang ba'i chos kun bden par grub pa med bzhin du 'khrul ngor

122 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bden pa ltar ston pa yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni/ /sems kyi rang bzhin la gnas te/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed kyis/ /las dang nyon mongs rab tu byed/ /las dang nyon mongs chu las ni/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams 'byung / /zhes rbedu/ /gnyis pa ('brul ba'i rtsa ba blang dor gyis byung ba )ni/de la blathador byed mkhan 'khyul/ /rangasnangadorabasagathatu 'gag /rangasnabablangasapasartsizhig 'byung / /gnyisa'adzin rdzun pa mayinanam/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar na snang ba sems kyi rang snang yin pas gzung 'dzin gnyis su grub pa med kyang / 'khrul rtog las byung ba'i med pa la yod par btags pa'i gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba'i yul kun btags de la 'dod pa blang zhing mi 'dod pa dor ba'i blang dor byed mkhan gyi shes pa de 'brul ba yin te/ci'i phyir zhe na/ phyi rol gyi yul ni sems 'khrul bas sgro btags pa yin gyi don la med pa yin pas bzung ba med de/ de med pas de la brten pa'i 'dzin pa'ang

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 123med mod/ thog med kyi bag chags brtas pa'i mthu las snang ba yin no/ /dper na nam mkha' rang bzhin stong pa 'di la blang bya dang dor byar med pa bzhin du/yul rang gi sems kyi snang ba yin pa mi 'dod cing dor byar med la/ rang sems kyi snang ba de nyid 'dod pas blang bas ci zhig 'byung ste blang byar med do/ /de bas na rang snang gcig pu la blang dor gnyis su 'dzin mkhan gyi yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa ni rdzun pa ma yin nam ste nges par mi bden rdzun no/ /gsum pa (gnyen po'i rtogs pa'i don )ni/de shesaganyen por gsungagamod kyang / / gnyisamed rtogasade bden pa min/ /rtog med rtogasapar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /gzugasasogasacha phyesastongartogasapa/ /khyod rang 'khrul ba ma yin nam/ /'on kyangabaden zhen bkag phyir gsungs/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar gzung 'dzin gnyis med do snyam du rtog pa'i shes pa de dag gi gnyen por gsungs mod kyang gzung 'dzin gnyis med cing stong pa yin snyam pa'i rtog pa de yang bden pa'am don dam min te/ rmi lam du bu 'chi rgyu med kyang shi ba rmis nas bu med do snyam pa ltar/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su ma grub bo snyam pa'i rtog med kyi shes pa de snyems byed kyi rtogs pa chen por gyur pa'i phyir te/ zhi ba 'ulngarngaṭa/de phyir rdzun pa'i dngos gang yin/ /

124 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/de yi dngos med gsal bar rdzun/ /dper na rmi lam bu shi la/ /de med snyam pa'i rnam rtog ni/ /de yod rnam par rtog pa yi/ /gegs yin de yang rdzun pa yin/ /zhes so/ /de yang dngos 'dzin gyi gnyen po stong pa nyid yin kyang / stong nyid la mngon par zhen na gsor mi rung ba'i lta bar gsungs te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'od srungs gang zag tu lta ba ri rab tsam la gnas pa ni bla'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal can stong pa nyid du lta ba ni de lta ma yin no zhes dang / rtsa shes las/stong pa nyid la lta nyes na/ /shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang /rgyal ba rnam kyis stong pa nyid/ /lta kun nges par 'byin par gsungs/ /gang dag stong pa nyid lta la/ /de dag gsor mi rung bar gsungs/ /zhes so/ /des na stong nyid la zhen pa'i blo de nyid kyang spang dgos te/ mdo sde rgyan 95shā5/

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 125sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas/ /de nas sems kyang med pa nyid du rtogs/ / blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas/ /de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas/ /zhes dang / zhi ba lhas/stong nyid bag chags goms pas ni/ / dngos po'i bag chags spong 'gyur zhing / /ci yang med ces goms pas na/ /de yang phyi nas spong bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de yang gzugs sogs rmi lam gyi yul bzhin rang sems kyi snang ba kho na yin pa la gcig dang du ma'i cha so sor phyes nas nam mkha' ltar blo yi yul du ci yang med pa'i stong pa nyid du rtog pa'i cha phye mkhan gyi shes pa khyod rang yang don la 'khrul ba ma yin nam ste snang ba thams cad sems kyi rang 'od snang stong dbyer med chu zla lta bu yin pas cha phye rgyu ma grub pa la phyes na 'khrul ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i snang stong dbyer med mi shes pas sngar dngos por yod pa de phyis stong nyid kyis bcom nas med par 'dzin pa ni nyes pa chen por gsungs te/ dpal sa ra ha chen pos/dngos por 'dzin pa phyugs dang 'dra ba ste/ /dngos med 'dzin pa de bas kyang ni blun/ /

126 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang phung po lnga ril por 'dzin pa sogs bden par zhen pa dgag pa'i phyir cha so sor 'byed cing stong par gtan la dbab pa'i tshul bka' bstan bcos tshad mar gyur pa rnams las gsungs pa yin no/ /gsum pa sangs rgyas kyi snying po nyid bshad pa la gsum/ rang gi ngo bo bstan pa/ yon tan bshad pa/ dpe don dang sbyar nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po (rang gi ngo bo bstan pa )ni/thamasacad bden min rdzun min te/ /chu zlabazhin du mkhasarnamasa'adod/ /tha mal shesapa de nyid la/ /chosadabyingasargyal ba'i snying pozer/ /bzapadu 'phagasapasabatang ba med/ /ngan du semasacan gyisam btang / /thasnyad du ma brjod mod kyang/ /brjod pasade yidon mi shes/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad gdod ma nas skye ba med cing bden par ma grub pas don dam du bden pa min la/ sems kyi rang rtsal 'gag med so sor snang bas 'khrul ngor rdzun pa'ang min te/ dper na chu dwangs pa'i nang du zla ba'i gzugs brnyan snang ba na zla bar snang ba'i dus nas zla bar yod ma myong ba dang / zla ba med bzhin du zla ba'i gzugs dang kha dog snang ba tsam ma 'gag pa/zla snang dang med dngos gnyis dbyer mi phyed cing / chu zla'i mtshan nyid stong par

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 127shes na zla 'dzin rang sar grol ba bzhin du yul snang rnams snang ba'i dus nyid nas bden par yod ma myong ba dang / bden par med bzhin du snang tsam ma 'gag par snang ba ste/ des na snang stong dbyer mi phyed pa dang / mtshan nyid stong par shes nas snang bar 'dzin pa rang sar grol ba shes bya kun la mkhas pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bzhed cing 'dod de/ he badzra las/rang bzhin gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /rdzun min bden min de bzhin du/ /thams cad chu yi zla ba ltar/ /'dod pas rnal 'byor mas shes kyi/ /zhes so/ /de ltar snang stong zung 'jug gi rang bzhin grub mtha' dang gnyen pos ma bcos pa'i tha mal gnyug ma'i shes pa de nyid la/ chos dbyings dang / chos sku dang / bde ba chen po dang / shes rab phar phyin dang / rgyal ba'i snying po la sogs pa ming du ma zer te don sems nyid gnyug ma'i shes pa gcig kho na yin la/ de nyid rig dang ma rig gi khyad par tsam ma gtogs ngo bo 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid yin pas gzhi mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i dus dang / lam byang chub sems dpas rtogs pa'i tshe sngar med kyi yon tan bskyed pa sogs bzang du 'phags pa rnams kyis kyang btang ba med cing / gzhi'i gnas skabs ma rtogs pa'i dus su ngo bo'i yon tan mi ldan pa sogs ngan du sems can gyis kyang ma btang ste/ chos nyid bsal bzhag dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang rgyud bla ma las/

128 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes so/ /don 'di ni sa bcu'i byang sems rnams kyis kyang bsam gyis mi khyab pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma thob bar du tshig dang tha snyad du ma dag gis gnas lugs kyi don brjod mod kyang / chos nyid bsam gyis mi khyab cing rtog ge'i yul ma yin pas tha snyad kyis brjod pas chos nyid de yi don ci lta ba bzhin du mi shes so/ /'o na sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul de so sa'i skye bo rnams la ci'i phyir bstan snyam na/ rgyal ba byams pas/sems zhum sems can dman la brnyas pa dang / /yang dag min 'dzin yang dag chos la skur/ /bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga gang dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spang don du gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas kyi snying pos sems can thams cad la khyab par ma shes nas bdag gis sangs rgyas mi thob snyam du sems zhum nas sems mi bskyed pa dang / sems can dman pa la khams skustod pa ma shes nas brnyas pa dang / khams la bsgribs pa'i dri ma yang dag par yod pa ma yin pa la bden par 'dzin cing yod par sgro 'dogs pa dang / yang dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan stobs sogs rnams ye nas yod pa la med ces skur ba 'debs pa

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 129dang / sems can thams cad la khams yod par 'dra bar ma shes nas yon tan cung zad skyes nas bdag cag lhag go snyam nas nga rgyal ba ste skyon de lnga sbong ba'i don du bstan pa'o/ /kha cig gis dgos pa bstan pa 'dis bde gshegs snying po'i don bstan pa rnams drang don yin par bshad kyang / de lta na stong pa nyid du bstan pa thams cad bdag gcig dang ril por 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i ched du gsungs pas de'ang drang don du 'gyur la/ stong pa nyid chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs yin pas mi mtshungs so snyam na/ blo'i spyod yul du gyur pa'i stong pa tsam gnas lugs su 'gyur na blo 'das chos nyid 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin gnas lugs su ci'i phyir mi 'gyur/ des na 'khor lo bar par stong nyid spros bral gyi lung mang du gsungs pa thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum rbestogs 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid kyis dben par bstan pa yin gyi khams de med par bstan pa ni ma yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo/ /rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa de/ /de dag kun gyi nyon mongs ldog /khams de nyams par byed ma yin/ /zhes gasdo/ngas rbersha/ /gnyis pa (blan tan bshad pa )la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po rṣador bstan pa )ni/de nyid ma 'gag rolaspra la/ /

130 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/yon tan drug stortsabanipo/ /ragasapa min te re re la'ang /bye ba phragarer gsungasakho yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po de nyid ngo bo stong zhing rang bzhin gsal la rnam pa ma 'gag par rol pa'i cha la/ chos sku'i yon tan so gnyis dang /gzugs sku'i yon tan so gnyis te drug cu rtsa bzhi po tshang bar yod par bshad pa de ni gtso bor smos pa'i rags pa yin te/ rgyas par byed na de re re la yang bye ba phrag re'am grangs med pa mnga' bar gsungs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ chos sku'i yon tan dang / gzugs sku'i yon tan bshad pa'o/ /dang po la lnga/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/da ltar yod kyang mi snang ba'i tshul/ rtogs par bya ba'i tshul lung dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po (stobs bcu )ni/gnasadang gnasamin lasashesadang / /rnam:na khamasadangadabangabodang / /mosapa mkhyen dang kun 'gro ba'i/ /lamadapabasamagatan lha yi mig /gnasarjesadran dang nib ni/ /stob / /zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad sngon sems bskyed dang sdom pa'i dam

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 131bca' brtan pa las/ dge bas rnam smin yid du 'ong ba thob pa ni gnas dang rnam smin yid du mi 'ong ba thob pa ni gnas min dang de las ldog pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang po/ las 'bras shes pas las rnams kyi rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs gnyis pa/ khams rnams dang mthun par zhugs pas sems can gyi khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs gsum pa/ dbang po dang mthun par chos ston pas dbang po mchog dman mkhyen pa'i stobs bzhi pa/ mos pa dang mthun par zhugs pas 'gro ba'i mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs lnga pa/ theg pa thams cad la goms pa las theg pa gsum mam 'khor 'das kun 'gro ba'i lam sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs drug pa/ ting nge 'dzin lhur blangs pas bsam gtan sogs nyon mongs pa dang dri ma med pa mkhyen pa'i stobs bdun pa/ sems can la lhag pa'i bsam pa sogs las lha'i mig gis 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa stobs brgyad pa/ dge ba chud ma gsan pas rang gzhan gyi sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i stobs dgu pa/zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs bcu pa ste de ltar na nus pa'i mthu 'gran zla bral ba'i stobs rnam pa bcu'o/ /gnyis pa (mi 'jigs pa bzhi )ni/debarten mi 'jigasabazhi/ /chosakun byang chub gnasastonadab/ /lamadatha'agogaston rtsod med nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ stobs bcu de la brten pa'i mi 'jigs pa bzhi ste/ rang don rtogs pa phun tshogs su dam bca' ba la mi 'jigs pa ni/ 'khor gyi dbus su

132 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bdag ni chos kun gyi dbyings su mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'o zhes zhal gyi bzhes pa la byang chub pa ma yin pa'i rgol ba po med pa dang / gzhan don bar chad kyi chos bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ 'dod chags sogs thar pa'i gegs yin pas 'gog par byed do zhes ston pa la de dag gegs ma yin no zhes rgol ba po med pa dang / gzhan don nges 'byin gyi lam ston pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ byang phyogs so bdun 'khor ba las nges par 'byin pa'i lam yin no zhes ston pa la lam ma yin zhes pa'i rgol ba po med pa dang / rang don spangs pa phun tshogs su bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ zag pa bag chags dang bcas pa 'gag pa'i 'gog pa thob bo zhes ston pa la de ma thob bo zhes pa'i rgol ba med pa ste/ mdor na chos mthun gyi rtsod pa po dngos dang brgyud nas med pa nyid do/ /gsum pa (ma 'dres pa bco brgyad )ni/rgyu desam 'khrul ca co med/ /dran pa ma nyamasartag mnyam bzhag /'du shegasna tshogasami mnga' dang / /mabartagasabatangastomasamedab dang / /'dun pabartson 'grusadran ba dang / /tinga'adzin shesarabarnam grol gyi/ /ye shesamathong ba mi nyamasapa/ /lasarnamasaye shesasngon 'gro dang / /dusal sgrib med bco brgyad de/ /sgoganyisaldan pa chosasku yin/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 133zhes gsungs te/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi brnyes pa'i rgyu des nyan rang byang sems dang ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad mnga' ba ste/ de la spyod pas bsdus pa drug ni/ sku'i spyod pa la 'khrul ba med pas ma zhabrul ba dang / gsung gi brjod pa ca co med pa dang / thugs shes bya thams cad la dran pa ma nyams pas brjed pa mi mang 'a ba dang / spyod lam rnam bzhi'i dus rtag tu mnyam par ma bzhag pa mi mnga' ba dang /'khor 'das la tha dad kyi 'du shes sna tshogs mi mnga' ba dang / so so ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms med pa dang drug go /rtogs pas bsdus pa drug ni/ chos ston pa'i 'dun pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba dang / de bzhin du don gyi brtson 'grus dang /gdul bya la sogs pa dran pa dang / mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang /'bor 'das thams cad shes pa'i shes rab dang / zag pa sa bon dang bcas pa las rnam par grol ba'i rnam grol gyi ye shes mthong ba drug las yongs su nyams pa mi mnga' ba rnams so/ /phrin las kyi bsdus pa gsum ni/ spyod lam thams cad kyis sems can mi 'dul ba med pa'i sku'i phrin las dang / yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas gsung gi phrin las dang / gdul bya mkhyen cing brtse bas 'dzin pa'i thugs kyi phrin las te/ phrin las gsum po rnams ye shes sngon du 'gro ba dang ye shes kyi rjes su 'jug pa thob pa'o/ /ye shes kyis bsdus pa gsum ni/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus gsum la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa sgrib pa med pa bco brgyad de/ de ltar yon tan so gnyis dang ldan pa ni rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi sku yin la/ glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa'i tshe yon tan de dag gi nus pa mngon du 'gyur ba yin no/ /

134 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bzhi pa (di ltar yod kyang mi snang ba'i tshul )ni/da ltade la 'gal bar byed/ /yin layinabazhin ma ngesabs/ /med la yodartog kun btagasabyas/ /desabaskyed rtogade gzhan dbang yin/ /yongasasu grub pa ma shegapas/ /rangagigabyasapasagazingasaya ste/ /kye mchosasku'ibonatan 'di/ /bden pa'i rtogal bden shesayin/ /da ltanusapa chung bde/ /bden shesabor nasami bdenabazos/ /de la rjesa'abrang g.yosapasalan/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems nyid bde gshegs snying po la chos sku'i yon tan rnams tshang bar yod kyang ma rig pas da lta gzhi sems can gyi dus su yon tan de la 'gal bar byed de/ ji ltar byed na/ sems nyid dbyings dang rig pa dbyer med pa 'di la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad tshang zhing ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa zhig yin pa la yin pa bzhin du ma shes shing ma nges pas/ yul med pa rnam rtog gis yod par rtog pa'i kun btags byas shing / yul des bskyed pa'i 'khrul ba'i rtog pa de gzhan dbang yin te/ rgyan las/ gang zhig yod pa ma mthong med mthong ba/ /zhes so/ /gzung 'dzin de'i dbang gis don dam pa'i bden pa chos nyid

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 135'gyur ba med pa'i yongs su grub pa gzung 'dzin gnyis las 'das pa'i sems nyid kyi ngo bo rang gis rang ma rig cing ma shes pas/ rang nyid 'khrul ba'i snang ba la rang gis bden zhen byas pa nyid 'khor ba kha brgyud pa'i bag chags su gyur te sdug bsngal du mas gzings pa ste/ 'phags pa ṇḍa/ lha/ba zhabs kyis/ji ltar rang gis 'dam g.yos pas/ /byis pa gzhan zhig bying ba ltar/ /de bzhin rtog pa'i 'dam bying bas/ /sems can rnams ni 'byung mi nus/ /dngos med dngos por lta ba yi/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba nyams su ྅)nga / /zhes so/ /kye ma ni ya mtshan pa'i don te/ ci'i phyir na/ 'gyur med yongs grub chos sku'i yon tan rnam par dbye ba med pa'i mtshan nyid can 'di nyid sems can gyi rgyud la don dam bden pa'i ngo bo ji lta bar yod par yid ches pa'i bden par rtogs pa can de la/ don dam bden pa shes pa'i shes rab phyin ci ma log pa'i yongs grub yin zhing / da ltar ma rig pa'i dus su yon tan yod kyang nus pa chung ba de yon tan rnams don dam pa'i bden par yod par shes pa'i shes pa de bor nas don la med cing mi bden pa'i gzung 'dzin gyis dbyen bcos te 'khor 'das kyi 'khrul snang du ma bzos shing / de la rjes su 'brang ba'i 'du byed kyi shes pa du ma chu rlabs bzhin du g.yos pas lan pa yin no/ /

136 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/lnga pa rtortogs par bya ba'i tshul lung dang bcas pa )ni/da ni yin la yin bzhin du/ /shesakyisade la nusapa thob/ /'di labasal bya cipong med/ /bzhagapar bya ba cung zad med/ /yathadag nyid lasprang dag lta/ /yabadag mthongan rnam par grol/ /rnam dbyer bcasapa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo b.radagagisakhamasastongagis/ /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chosakyisastotham yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos sku rang la bzhugs pa thos bsamahogyis rtogs pa de'i phyir/da ni sems nyid sangs rgyas kyi snying po 'di la yon tan thams cad tshang bar yod pa yin pa la yin pa bzhin du shes par gyis la/ shes pa de la goms pas yang yang gsos btab nas ji lta bar rtogs pas chog ste yon tan gyi nus pa mngon sum du thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir na/ sems nyid bde gshegs snying po 'di la rang gi 'khrul snang 'du shes kyi 'ching ba las gzhan pa'i dri ma bden dngos su grub pa bsal bar bya rgyu logs su ci yang med cing / yon tan rang bzhin gyis ldan pas sngar med gsar du bsgrub cing bzhag par bya ba cung zad kyang med pas/yang dag pa'i sems nyid bsal bzha ga dang bral ba de nyid rang la rang gis blta

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 137ru med pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par blta'o/ /de ltar bltas pas sems nyid dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa yin pa la yin par mthong ngo / /des na dri ma glo bur ba ni 'du shes yin la/ de'i rang gi ngo bo smig rgyu ltar med pa la med par yang dag par mthong na 'du shes kyi 'ching ba las rnam par grol te/ stobs po chen po'i rgyud las kyang /'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bsnan par bya ba cung zad med/ / de nyid mthong na rnam par grol/ /zhes so/ /sems nyid la spang thob kyi bya ba ci yang med pa de'i phyir dri ma sems kyi rang bzhin ma yin pas sems nyid dang rnam par dbye ba dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi glo bur dri ma dag gis ni khams bde gshegs snying po la ma gos pas stong zhing rang bzhin rnam par dag gi rnam par byang ba'i dmigs pa gsar du gzhag par bya ba med cing yon tan sems nyid kyi rang bzhin yin pas sems nyid dang rnam par dbyer med pa'i 'bral mi rung ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos kyis khams de stong pa ni ma yin no/ /'di ni dpal phreng gi mdo las gsungs pa'i don rgyud bla ma'i lung ngo / /gnyis pa gzugs sku'i yon tan bshad pa la gsum/ yon tan gyi ngo bo/ de lus la gnas pa'i 'thad pa/ dag ma dag gi tshul mdu/ /

8'jam mgon kong sprul yon to rgya mtsho/dang po tren tan gyi ngo li ni/de ldorṣagarsha/gashka~Xbawo// sum stortsag mtshand byad//ces ༷suXs te/chosakyikyaiderdzusnangadzñocha lodzospyodasnrogs pa dang sprurdzu pa'i rnam raswā ta gzugs sku py-inyas kya rang ban nam yan tan na tram̐tshan bzang pa sutram̐ curtsa gnyas da~X / da byad ḍirgyakyi cu tham paragasungasarno yand+ral/ mtshan sa/nd+rad bla mar/ gas gnas 'khar rdzus spratshan pa dang //sa sags dang /marnon kyigs sngin las/ phyag sngis tsor rdzusardzu tshanadang rusna sbalazhabs/mi/sa sakrisardzulha spyand+ra'i pati yan ༷/'akā gnyaswā grangs 'an tshul cung zapro se 'and+ra ba na mdosas daXdas pa'/ོ/darnodaX/rgyakrolas/thub paX ṭī ma zaXg masag dang //mdag snum mtha dang sa sags kyas bstan pa ltar ta 'dar 34 /sprolnga/ri spros//1rwardo tshor ri/95gnyas pa lus la gnas pa' 'thad pa na/thob ṭwāṃmiyonato4lugo//tso badzñotāng sgyu /bang ṭwāṃg/rmasaṭwā yildobaṭwāṃ pardul//ṭwāṃg na gabya//paṭwāṃ//lngas ngadapadenaya ///rnyi lhas ma dag spyosapas// ba par tha snyad byas//

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 139zhes gsungs te/ de ltar gzugs sku gnyis kyi yon tan mtshan dpe rnams thob par byed pa'i rgyu rang lus rtsa rlung thig le las grub pa 'di nyid yin pas/ yon tan de dag rang gi lus rnam par dag pa las byung ba yin zhing / lus de gang las byung snyam na/ bod kyi 'dod pa ltar phywa dang / mu stegs pas 'dod pa'i rtag gcig rang dbang can gyi bdag dang / dbang phyug tshangs pa sogs dang / nyan thos bye smra bas bzhed pa'i phyi rol du bden par grub pa'i rdul phran cha med dang / mdo sde pa ltar snang ba mi bden kyang dbang po la rnam pa gtod mkhan gyi don bden pa ba phag gam lkog na mor yod pas byas par 'dod pa sogs de dag gis lus 'di byas pa min no/ /'o na gang yin na/ sems sems ltar du snang ba dang / sems lus ltar du snang ba ste cha gnyis su yod pa las/ lus ni phyi ma nyid yin pas sems kyi cha las snang ba ste/ zab mo nang don las/de ltar rtsa rlung thig le gsum/ /sems kyi cha las snang ba ste / /zhes so/ /de bas sems ma dag pa'i bar du bar do gsum du yang lus la rgyun chad med cing gzugs med du yang yid kyi lus yod pa ste/ gzugs med ces bya yid lus so/ /zhes so/ /des na sems kyi cha dag pa la sngar bstan pa ltar chos sku'i yon tan du 'gyur la/ lus kyi cha dbang po sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa gzung ba dang 'dzin pa yi rnam par 'gyur ba ma dag pa de lam gyi rtogs pas sbyangs shing dag pas/ gnas lugs kyi rang bzhin mngon du gyur pa de'i tshe gzugs sku thob par gyur pa'i ming dang tha snyad du byas pa'o/ /de yang sa dang po thob nas dbang po

140 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/lnga gnas 'gyur ba'am dbang 'byor ba thob ste/ mig gi dbang po la sogs pa re res kyang gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ste don lnga lnga la 'jug pas dbang po lnga pos yon tan gyi khyad par brgya phrag bcu gnyis 'byung ba la dbang 'byor thob ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/dbang po lnga rnams gnas gyur nas/ /don kun 'jug dang thams cad kyang / /yon tan phrag brgya bcu gnyis 'byung / /dbang 'byor dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de bzhin du sa gnyis pa la sogs pa'i yon tan 'phel ba mthar phyin nas sangs rgyas kyi sar ni yon tan gyi grangs tshad med cing bsam gyis mi khyab ste/mdo sde rgyan las/sangs rgyas sprul ba de rtag tu/ /mdzad pa grub pa'i bye brag dang / /grangs dang zhing dang rnam kun tu/ /bsam mi khyab par shes par bya/ /zhes so/ /'di la kha cig sems kyi dri ma dag pa la sangs rgyas su 'gyur bar rigs kyi/ lus ni pha ma'i rkyen las byung bas mi gtsang ba 'jig pa'i rang bzhin yin pas 'dus byas las 'dus ma byas kyi yon tan 'byung ba mi rigs so snyam na /'phagabro/ pa ṇḍa/bro//
