snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 141shes dang mi shes ma dag las/ /lus 'di nyid la thams cad de/ /rang gi rnam par rtog pas bcings/ /de nyid shes na grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa thogs med zhal nas/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur pa'i phyir zhing dang / lus dang / mtshan dang / dpe byad bzang po dang / dbyangs mtha' yas pa dang / spyi gtsug ltar mi mngon pa la dbang 'byor ba dang zhes gsungs pa sogs thun mong theg pa dang mthun pa'i chos tshul las kyang lus gnas gyur pa'i mtshan dpe gsungs pa yod cing / brtag gnyis las/ btsun mo'i bha ga bde chen du/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /khu ba zhes bya'i rnam par gnas/ /zhes sogs thun min gyi theg pa rnams nas lus 'di nyid gzugs sku 'i rang bzhin du yang yang gsungs te/ des na sems kyi rtsal du snang ba'i lus 'di la gzugs sku'i yon tan thams cad tshang bar yod kyang / rang gi zhabrul rtog gis bcings pas mi mthong ba yin zhing / 'ching ba dang bral na gzugs sku gnyis kyi yon tan du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi po rnams la dngos kyi rgyu dang rkyen gyi rgyu gnyis su yod pa las/ chos sku'i dngos rgyu sems nyid 'od gsal ba'i rang

142 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bzhin dang / gzugs sku'i dngos rgyu sems lus ltar du snang ba nyid yin la/ dri ma dag cing gsal bar byed pa'i rkyen gyi rgyu ni sngon sems bskyed pa nyid kyis gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa sogs dang / bla ma bsu skyel byas pas phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan pa sogs yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi po re re bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyu bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa (dig ma dag gi tshul )ni/debasartsarlung thig le rnams/ /dag pa dgaspra'ibakhugasasku ste/ /masnyung mdagagazubakha(sku'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs sku rnam gnyis lus la gnas pa'i tshul bshad ma thag pa de lta bas na/ sbyang gzhi rtsa dang rlung dang thig le rnams sbyang bya glo bur gyi dri ma rnam par dag pas dag pa'i gzugs kyi skur gnas gyur pa yin te/ rtsa sku/ rlung gsung / thig le thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du sbyang zhing / dri ma ma sbyangs pa'i sems can gyi gnas skabs su ma dag pa'am dri bcas kyi gzugs skur gnas pa'o/ /de dag kyang thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung zhabs nyid kyis zab mo nang gi don las gsal bar gsungs te/ dag pa'i gnas skabs la dgongs nas/ sku gsum rtsa rlung thig le can/ /zhes dang / ma dag pa'i gnas skabs la dgongs nas/ de ltar phung po khams skye mched/ /rtsa rlung thig le la grub pa/ /dri mar bcas pa'i sems nyid las/ /byung ste dri bcas sprul skur gsungs/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par/'dir sngags kyi theg pa nas skye ba sangs rgyas sprul pa'i skur gsungs pa'i don

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 143phung khams skye mched rim gyis rdzogs pa'i tshe/ mchog gi sprul pa dri ma dang bcas pa gzugs kyi sku yin no/ /dri ma med par sbyangs pa na bha ga ni chos kyi dbyings yin la/ zla ba bcu ni sa bcu'i rang bzhin gyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni ye shes/ ma ni mkhan po/ phru ma ni chos gos/ ngag gi bzlas pa ni a haṃ/ de'i lus sbyong pa la sogs pa ni dbang bskur bar byed pa 'od zer chen po'i tshul/ de gnas skabs bzhi rdzogs pa ni sku bzhi'i sangs rgyas su bzhugs kyang ma rtogs pas 'khor ba'i lus su gyur to/ /zhes brtag gnyis sogs kyi lung dang bcas rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gsum pa de'i dpe don sbyar te bshad pa la bzhi/ dpe dngos bstan/ de don dang sbyar/ kun rtog gnyis kyis bcom pa'i tshul go rim dang bcas pa/ mi 'gyur yang dag thob pa'i tshul lung dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po 6pe dngos bstan )ni/dbair na 81na ḍāces/ /de la yon tan misnangadab/ /re ba ba ṅgā'i chusasbyong dang / /skyurapo lha bsasbyong bdapa/ /chugakhong kāshi spusasbyong nas/ /dgade nor gdagosa'adod nas/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems nyid rgyal ba'i snying po 'di nyid dper bya bas mtshon na/shun pa dang bcas pa'i rin po che beeḍārya de la shun pas bsgribs pa'i phyir dgos

144 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'dod 'byung ba'i yon tan mi snang ste/ yon tan de snang bar bya ba'i phyir dang po re bas phyi ba dang / ba tshwa'i chur sbangs te sbyangs pa spel nas dri ma rags pa dang bral bar bya ba dang / bar du chu skyur pos sbangs nas bal gyi lwa bas dri ma phra ba sbyangs pa dang / mthar chu gtsang mas sbangs nas kā shi ka'i ras srab mos dri ma shin tu phra ba sbyangs nas sgrib byed shun pa'i dri ma thams cad dag pa de ni rin po che thams cad kyi mchog nor bu dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa de don dang sbyar ba )ni/debazhinarsāmasakyibaiḍārya/ /nyon mongasashesabya stomasa'ajugagi /shun pa gsum bo sbyangaba'i phyir/ /tshogasaspyor ma dag gabadun dang / /dag pa'i sagasum la raba31nga / /zhes gsungs te/ dpe de bzhin du sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal sangs rgyas kyi snying po beeḍūrya lta bu de la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad tshang bar yod kyang pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs ser sna sogs nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / 'bor gsum du bden par 'dzin pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / bying rgod gnyis snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa ste/ shun pa sgrib pa de gsum pos bsgribs nas mi gsal ba de sbyang ba'i phyir/ thog mar tshogs lam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis dang /sbyor lam nges 'byed cha bzhir dri ma rags pa nyon sgrib sbyang / ma dag sa bdun du phra ba shes sgrib sbyang ba dang / dag pa'i sa gsum du shin tu phra ba snyoms 'jug gam

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 145mtshan 'dzin bzhi po rab tu sbyang bar bya ba yin no/ /de'ang 'phags pa klus/ji ltar rin chen beeḍārya/ /dus rnams kun tu 'od gsal ba/ /rdo yi nang du gnas gyur na/ /de yi 'od ni gas la ma yin/ /de bzhin nyon mongs kyis bsgribs pa'i/ /chos dbyings shin tu dri med la'ang / /'khor bar 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /mya ngan 'das na 'od gsal 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di dag gi don rgyas pa rje nyid kyi nang don rang 'grel las 'di ltar 'byung ste/dag dang nyon mongs dang ldan phyir/ /kun nas nyon mongs med dag phyir/ /rnam par dbye ba med chos phyir/ /lhun grub rnam par mi rtog phyir/ /zhes rgyud bla mar gsungs pa yin no/ /tshul 'di nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang / theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang rtogs dka' bar gsungs kyang re zhig dper bstan par bya ste/ nor bu rin po che beeḍārya chen po shun pa dang bcas pa'i tshe shun pa dang bcas kyang nang du nor bu la

146 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/shun pa 'dres pa med pa ltar/ sems can gyi dus na sangs rgyas kyi snying po dri ma rnams kyis bsgribs kyang ma 'dres pas na dag la nyon mongs pa dang ldan pa yin no/ /yang thog ma nas shun pa dang bcas pa'i nor bu yin kyang shun pa de ni nor bu las byung ba ma yin/ nor bu las gzhan nas byung ba yang ma yin te/ gang nas kyang ma byung ba'i shun pa de rnam par dag par byas pas dag pa ltar/ sems sangs rgyas kyi snying po'i sgrib pa dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyang de kho na bzhin du yin no/ /yang nor bu'i yon tan de rnams dang po dang mtha' ma khyad med kyang / snga ma la ni yon tan mi snang la/ phyi ma dri ma med pa de rgyal ma/tshan gyi rtser btags te gsol ba btab na yon tan 'byin pa bzhin du/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad da ltar yod kyang skyon med pa'i rnam par dkar bas ma bskyed na nus pa mi 'byin pas yon tan rnam par dbye ba med pa'i chos nyid yin no/ /de lta bu'i nor bu nga ni shun pa can no/ /nga ni shun pa'o/ /gsol ba 'debs pa la yon tan sbyin no/ /mi sbyin no/ /zhes rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub bzhin phrin las 'jug ste/ des na sangs rgyas kyi snying po yang lhun gyis grub cing rnam par mi rtog ste tshul de ltar rtogs par bya'o zhes rbedugs gsungs dre(/ /gsum pa (kun rtog gnyis kyis bcom pa'i tshul go rim dang bcas pa )ni/mthadag ma6sgon kun rtob/de/ /dgapa'i kun rtog dathasbrad pas/ /shithaganyisatshig bzhin kun rtogabral/ /spangasaganyen de bzhin nyidartog dang / /'brasabu'i mtshan 'dzinabazhi bral ba/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 147zhes gsungs te/ de'ang spang gnyen gyi rtog pa ni tshogs sbyor na yod la/ ngo bo ni mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin pa dang / 'dus byas la dngos por 'dzin pa dang / srid pa sdug bsngal gsum gyi rang bzhin la bde bar 'dzin pa dang / bdag med pa'i dngos po la bdag tu 'dzin pa ste/ de ltar yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa spang bya'i mtshan nyid can de nyid/ 'dus byas mi rtag pa/ zag bcas sdug bsngal ba/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi bar shes pa ste yang dag pa'i kun tu rtog pa gnyen po'i mtshan nyid can dang phan tshun g.yul sprad pas/ dper na me'i mtshan nyid ma yin pa'i gtsubs shing gtsubs gtan gnyis bsrubs pa las me byung nas shing kho rang gnyis tshig ste me'ang rang yal ba bzhin du/ gnyen po ni spang bya la ltos pa'i phyir spang bya zad pa dang dus mnyam du gnyen po'i rtog pa'ang zad pa'i tshe 'phags pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i shes rab kyi dbang po skyes nas spang gnyen gyi kun tu rtog pa dang bral bar 'gyur te/ 'od dzo/ngas kyis sdokyis pa las/shing gnyis drud pa las ni me 'byung ste/ /byung ba de yis de nyid bsreg pa ltar/ /de bzhin shes rab dbang po skyes nas kyang / /skyes pa de yis de nyid sreg par byed/ /ces so/ /mtshan 'dzin bzhi ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i spang gnyen gyi rtog pa gnyis dang rmi lam gyi chu rmi lam yin pa shes bzhin du brgal ba'i rtsol ba byed pa ltar de bzhin nyid la mtshan mar rtog pa dang / 'bras bu'i mtshan mar 'dzin pa rnams

148 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho /so/ /de la tshogs sbyor du yod pa'i spang gnyen gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ni de bzhin nyid dmigs kyis sel la de gnyis kyi 'dzin rtog bral bas chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba ni mthong ba'i lam mo/ /mnyam bzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang rjes thob sgyu ma lta bur srid zhi mnyam par 'dzin pa tsam de ni de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa'i rtog pa ste/ skabs 'dir nyon yid kyi lhag ma lus pa'i phyir sgom lam ma dag sa bdun la gnas pa yin zhing / yid dang 'dzin pa dang rnam par rtog pa'i rlabs bral nas sa brgyad pa thob ma thag 'bras bu'i mtshan ma tsam 'byung ste/ de ni sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyis zhal bstan nas mi rtog pa las bslangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang byang chub kyi snying po yongs su sbyang ba la 'jug pas dag pa'i sa yin zhing / da rung sa bon thams cad pa'i dri ma'i cha dag pa sa gsum gyis spangs pas 'bras bu'i mtshan mar 'dzin pa yang zhi bas de ltar mtshan 'dzin bzhi dang bral ba la ni sangs rgyas kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes zhes bya'o/ /bzhi pa (mi 'gyur yang dag thob pa'i tshul lung dang bcas pa )ni/ de tshenam mkha'i〉glu can la/ /mtshan gyi me tog rgyasapar 'gyur/ /ma dgam dag dgapa dang / /shinasgyu rnam dgago rim bzhin/ /semasacan byapachub semasadapa' dang / /de bzhinabakhregasapa'iganasaskabasagasum/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 149brjod kyang sangasargyasagasar skyesamin/ /rtsiltar sngar bzhin phyisade bzhin/ /mi 'gyur sangasargyasasnying po yin/ /'gyurab dri bral de la brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ bshad ma thag pa'i mtshan 'dzin bzhi'i dri ma dang bral ba de'i tshe chos kyi sku zhi ba chen po'i ngang du bzhugs shing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'i sku brnyes pa can de la/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od zer mtshan dang dpe byad kyi me tog rgyas par gyur nas gzugs sku gnyis kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa ste/ zab mo nang don las/rgyal ba nam mkha'i sku can ye shes nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun tu gzugs sku 'khor ba ji srid ston/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i sangs rgyas de ni dri mas ma dag pa'i gnas skabs dang / ma dag pa dang dag pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i gnas skabs dang / shin tu rnam par dag pa'i gnas skabs dang gsum po ni go rim bzhin du 'khor ba'i sems can dang /lam zhugs byang chub sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas skabs gsum du brjod pa'am gsungs kyang sangs rgyas de ni sngar med pa gsar du skyes pa min te/ ci ltar sngar yod pa bzhin phyis kyang de bzhin du mi 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po de ngo bo 'gyur ba med pa'i de bzhin nyid yin pas so/ /'on kyang gnas 'gyur ba'i cha ni glo bur ba'i dri ma gzung 'dzin gyi

150 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'ching ba las grol cing bral ba'i cha de nyid la brjod pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/snga ma phyi ma khyad med kyang / /sgrib pa kun gyi dri med pa/ /de bzhin nyid ni sangs rgyas 'dod/ /dag pa ma yin mi dag min/ /zhes ganda/ngas rbedu/ /spyi don bzhi pa brgal lan gyis gtan la dbab pa la bdun/ rgyu med pa dang rgyu phyi rol du mi 'thad pa mdor bstan/ yid dag pa dang ma dag pa'i shes pa bshad pa/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ bya ba grub pa'i phrin las/ mnyam nyid ye shes kyi don/ sku gsum rtag pa'i tshul/ de la ma nges spang ba'o/ /dang po (rgyu med pa dang rgyu phyi rol du mi 'thad pa mdor bstan pa )ni/gangadag ltangan zhugasaparnams/ /sapasargyasayonatan rgyu med dang / /yathan rang min phyi rol gyi/ /rgyu rkyen gyisabaskyedartogagapa ni/ /phyi rol rtag chad khyad ci yod/ /ces gsungs te/ bka' dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa ma lon pa'i gang zag gang dag gsung rab la go ba nyes pas lta ba ngan pa sems la zhugs pa rnams ni/sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams chos nyid stong pa rgyu med pa de kho na las skye bar

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 151'dod pa'i grub mtha' de ni lung rigs dang mi mthun zhing mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yin te/ gur las/rgyu las 'bras gzhan med pa'i phyir/ /thabs ni stong pa nyid ma yin/ /zhes dang / klu sgrub zhal nas/ de bzhin sa bon thams cad la/ /rgyu dang 'dra ba'i 'bras bu 'byung / /sa bon med par 'bras yod par/ / —shes ldan gang gis bsgrub par nus/ / zhes gsungs pa dang / yang kha cig rang nyid la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams gdod nas yod pa min la phyi rol thos bsam gyi bag chags gsar du bzhag nas/yang nas yang du thos don bsam zhing de don sgom pa sogs lan mang du byas pas rgyu rkyen de dag kun gyis bag chags de 'phel ba dang rgyas pa las sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams sngar med gsar du bskyed par 'dod pa'i rtogs pa ni rigs pa ma yin te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku dang ye shes ni 'dus ma byas yin pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas kyi rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed pa ma yin te/ 'khor lo sdom pa las/rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa la/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis bskyed pa 'khrul/ /

152 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes dang / byams matre/na gyi zhal nas/de bzhin nyid 'di thams cad la/ /khyad par med par dag gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /zhes so/ /de'ang phyi rol mu stegs rtag par lta ba dper na dbang phyug pa rnams phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad dbang phyug gis bskyed par 'dod pa sogs dang /chad par lta ba phur bu ba rnams dngos po thams cad rgyu med ngo bo nyid kyis byung bar 'dod pa'i lta ba ngan pa de dang khyad par ci zhig yod de cung zad kyang med do zhes so/ /gnyis pa yid dag pa dang ma dag pa'i shes pa bshad pa ni/'du byed skad cigaskye 'gag snang / /ma dga'adu byed dgadang mtshungs/ /galate de lta ma yinan/ /gzugasasku'i phrin lasargyun chad 'gyur/ /'on kyang 'du byed ming mi brjod/ /sosor rtogapa'i ye shegakyi/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyal ba rnams kyis so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyis 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan lan drug tu gzigs shing sems can rnams kyi sems rgyud tha

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 153dad pa cig car du mkhyen pa sogs mkhyen brtse'i ye shes gzhan don du 'phro ba'am g.yo ba 'du byed pa ni skad cig gis skye 'gag ltar snang ba ste/ de'ang ma dag pa'i 'du byed yid kyi g.yo ba dag dang 'bad rtsol la ma ltos par skye 'gag byed pa'i cha tsam zhig mtshungs so/ /gal te sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kun rdzob tu skye 'gag ltar snang ba de lta ma yin na rgyal ba'i ye shes kyis gdul bya mi mkhyen mi gzigs pa'i phyir sprul sku rgyun mi chad du 'byung ba mi 'thad pas longs sprul gnyis kyi gzugs sku'i phrin las rgyun chad par 'gyur bas rigs pa ma yin la/ 'on kyang ye shes de la 'du byed kyi ming gis ni mi brjod de/ blos btags pa'i bden grub tu med cing gcig dang tha dad las 'das pas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ming gis brjod de/ nang don las/kun rtog dag pa so sor rtog /sgo lnga'i rnam shes bya ba grub / / ces dang / sku gsum la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ kun gzhi gnas gyur pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /kun gzhi la gnas pa'i yid gnas gyur pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /yid gnas gyur pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /sgo lnga'i shes pa gnas gyur pa ni bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bo bshad pa la gnyis/ sgo lnga yul dang yul can gyi snang tshul/ khyad par dang gtan tshigs so/ /dang po (sgo lnga yul dang yul can gyi snang tshul )ni/'byung ba che sogasarangabazhin gang / /

154 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'dzinabacasango bonusaldan ston/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrulaganyisabo mang /snathabar khyadayar cispung med/ /ces gsungs te/ rgyu'i gzugs 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung rnams dang sogs khongs nas 'byung 'gyur gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya rnams kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa de ni/ sems can gyi dus su sems phyi rol yul du snang bas ming dang mtshan ma sogs kyi 'dzin pa bcas pa'i dri ma glo bur bas bslad pa de nyid dag cing gnas gyur pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi sar rang rang gi ngo bo ye shes kyi rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i nus ldan du gyur pas/ zhing rnam dag la dbang 'byor thob cing ci ltar 'dod pa bzhin du longs spyod kun tu ston par byed pa ste/ rgyan las/don bcas 'dzin pa gzhan 'gyur na/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin longs spyod dag /bstan phyir zhing ni dag pa la/ /dbang 'byor dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /des na 'khrul ba'i sems can gyi snang ngo dang ma 'khrul ba 'phags pa'i gzigs ngo gnyis po la yang / snang bar snang tsam zhig la ni khyad par ci yang med de/ dper na sgyu ma'i ltad mo ba dang / sgyu ma'i mkhan po gnyis ka la'ang sgyu ma'i rta glang bud med sogs snang ba tsam zhig la ni khyad med pa bzhin no/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 155gnyis pa khyad par dang gtan tshigs ni/gnyisa'adzin yod med khyadayarayin/ /galate de lta mayinan/ /rgyal ba'i phrin lasaci ltar 'jug /ces gsungs te/ 'o na sems can dang sangs rgyas gnyis po snang ba tsam la khyad par med na 'khrul ma 'khrul cis dbye snyam na/ snang tsam la khyad med kyang 'dzin stangs la khyad yod de/ 'brul bas ni gzung 'dzin gnyis tha dad du 'dzin pa yod la/ ma 'khrul ba la gnyis 'dzin med pas khyad par ni de yin no/ /de yang sems can gyis snang ba sems kyi rang snang snang stong dbyer med yin par ma shes pas bden par bzung nas blang dor byas pas 'ching bar 'gyur te/ dper na sgyu ma'i ltad mo bsasgyu ma'i rta glang sogs la bden par bzung ba bzhin te/ klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/sgyu ma ji lta ji lta bar/ /de bzhin sems can yul la spyod/ /'gro ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin yin/ /de bzhin du ni brten nas byung / /zhes so/ /'phags pa rnams ni yul snang stong dbyer med du shes shing bden par mi 'dzin pas 'khrul bar mi 'gyur te/ sgyu ma'i mkhan pos rang gis sprul pa'i rta glang sogs la bden par mi 'dzin pa bzhin te/ rigs pa drug cu pa las/

156 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/dngos po gzugs brnyan lta bur ni/ /ye shes mig gis rab mthong ba/ /bdag nyid chen po de dag ni/ /yul gyi 'dam la mi chags so/ /zhes so/ /des na sangs rgyas kyis snang ba rnams chu zla ltar dngos po dang dngos med gang du'ang mi 'dzin par snang stong dbyer med du gzigs nas gzhan yang de la dgod pa yin te/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/rgyal ba gang dag mya ngan 'das pa kun/ /thams cad chu zla lta bur gzigs pas na/ /zhes so/ /gal te gnyis 'dzin yod med kyi khyad par de lta ma yin par snod bcud chu zla lta bur sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi yul du mi snang na rgyal ba'i gzugs sku gnyis kyi phrin las yul gang la tshul ji ltar 'jug ste/ phrin las la ladug pa med pa'i skyon du 'gyur bas rigs pa ma yin no/ /bzhi pa bya ba grub pa'i phrin las brjod pa la lnga/ dpe bshad pa'i don 'god pa dang / gzhan rgyud kho nar 'dod pa'i skyon brjod pa dang / snang ba la zhabrul bas ma khyab pa'i dpe dgod nas ma nges pa brjod pa dang / ji snyed pa'i ye shes 'khrul ba ma yin pa'i dpe don bshad pa dang / phrin las dang 'brel ba'i don no/ /dang po 9pe bshad pa'i don 'god pa )ni/yid bzhin nor sogasadabai brjod pa/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 157rtogaspra med paminusaston par/ /bshad kyis / /zhes gsungs te/ de'ang sangs rgyas rnams ni rang don chos sku mngon du mdzad cing / gzhan don du mkhyen brtse dang nus pa'i ye shes tshad med pa mnga' bas/shes bya'i dngos po thams cad dang sems can ma lus pa'i sems rgyud thams cad dus cig car du mkhyen cing gang la gang 'dul gyi sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las ston pa yin te/ mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni sku nam mkha'i rang bzhin yang mi 'dor la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du'ang kun tu ston no/ /gsung brjod du med pa'i chos nyid kyang mi 'dor la/ sgra rnam par rig pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos ston no/ /sems dmigs pa thams cad dang yang bral la/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa dang bsam pa yang rab tu shes so zhes gsungs la/ de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yang / rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang smon lam gyi nus pa dang gdul bya las dag pa gsum tshogs pa las te/ rgyud bla mar/ji ltar beeḍā'i sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /lha dbang lus kyi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro sems sa gzhi gtsang ma la/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i sku yi gzugs brnyan 'char/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /des na rgyud bla mar de bzhin gshegs pa'i phrin las kyi dper/ brgya byin rnga sprin sogs dgu dang / gzhan dag las yid bzhin gyi nor bu

158 'jam mgon kong sprul yonatan rgya mtsho/dang sogs khongs nas dpag bsam gyi shing rnams rgyal ba'i phrin las kyi dper brjod pa ni ye shes med pa'i dpe ma yin te/ sangs rgyas nyid ye shes dngos yin pas so/ /de'ang sdud pa las/ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med/ /rgya mtsho lta bu'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'on kyang mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang rnam par rtog pa dang 'bad rtsol med pa'i sgo na sa mkhyen brtse'i ye shes kyi nus pa ston par mdzad nas sems can gyi sdug bsngal dang / nyon mongs gcod pa yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/nus pa ye shes thugs rje yis/ /sdug bsngal nyon mongs gcod phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /mdor na rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las lhun shākyab tu 'byung ba ste/ 'phags pa lnga/sa/shin tu dri med chos sku la/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gnas gyur nas/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin du/ /de la sems can don rnams 'byung / /zhes gsungs pas/ chos sku'i phrin las gzugs sku gnyis ni sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen brtse'i nus pa bstan pa ste/ las dag pa'i snang ba la shar bar bshad pa

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 9yin sngi gdul bya'i dag kau kho naX spyo) ༷ ni ma ༷na no'i//gnyas pa gzhan rgyud kha nar 'dad pa' skyan brjad pa na/yi gzhan rgyud ṭā / min//na nagazhan rgyud 'a('a yang//'dod nawe shesa'akhrul bar 'gyu ra//zhes gaphroṃngs te/spyodamasngipa ltar dzi ba'i sku dang ṭwāṃ shesbya ji skad sngasdo pa rnamardzu na gzhan rgyud gdul sngi' krog tram̐ng dro nar bshad pa na na//gal ta da tī ma yan pardu saḍis rgyas la ya shas mdā ༷nga sprazudzis sku gzhan rgyudas gdul ṣṭṛX ༷ga snang kha nardzun nd+rashe/ ༷ngas rgyas kya rdzu shadzo da krigān kaul sna' rgyudatram̐ ya ༷༷ su ༷snir ta/ya sa da gzhand+ra rgyud kha na yan pa' phyar rari/ri/da ༈ra ḍidad na ya shasa'i da dzod ༷khrul bar 'gyur dzi/dgazhan rgyud 'asngil ba du ya shas yadzo par snazlo baḍiphyararda/ /gaXnayangaya shaṭwāṃ gzhaṭwāṃ snang yatt+waṃ na das gadziX rjaṭwāṃ su 'a'in ma nus ta dbyāl pas bza' bo ra du da pa ban rang la ya shas da pa' garbergyags /glu de mang byurgam zad pas sa//mupesardzo nge bstonigasum pa snang ba la 'khrul bas ma khyab pa' da bkad nas ma sa pa brjad pa /galate wo snaba'adzinayin zhes//'dodan ṭwāṃlongasnangab yang //'dzinasngarnam rtog can du gta//

160 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs te/ gal te sangs rgyas la snang bcas ye shes yod cing ye shes de la sems can gyi zhabrul ba de snang na skyon yod de/ ye shes des rang gi snang ba 'dzin pa yin pas 'dzin rtog can du 'gyur zhes 'dod pa yin zhe na/ 'o na me long nang du gzugs brnyan snang ba na yang snang dus kyi me long de yang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog can tu 'gyur te gzugs brnyan snang ba'i phyir ro/ /des na sangs rgyas kyi ji snyed pa'i ye shes de la gdul bya snang yang 'dzin rtog can tu mi 'gyur te/ dper na me long nang du gzugs snang 'dzin pa dang rtog pa med pa lta bu'o/ /bzhi pa ji snyed pa'i ye shes 'khrul ba ma yin pa'i dpe don bshad pa ni/semasacan 'khrulab ci snyed pa / /ye shesakul du snapagyur kyang / /ye shesa'akhrulabasagosapa min/ /dapher na mkha' la 'byung chenarnams/ /skye 'gagasnang yang nam mkha' la/ /gosamin skye dang 'gag pa med/ / ces gsungs te/ de ltar na sems can gyi 'khrul ba'i snang ba ji snyed pa rnams kyi ye shes yul du ji lta ba bzhin du snang bar gyur kyang sna nga ba la 'khrul bas ma khyab ste/ snod bcud chu nang zla ba ltar snang stong dbyer med du gzigs shing bden pa dang rdzun pa gang du'ang mi 'dzin pas ye shes dang phrin las la sems can gyi bden 'dzin 'khrul bas nam yang gos pa min te/ rigs pa drug cu pa las/

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 161gang las rten na dngos po rnams/ /chu yi zla ba kho na ltar/ /yang dag ma yin 'ordzog min par/ /shes pa de dag ltas mi 'phrog / ces so/ /de yang dper na nam mkha' stong pa la 'byung ba chen po rnams skye 'gag tu snang yang mkha' la chags 'jig gis gos pa min zhing skye ba dang 'gag pa med pa de bzhin du ye shes la 'khrul bas gos pa med de/ 'phags pa lhas/dper na chu yi zla ba la/ /chu yis mngon par gos pa med/ /sna tshogs gzugs brnyan 'dra ba ste/ /mthong bas skyon gyis gos mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa phrin las dang 'brel ba'i don bshad pa ni/rgyal ba'iwe shesasemasacan la/ /zhugasakyangade bzhin gosapa med/ /'di la 'byulabardzimibamibarjod/ /bya ba grub pa zhesasu brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ bshad ma thag pa de ltar rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang brtse

162 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ba'i thugs rjes sems can gyi khams la ci snyed pa'i nyon mongs pa dang lhan cig tu zhugs shing mkhyen kyang nam mkha' skye 'jig gis ma gos pa de bzhin du nyon mongs pa'i tshogs kyis cung zad kyang gos pa med de/ dper na nyi ma'i 'od zer ni/ri dang sa gzhi nags tshal mi gtsang ba'i ljan ljin la sogs par nye ring med par 'jug cing de dag snang ba dang skem pa dang sreg par byed kyang / de rnams kyis nyi 'od la gos pa med pa ste/ rgyan las/ji ltar nyi ma'i 'od zer dag /'jug la bdag gir bya ba med/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas ye shes kyang / /0〈cog la bdag gir mdzad mi mnga' /zhes so/ /de ni sangs rgyas kyi gzhan don gyi ye shes yin pa'i phyir ye shes 'di la 'khrul ba'i ming gis ni mi brjod de/ ye shes bzhi'i nang nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes zhes su brjod pa yin no/ /de'ang ma dag pa'i gnas skabs su dbang po lnga'i shes pa ni yul la 'jug pa la 'bad rtsol mi dgos par 'jug pa ltar/ de gnas gyur pa las gyur pa'i bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyang 'jig rten gyi khams tham/sa cad du sprul pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa dpag tu med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bad cerdzol mi dgos pas zhugs shing sems can kun gyi don sgrub pa ste/ mdo sde rgyan las/bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ /khams rnams ṭa/na tu sna thenags zhing / /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 163dpag med bsam yas sprul pa yis/ /sems can kun gyi don sgrub pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gnas 'gyur ba'i tshul ji ltar snyam na/ /dper na nam mkha' rang bzhin gyis dag pa yin kyang khu rlangs la sogs pa'i rkyen dag pa'i tshe/ gnas gyur pa'am nam mkha' dag go zhes brjod pa bzhin du yin gyi/ rang gi ngo bo las gzhan pa'i sngar med gsar du thob par bya ba med de/ ji skad du/chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dag par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /lnga pa mnyam nyid ye shes kyi don brjod pa ni/sgribagasumadagaparaganasapa3yid / /mnyam pa nyidade zhi ba'ang yin/ /byamab(dang thuga'(rje che ldanawās/ /longasaspyod rdzogasasogasade la snatha/ /la la sangasargyasathob pa'i tshe/ /theg dman rnanadagag phyirabarjod/ /ces gsungs te/ nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa gsum gnyen pos dag par gyur pa na/ kun gzhi la gnas pa'i nyon mongs pa can gyi yid nga bdag

164 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/tu 'dzin pa de'ang bdag gzhan tha dad du 'dzin pa las grol nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su gnas 'gyur te/ de'ang srid pa'i mtha' la mi gnas par mya ngan las 'das pa zhi ba chen po'i ngang la bzhugs pa'ang yin la/ zhi ba'i mthar yang mi gnas par byams pa dang snying rje chen po dang ldan pas sems can rnams kyi mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ longs spyod rdzogs sku sogs gzugs kyi sku gdul bya so so de la snang ba ston pa yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/mi gnas zhi bar sdo/gas pa yang /mnyam nyid ye shes yin par brjod/ /dus rnams kun tu byams pa dang / /thugs rje chen po dag dang ldan/ /sems can rnams la 51sa pa bzhin/ /sangs rgyas sku ni nges par ston/ /zhes so/ /de'ang la la'i rtog pa la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i tshe mar me shi ba ltar shes pa rgyun chad nas zhi ba gcig pu'i mtha' la gnas par 'dod na/theg dman gyi nyan rang dgra bcom pa lhag med kyi myang 'das su bzhugs nas phrin las rgyun chad pa dang mtshungs par 'gyur bas log rtog de dgag pa'i phyir tshul 'di gsal bar brjod pa yin no/ /drug pa sku gsum rtag pa'i tshul bshad pa la gsum ste/ rtag pa'i tshul gsum gyi don/ mi rtag pa gsum gyi don/ de ye shes dang dri mar bzhad pa'o/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 165dang po 6ga pa'i tshul gsum gyi don )ni/ye shegartagapa gsumayinaste/ /rangabazhin rtag pa chosakyi sku/ /rgyun gyirtag pa longasaspyod rdzogs/ /rgyun michad pa sprul sku yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni nam du'ang 'gyur ba mi mnga' ba'i phyir rtag pa gsum yin te/ de'ang rang bzhin gyi rtag pa ni dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i rang don chos kyi dbyings yin te/ chos kyi sku la 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyun gyi rtag pa ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ste nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyun mi chad par rtag pa ni sprul pa'i sku yin te/ 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du mdzad pa phrin las rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang mdo sde rgyan las/rang bzhin dang ni thre/na mi chad/ /rgyun gyis de dag rtag pa nyid/ /ces so /gnyis pa mi rtag pa gsum gyi don ni/de la mirtagagasumaspezhudade/ /blo byasastobapa rtagapa min/ /g.yo ba'irtog yid rtagapa min/ /tshogasadrug 'dusabyasartagapa min/ /

166 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs te/ ji skad bshad pa'i ye shes de gsum la sgrib byed mi rtag pa gsum yod de/ de yang gzugs sogs phung po lnga po de rang bzhin gyis don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes yin par ma shes nas phyis blos bzo bcos byas pa'i stong pa de nyi tshe ba'i stong nyid yin pa'i phyir rtag pa min no/ /nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang des bskyed pa'i g.yo ba'i rtog yid ni 'khrul ba yin pa'i phyir rtag pa min zhing / rnam shes tshogs drug gi shes pa rkyen bzhis 'dus byas pa yin pa'i phyir rtag pa min no / /gsum pa de ye shes dri mar bshad pa ni/'on kyangade lartagagasumabu(da/ /mirtagarasakyim po drim snye/ /rtag pa gsum po ye shen(yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'on kyang bshad ma thag pa'i mi rtag pa gsum po de'i sbubs na ye shes rtag pa gsum rang chas su yod de sems can gyi gnas skabs na dri ma dang ye shes 'dres pa'i phyir ro/ /de la mi rtag pa gsum po de ni 'brul ba glo bur ba'i dri ma sbyang bya yin te/ rtag pa gsum po de ni gnas lugs yongs su grub pa'i ye shes sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu yin no/ /bdun pa de ma nges pa spong ba la drug mu stegs pa'i bdag dang mi mthun pa'i don/ nyan rang gi zhi ba dang mi mtshungs pa'i don/ sems can dang mi mtshungs pa'i don/ phyir mi ldog pa'i don/ dri ma gtan mi ldang ba'i don/ thams cad kyi don bsdu ba'o/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 167dang po (5 stegs pa'i bdag dang mi mthun pa'i don )ni/mu stega'/bdag dang min te/ /yid kyisabatagasadang ma btagasaphyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ de ltar chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba sangs rgyas kyi snying po de sku gsum gyi rang bzhin du 'gyur ba med cing rtag par yod na/mu stegs pa'i bdag dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro zhe na/ mu stegs pa rnams kyis btags pa'i gang zag gi bdag 'gyur ba med pas rtag pa/ du ma ma yin pas gcig pu/ rgyu rkyen la mi ltos pas rang dbang can du blos btags pa ni/ phung po lnga bdag med pa la bdag tu btags pa'i 'khrul ba dang mtshungs pa min te/sems nyid chos sku skye 'gag sogs spros pa'i dra ba thams cad las grol bar 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa nam mkha' lta bur kun la khyab pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas don dam par rtag ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mu stegs pas ni blos byas kyi yid kyis btags pa'i sgro btags yin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes gcig dang tha dad las grol ba bdag med pa'i rang bzhin can yin pas bdag dang bdag gir sgro btags byas pa ma yin zhing rtog pas ma btags pa'i phyir mu stogs pas btags pa'i bdag dang mi mtshungs te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/chos dbyings gang phyir bdag ma yin/ /skyes pa ma yin bud med min/ /

168 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam grol ba/ /ji ltar bdag ces rtog par bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyi sa pa nyan rang gi zhi ba dang mi mtshungs pa'i don ni/nyan rang ṣkadang mtshungasaminate/ /gzugasasku'iyonatan kun ston phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la nyan rang gi zhi ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyis ma bskul bar du zhi ba gcig pu'i ngang la gnas par gsungs te/ klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ci srid sangs rgyas kyis ma bskul/ /de srid ye shes lus dngos can/ /ting 'dzin myos pas brgyal gyur pa/ /nyan thos de dag gnas par gyur/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin yin la/ de ltar mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i dbyings su bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / nyan rang zhi ba phyogs gcig pa'i ngang la bzhugs pa dang mtshungs pa min te/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje'i dbang las mtha' yas pa'i gdul bya gang la gang 'dul ba'i longs sprul gnyis kyi gzugs sku'i yon tan rnam pa mang po kun ston pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du'ang rnal 'gyor spyod pa'i gzhung 'bum pa las/

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 169thabs 05 mkhas pas zhir gnas min/ /shes rab kyis ni 'khor bar min/ /mtha' gnyis rnam par spangs nas kyang / /rtog pa med par 'gro don spyod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar ro/ /gsum pa sems can dang mi mtshungs pa'i don ni/semasacan lusadang mtshungasaminaste/ /zag bcasarkyen gyisam bskyed phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ de lta bu'i gzugs sku zhes bya ba de sems can gyi lus dang mtshungs sam snyam na/ sems can gyi lus phung khams skye mched kyi bdag nyid las dang nyon mongs pas 'phags pa'i 'dus byas de dang mtshungs pa min te/gzugs sku gnyis zag/ bcas las dang nyon mongs pa'i rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa'i phyir/ der ma zad shin tu rnam dag sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs su zag med kyi las kyis bskyed pa'i yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus kyi skye ba'ang med na/ phung po mngon par grub pa'i skye ba lta ci smos/ rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa'i rga ba'ang med na 'du byed yongs su smin pa'i rga ba lta ci smos/ bag chags phra mo'i nad kyang med na nyon mongs pa'i nad lta ci smos/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgyur ba'i 'chi 'pho ba'ang med na tshe yongs su gtugs pa'i 'chi 'pho ba lta ci smos te/ rgyud bla mar/

170 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/de ni yid kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /lus kyis skye med rtag pa'i phyir/ /bsam mi khyab bsgyur 'chi 'pho yis/ /de ni mi 'chi brtan pa'i phyir/ /bag chags phra mo'i nad rnams kyis/ /gnod med zhi ba nyid kyi phyir/ /zag med mngon par 'du byed kyis/ /g.yung drung phyir na rga ba med/ /ces so /bzhi pa phyir mi ldog pa'i don ni/phyir la sdogapar mi'agyur te/ /yin layinabazhin mngonagyur phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ sngar dri bcas kyi sangs rgyas de bar du lam gyi dri ma bsal yang slar 'khor bar ldog par mi 'gyur ram snyam na/ rtogs pas gnas lugs mngon du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas de phyir la ldog cing slar nyon mongs par mi 'gyur te/ so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis ye nas gnas pa'i sems nyid gnas lugs ci lta bu yin pa la yin lugs bzhin du mngon sum du gyur pa'i phyir te/ dpal chos kyi spru/ba/rnga5 shā/thag/'tshe ba med dang yang dag don/ /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 171ngo bo nyid las phyin log gis/ /'bad du zin kyang mi ldog ste/ /blo ni de phyogs 'dzin phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa dri ma gtan mi ldang ba'i don ni/drim ldang ba gtan med de/ /thadad kun rtog bral ba'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs te/ lam mthar phyin kyang da dung phyin ci log gi blo'i dri ma ldang bar 'gyur ram snyam na/ mngon du gyur nas dri ma slar ldang ba gtan nas med de/ dri ma ni gzung 'dzin tha dad du 'dzin pa'i kun rtog 'khrul ba yin la de'i rgyu ni ma rig pa yin pas de dang bral ba'i phyir te/ chos kyi grags pas/lta ba'i sa bon spangs pa'i phyir/ /slar mi ldog pa nyid yin no / /zhes so/ /drug pa thams cad kyi don bsdu ba ni/de phyir bemasanyid sangasargyasa'adi/ /da ltar yod kyangam shesaso/ /

172 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes gsungs te/ rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir sems nyid rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa'i sangs rgyas 'di/ da ltar gzhi sems can gyi dus su tshang bar yod kyang gzung 'dzin gyi dri mas bsgribs nas ma shes so/ /de'ang dper na mi dbul po'i khyim du gter yod pa ma shes nas dbul phongs kyis sdug bsngal ba lta bu ste/ byams pa mgon po'i zhal snga nas/ji ltar mi dbul khyim nang sa 'og na/ /mi zad pa yi gter ni yod gyur la/ /mi des de ma shes shing gter de yang / /de la nga 'dir yod ces mi smra ltar/ /de bzhin yid kyi nang chud rin chen gter/ /dri med bzhag dang bsal med chos nyid kyang / /ma rtogs pas na dbul ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /rnam mang rgyun du skye dgu 'dis myong ngo / /zhes rbersha/ /lnga pa lung gis ngo bo nyid bshad par nges pa bskyed pa la bzhi/ mdo sde rgyan gyi lung / theg pa chen po nyi shu pa'i lung / rgyud bla ma'i lung / mdo rgyud las gsungs pa'i don bsdus pa'o/ /dang po rṣado sde rgyan gyi lung )ni/gathatshestogasapade ṣpetshe/ /rdziltar lcagasal rmab dang / /

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 173mig la rab rib nib ltar/ /sangasargyasasemasadang ye shesal/ /yod dang med par mibarjodado/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang gi tshe spyir thos bsam sgom pa las byung ba'i shes rab dang /khyad par bla ma'i byin rlabs dang slob ma'i mos gus kyi rten 'brel tshogs pas sems nyid bde gshegs snying po'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa de'i tshe/dpe ji lta na lcags bsregs pa la tsha ba zhi ba ni gdung ba med pa yin pa dang /mig la rab rib zug gzer zhi bas rab rib med pa yin pas/ tsha ba dang rab rib kyi dngos po yod pa yang ma yin la/ de gnyis zhi ba'i mtshan nyid lcags dang mig gsal po yod pas de ni med pa'ang ma yin pa ltar/ ma rig pa sangs shing ye shes rgyas pa de'i dus na sems rnam shes tshogs brgyad sangs pa dang ye shes lnga rgyas pa la/ kun rdzob 'khrul ba'i dri ma tsha ba dang rab rib bzhin du yod par mi brjod cing lcags dang mig dwangs pa bzhin du med par mi brjod do/ /gnyis pa theg pa chen nyi shu pa'i lung ni/dam pa'i don duskye med phyir/ /de nyid du nigrolaba'ang med/ /mkha' bzhin sangasargyasade bzhin te/ /semasacanadang nimatshan snyed gcig /tshur rol pha rol skye med pas/ /rangabazhin myangan 'dasapa'ang med/ /

174 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ de phyir 'dusabyasamangon parastong / /kun mkhyenawe she'(spyod kul yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ dam pa ste nges pa'i don du na chos thams cad gdod nas skye ba med pa'i phyir/ don dam de nyid du ni 'khor ba las grol bar bya ba'ang med de/nam mkha' skye 'gag med cing 'gyur ba med pa bzhin du sangs rgyas ni gnas skabs thams cad du 'gyur ba med pa de bzhin te/ des na rtogs ma rtogs tsam las sems can dang ni sangs rgyas gnyis ka'i mtshan nyid gcig cing ngo bo dbyer med do/ /tshu rol 'khor ba pha rol myang 'das gnyis ka'ang med pas rang bzhin mya ngan las 'das pa'ang med do/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir du 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad mngon par stong zhing bdag med pa ste/ de bas na bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas 'di lta bu ni kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul yin gyi de las gzhan pa dag gis bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /gsum pa rgyud bla ma'i lung ni/za phyirdothosabamicu'akhamin la/ /donadam phyiratabasam bamimin/ /chosanyidajagaphyir 'jig rtenaspra'i/ /lha/maḥ/ 'a(thersha/thabaku'(ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid sangs rgyas kyi snying po 'di nyid dpag dka' zhing shin tu phra bas smra bsam brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 175thos pa'i shes rab kyi yul ma yin la/ don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyir rtog dpyod kyis bsam pa'i shes rab kyi yul yang min te kun rdzob yin pa'i phyir des don dam ji bzhin gzhal mi nus la/ chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid gzhal bar dka' ba'i gting zab pas mtshan ma'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i phyir 'jig rten pa'i sgom pa bsam gtan dang gzugs med bzhi la sogs pa'i khongs nas nyan rang gi dran nye dang / rten 'brel 'byung ldog rnam thar brgyad/ snyoms 'jug dag gi yu la du byas nas kyang rtogs par nus pa ma yin no/ /bzhi pa mdo rgyud las gsungs pa'i don bsdus pa ni/rangarig ye shesaspyodaskul te/ /rangabyung dad pasadonadam skyed/ /kye mtshul 'dimartogasapas/ / byisal 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'o na sems nyid 'od gsal bde gshegs snying po de dag gang gis kyang rtogs pa'i yul min na/ rtogs pa'i thabs ci zhig ce na/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi so sor rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul du gyur pa ste/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs ni rang byung gshis kyi snying po sngon goms dge stobs kyis sad pa'i chos dbyings nyid rnam pa kun ldan gyi bla mar snang ba la yid ches nges shes skyes pa'i dbang gis bzod du med pa'i gdung shugs dang / des chos thams cad la rgyas thebs pa'i snang srid bla mar shar ba'i nyams myong brjod bral gyis dus 'da' ba'i dad pas don dam pa la sgrib byed thams cad rang sangs su gyur nas mthar

176 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/thug pa'i ye shes mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes skyed par byed de/ rgyal ba byams pas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam de/ /dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnas lugs rtogs rim bzhin de ltar ma rtogs pa'i khams gsum po dag la bzod du med pa'i snying rje chen po shugs kyis skye zhing / der ma zad ched du sgom pa'ang rgyal sras rnams kyi gzhung lam yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar rjes 'jug rnams la thugs brtse bas gdams pa'i phyir/ rgyal ba nyid kyis kyang gzhung gi mjug bsngo ba'i don 'dus par gzhung zor yang ba'i dgos pas 'dir stabs cig tu gsungs pa/ kye ma gnas lugs zab mo'i tshul 'di ma rtogs pas spang blang gi don la shes rab ma skyes pa'i byis pa dag phyin ci log la spyod pas 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams pa snying rje ba'i gnas yin no/ /spyi don lnga pa rnyed tshul gyis mjug bsdu ba la gnyis/ rnyed tshul dngos/ smon lam 31/ /dang po lked tshul dngos )ni/thubaya chen po 'jam dpaladabyangs/ /byamasapa spyan rasagazigasadabangagi /mthu yisarangabyung rdo rjesabris/ /zhes gsungs te/ bde gshegs snying po'i don 'di bdag cag gi 'dren pa thub pa chen po'i gsung dri ma med pa dang mkhyen rab kyi bdag nyid 'jam dpal dbyangs dang / sems can thams cad la bde legs 'byung ba'i gnas rgyal tshab byams pa dang / thugs rjes 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs

snying po bstan pa'i rnam 'grel rang byung dgongs gsal/ 177dbang phyug ste de dag gi rnam par thar pa la bskal pa grangs med pa nas goms par byas pa'i stobs kyis dang / da ltar yang rgyal dang de sras rnams kyi bka' dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa ma nor mngon du mdzad nas/ de nyid phyi ma'i gdul bya la brtse bas rjes su gdams pa'i mthu dang dbang chen po thob pa yis dpal ldan karma pa gsum pa rang byung rdo rjes gzhan gyi don du gsal bar bris pa'o/ /gnyis pa smon lam ni/'dres kun tha934lhakhagasnying po 'di/ /mthar phyin mnor shesayar 3|ga / ces gsungs te/ 'di ltar theg pa chen po'i don mthar thug pa gsal bar mdzad pa'i dge ba sangs rgyas grangs med pas gsungs kyang mthar gtugs par mi nus pa'i phan yon chen po dang ldan pas na/ de lta'i dge ba bsngo ba'i yul 'gro ba kun la byin pas de'i mthus sems can de thams cad kyis rang la yod pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po 'di nyid/ gnad kyi gdams ngag zab mo 'di lta bu la thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin nas glo bur ba'i dri ma thams cad dag pa'i gnas lugs ma no ra ba de rtogs shing shes par shog cigatha patha(/tagakyi4)nga 21 gtan la dbab pa therdo rje theb/pa'i snyitha11 :rdoga'(the(/ /zhes gsungs te/ rgyu'i theg pa las gsal zhing rgyas par gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po gtan la dbab pa 'di gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lta ba'i yang snying po yin zhing / des na mthar thug gi lta ba bshad pa rdzogs so zhes pa'o/ /

178 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zab cing kun gyis mi rtogs la/ /rtogs na sangs rgyas 'gyur ba'i don/phyogs tsam go bas glo bur gyi/ /dri ma'i sbubs mthug brtol bar 'gyur/ /snying po yod par yid ches tsam /skyes kyang rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob gsung / /go sla don 'dus gzhung bzang 'di/ /go myong rtogs pas mthar 'byin 'tshal/ /skal mnyam dag la phan pa'i blos/ /tshig tsam mchog gi rjes su bkral/ /dge bas bde gshegs snying po'i zhal/ /grol ba kun gyis mjal bar shog /snying po gtan la dbab pa'i gzhung 'di la snga phyir byon pa'i 'grel pa dang mchan bu kha shas mchis kyang / 'jam dbyangs don grub 'od zer gyi gsung nyid khyad par du 'phags shing thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa dmar lnga pas de'i don bsdus te mchan bu mdzad pa rnams kyi snying po blangs nas/ mdo khams bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa chen po dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gi gandho lar karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes snga 'grel tshad ma'i legs bshad gsal bar bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid rdo rje zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od zer/mthar thug phyir mi ldog pa'i chos/ /ston dang bstan pa 'dzin mdzad rnams/ /snying gi thig ler bkod nas 'dir/ /dbu ma'i lta khrid nyung bsdus 'bri/ /de la gang nas byung ba'i khungs dang / lta khrid dngos/ phan yon bshad pa/ brgyud pa dang bzhi'o/ /dang po la'ang spyi dang / khyad par gnyis las/dang po (lta khrid spyi )ni/ spyir rgyal ba'i bka' la bslu ba'am mi bden pa zhig yod nas drang nges kyi rnam par bzhag pa ma yin yang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug mi nus pa dang nus pa'i gang zag gi blo khyad la brten nas byis pa la zas snyod pa'i tshul gyis bka' 'khor lo dang pos 'khor ba las nges par 'byung / bar pas mtshan 'dzin zlog mtha' mas gnas lugs kyi don yod med yin min sogs legs par phye bas/ dang po drang don/ bar pa drang nges 'dres pa/mtha' ma nges don bla med du mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel lung gis grub pa sogs rgyal ba sras bcas kyis rnam par bzhag pa las 'gongs mi nus pa ma zad/zab mo'i don rim par gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par mngon sum gyis kyang grub pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang med pa la med ces kun rdzob kyi snang tshul bar pas

180 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bstan cing / yod pa la yod ces don dam gyi stong tshul mtha' mas bstan pas/bar mtha' gnyis dang de dag gi srol 'byed shing rta chen po gnyis kyang dgongs pa'i 'bab stegs gcig par shadhī pa sogs bzhed/ de la 'khor lo mtha' ma nges don snying po'i mdo sde nyi shu/ byams chos sde lnga/ klu thogs yab sras kyi gzhung lugs la brten lo tsā ba gzu btsan rnam gnyis nas bzung da lta'i bar du bod kyi yul 'dir yang gzhan stong dbu mar grags pa'i 'chad nyan srol ka ci rigs par byung ba las/ shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po ni thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rje/kun mkhyen dol po pa/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer dang gsum po yin la/ rje bdun pa/ zi lung paṇa chen/ tā ra nā tha/ bstan pa'i nyin byed sogs 'phags pa'i sa la nges par bzhugs shing bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bshes gnyen phyogs rer ma lhung ba'i chos kyi spyan ldan rnams kyis kyang nyan bshad sgom gsum gyis gtan la phab cing de dag gi gsung rab thams cad 'di'i rgyab brten tu byon no/ /der ma zad thos bsam sgom pa zung 'brel gyis gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par gzigs pa'i skye 'phags rnams kyi mthar thug dgongs pa ni 'di kho nar 'bab dgos so/ /gnyis pa khyad par zab mo'i lta khrid ni/ rgyud bla ma'i dgongs don mnga' bdag mi tri pas rtsal du bton te dbus kyi ka chen rin chen rdo rje dang / kha che sadza ja na sogs su brgyud pa lta khrid thun mong ba'i lugs dang / byin rlabs 'pho ba'i dbang bskur gyi lam nas rje btsun lho brag pa la bstsal ba bka' brgyud yongs la grags pa'i mdo sngags zung 'jug gi phyag chen thun mong min pa dang gnyis yod pa'i snga ma ni 'dir 'chad par bya ba nyid do/ /

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 181gnyis pa lta khrid dngos la'ang mdo lugs rang rkang dang / de sngags lugs zab mo dang 'brel ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la'ang go bar bya ba dang / de nyams su blang ba'i tshul gnyis las/dang po (go bar bya ba )ni/ rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa la yid ches pa 'jig rten pa'i yang dag lta bar gsungs pa de gzhir bzhagatshopa'i steng / khams gsum las 'da' bar byed pa zab mo'i lta ba phyin ci ma log pa zhig la brten dgos shing /de'ang nyan thos pas gang zag bdag med// rang rgyal bas gzung ba bden med/ rnal 'byor spyod pas gnyis stong ye shes/ dbu ma thun mong bas chos kun rang rang gi ngo bos stong par gtan la phab pa'i don bsgom pas nyams su myong pa yin yang /sems dang / 'du shes dang / lta ba phyin ci log gsum gyis kun nas dkris pas gnyis med ye shes gtan la ma phab par sangs rgyas dang sa thag ring ba'o/ /'o na gnyis med ye shes de su zhig gis nyams su myong zhe na/ mtshan nyid pa 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis gzigs shing / rjes mthun pa so so'i skye bo thos bsam sgom pa thun min gyis rgyud sbyangs pa rnams kyis so/ /phyi ma de la'ang gnyis te/ ngo bo nyid med par smra ba rnams kyis gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos thams cad ri bong gi rwa dang mo gsham gyi bu ltar gnas lugs la ci'ang mi dmigs shing gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong nyid de/ rten 'brel du snang la ma 'gag par shar ba dbu ma'i rigs chen lngas thag chod par byas te/ dngos gzhi'i gtsub shing dang gtsub gtan gnyis ka'ang mes bsregs nas mthar me nyid rang yal du song ba ltar zhen rtog sor rtog gis 'jal zin nas so sor rtog pa'i shes rab nyid kyang da migs med du 'jog ste/ cir yang mi sems/ gang du'ang yid la mi byed par

182 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bdag med rtogs pa nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du mi bsgom pa'i tshul gyis bsgom pa na rin chen sgron ma la sogs pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mang po skyes pa'i tshe/ rnam par dag pa'i lung dang man ngag gis ngo legs par 'phrod na phyin ci log gi 'dzin stangs dag nas shes rab na 'phar te thun mong min pa'i dbu ma chen po'i lta ba rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs dam pa'i le'u las/ting nge 'dzin kyang rab brtan la/ /de la mngon par zhen byed na/ /byis pa nyer spyod pa zhes bya/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rtog dpyod kyi stong nyams la chos nyid du rlom pa kha cig gis dbu ma chen po ni nged kho na ltar yin gyi gzhan thams cad nor ba'o zhes lam shor dang / kha cig rang gi ngo bo blo 'das su ma grol bar skye 'gag grangs su 'debs pa la phyag rgya chen por 'khrul te myong ba brtan pa'i gshis shor ba gnyis ming gi rnam dadresad che chung ma gartastogs khams gsum las 'phags mi nus par mtshungs pas/thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sgor 'jug pa la lung rigs man ngag phyin ci ma log par go myong rtogs pa rdo rus 'phrod pas kun dang mi 'gal la kun las 'phags pa'i lta sgom spyod pa gnad du khel ba dgos so/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa byams chos la brten pa dag gis ni bka' 'khor lo bar pa'i gzhung lugs dgongs 'grel bcas pas chos can 'khrul snang glo bur ba'i spros pa gcod pa

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 183sngon du song na mchog yin zhing / de tsam spros pas mi lcogs na/ byams chos lnga'am rgyud bla ma tsam la ni nges par sbyong dgos la/ de'ang mi nus na/ ji skad du/sems las gzhan du med pa blos rig nas/ /de nas sems kyang med pa nyid rtogs te/ /blo dang ldan pas gnyis po med rig nas/ /de mi ldan pa chos kyi dbyings la gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar// thog ma med pa nas rang sems ma rig pa'i cha glo bur dri ma la brten nas ma brtags ma dpyad pa'i ngor rmi lam gyi 'khrul ba ltar sna tshogs su snang yang / dpyad na cir yang ma grub par rang rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir/ snang ba thams cad ni sems kho na'i cho 'phrul yin pas phyi don ltar shar ba'i gzung ba snang la rang bzhin med pa chu nang gi zla ba lta bu kun rdzob bden pa'i gnas lugs dang /'dzin pa'i sems kyang phyi nang gang du'ang mi gnas shing dbyibs kha dog dngos por ma grub la/ med pa la yod pa ltar zhabrul ba'i bdag 'dzin gyi rgyun las byung ba'i tshogs brgyad cha dang bcas pa nam mkha'i me tog ltar gdod nas stong yang / gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes sangs rgyas nas sems can gyi bar thams cad la khyab pa'i chos nyid bde gshegs snying po rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ glo bur dri mas gdod nas gos ma myong ba/ don dam bden pa'i gnas lugs de nyid yang dag par ngo shes nas de'i ngang du mnyam par 'jog pa ni byams chos kyi dgongs pa ste/ dpyad pa de tsam ni nges par sngon du 'gro dgos te mtha' bral du gtan la phab nas zung 'i〈cog tu nyams su len pa zhes bya ba gnas lugs gatshog ma rang byung gi

184 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ye shes su gnas/ stong lugs spros pa'i mthar 'dzin pa'i rtog pas stong / rtogs lugs so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyis rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyams len dngos la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo/ /dang po (sngon 'gro nani/ de'ang bde gshegs snying po yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i dri ma rags pa dang phra ba dang shin tu phra ba rnams sbyong ba'i go rim ltar/'bor lo dang po dang rjes su mthun par chos kyi mdo bzhin bsam bsgom du bya ste/'di ltar skyes pa'i mthar 'chi/ 'dus pa'i mthar 'bral/ bsags pa'i mthar mdzad/ bslangs pa'i mthar 'gyel/ 'dus byas kyi chos 'di thams cad chu bur dang glog las kyang mi rtag las dang nyon mongs pa'i nye bar len pa la brten nas khams gsum du gzugs sogs phung po lnga yis 'khor zhing zag pa bum par chud pa'i sbrang ma lta bu 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ sdug bsngal gyis g.yos/sdug bsngal gyi rgya ru chud/ gzugs nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad bden par ma grub pas stong zhing / gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi bdag med pa chos thams cad kyis stong pa'i gzhi 'khrul ba glo bur ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su grub pa chen po ni rtag brtan zhi ba dam pa'o snyam du bsam la/ ngag tu/ 'dus byas thams cad ni mi rtag pa'o/ /zag pa dang bcas pa ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni stong zhing bdag med pa'o/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'o/ /zhes yang yang brjod/ rgyas par lam rim rnams su 'byung ba'i thun mong gi sngon 'gro rnams rgyud la 'dre nges su bya'o/ /gnyis pa la'ang gsum ste/ dang po theg chen thun mong min pa'i lam du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 185sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal te/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dge /sems can rnams kyi nyer len ni/ /mtha' dang mtha' med rnam spangs pa'o/ /byi dor byas pas gser mdog dang / /sa le sbram dang 'khar ba dag /ji ltar mthong ba de bzhin du/ /phung po rnams la sems can dang / /gang zag med cing phung po med/ /sangs rgyas ye shes zag med pa/ /rtag tu zhi ba rnam bsgom ste/ /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sems bskyed pa ni/ sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /yid la sogs pa'i nyon mongs dang / /bdag dang lhan cig ldan par ni/ /smra ba'i mchog gis rab tu bstan/ /de bsal bya phyir lam mchog bsgom/ /zhes pa dag don dran bzhin du brjod/

186 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/gnyis pa 'khor lo bar pa dang rjes su mthun par rtog med spros bral du mnyam par bzhag nas chos nyid zab mo la zlo ba ni/ bde ba'i gdan la lus gnad dkyus mthun bca'/ mos gus dung ba bsgom/ sngar thos bsam gyis lta ba gtan la phab na lta ba de dran par byas la mnyam par bzhag thos bsam tshul ldan med na/ rang sems 'di ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub par gtan la phab nas gang zag gi bdag med dang / yul snang thams cad rang sems kyi snang cha las gzhan du ma grub par thag bcad nas chos kyi bdag med dang / de'ang sems snang dbye ba med pa chu rlabs chu las gzhan du med pa ltar gzung 'dzin ro mnyam du go ba bskyed nas/ phyi ru mi g.yeng/ nang du mi gcun/ bar du mi 'dzin/ lung ma bstan dang btang snyoms su ma shor bar nam mkha' lta bur phyal gyis gzhag pas mi sdod par 'gyu na tshogs drug gi snang ba gang shar stong pa nyid yin pas/ spang blang re dogs dgag sgrub gang yang mi byed par rang zhi rang grol du skyong ba na sems gnas kyi rtags rim par 'byung / de nas khrid gzhung rnams las byung ba ltar sems 'tshol byas pas rang bzhin gdod nas spros pa dang bral ba la thag chod skye zhing / gnas lugs spros bral de la ngo shes gcig pu ma gtogs logs su bsgom rgyu med pas 'bral med kyi dran pa bsten/ de'ang ma bcos so ma dang gang shar gnyug mar gsungs pas rang sems gsal stong 'jin med de nyid gnas 'gyu dga' sdug ci ltar shar ba de ka ma bcos par skyong ba las/ spang bya dang gnyen po'i rtsol bas mi 'ching bar rten med rig pa sgom med du 'jog pas theg chen zhi lhag mthar phyin pa 'byung ste/ de dag gi skabs su nyams kyi 'char sgo dang lam gyi yon tan ji ltar skyes kyang ma chags shing ma zhen par rang ngo shes par bya ba ni gnad zab mo'o/ /

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 187ngag tu yang / gzhi stong pa nyid do/ /lam mtshan ma med pa'o/ /'bras bu smon pa med pa'o zhes brjod cing don dran par bya'o/ /gsum pa zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin ci rigs skyes pa na 'khor lo mtha' ma dang rdo rje theg pa'i rjes su mthun par yod med la sogs pa'i shan legs par phye zhing ngo sprod pa ni/ gsung rab gzhung 'grel rnams la go ba rags rim yod na de kas 'thus la/ med na ri chos nges don rgya mtsho tsam zhig lung 'bogs pa dang / lta rtogs ci nus su byas pas sems kyi ngo bo rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid/rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ de bzhin nyid dang / stong pa nyid dang / phyag rgya chen mo dang a haṃ la sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mas bstan kyang 'gal 'du skyon gyis ma reg par khong du chud nas/ ji skad du/sangs rgyas kyi gsung thams cad las ni stong pa nyid dang bdag med pa ston no/ /stong pa nyid dang bdag med pa'i don mi shes pa'i mi blun po rnams ni nyams par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i skyon las grol te/ bden pa gnyis dang rton pa bzhi la brten nas rgyal ba'i gsung rab nges don mthar thug pa rnams dang rang gi nyams su myong bya'i ye shes brda 'phrod de lam bsgom pa don yod par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar kun btags glo bur ba'i sems kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sprin gyi 'du 'god ltar stong yang / chos nyid bde gshegs snying po gsal rig rgyun chad med pa nyid rang byung gi ye shes su ngo 'phrod nas nyams su blang ba ni/ skyabs sems gong ltar bya/ rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon po'i gsung rab las byung ba ltar bla ma sangs rgyas rjes dran thun gcig bsgom la/ mthar/ de bzhin btagags pa ni bstan tu med pa ste de ni mig gis blta bar mi nus so/ /chos ni brjod du med pa

188 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ste de ni rna bas mnyan par mi nus so/ /dge 'dun ni 'dus ma byas pa ste de ni lus dang ngag dang sems kyis bsnyen bkur bya bar mi nus so zhes dang / sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ni 'dus ma byas pas rtag pa zhes bya'o/ /nam mkha' zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ni 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /'dus ma byas ni rtag pa'o/ /rtag pa ni chos so/ /chos ni dge 'dun no/ /dge 'dun ni 'dus ma byas pa'o/ /'dus ma byas pa ni rtag pa'o zhes yang yang brjod la/ don dam gyi dkon mchog gsum rtag tu rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de nas laṅkar gshegs pa las/sems tsam la ni brten nas su/ /phyi rol don du mi brtag go /snang ba med pa la brten nas/ /sems tsam las ni 'da' bar bya/ /yang dag dmigs pa la brten nas/ /snang ba med las 'da' bar bya/ /rnal 'byor snang med la gnas na/ /theg pa chen po mi mthong ngo / /zhes kun rdzob 'khrul ba sems tsam du rtogs pa de snang med dbu mas gzhig cing /de las kyang 'das nas snang bcas dbu mas de kho na nyid kyi tshul ma nor ba la 'jug dgos/ de la yang dag pa'i dmigs pa gang zhe na/ nam mkhas ma khyab pa'i 'byung ba bzhi med pa ltar sangs rgyas chos kyi skus ma khyab pa'i shes bya med pa dang /

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 189sangs rgyas dang / bdag dang / sems can thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid la bzang ngan che chung mtho dman la sogs pa'i dbye ba med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos bskyed par nus pa/ thog ma med pa'i dus can/ chos nyid kyis thob pa'i rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs sam khams de nyid srog dbugs kyis bsdus pa'i skye 'gro thams cad la yod pas sems can thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can no zhes gsal gdab pa'i phyir /rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang / /de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang / /rigs yod phyir na lus can kun/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can/ /zhes brjod/ dag pa rnams kyi chos sku/ ma dag cing dag pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid/ma dag pa rnams kyi rigs de nyid tshul 'di ltar du yod de/ sangs rgyas pad ngan sbrang rtsi sbrang ma la/ /sbun la snying po mi gtsang nang na gser/ /sa la gter dang myug sogs 'bras chung dang / /gos hrul nang na rgyal ba'i sku dang ni/ /bud med ngan ma'i lto na mi bdag dang / /sa la rin chen gzugs yod ji lta bar/ /glo bur nyon mongs dri mas bsgribs pa yi/ /sems can rnams la de bzhin khams 'di gnas/ /

190 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/zhes brjod cing don bsam/ las dang rgyu dang 'bras bu dang / rnam par smin pa dang nyon mongs pa dang / phung khams skye mched rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sogs rnam par dbye ba can thams cad don dam du yod ma myong bar ma zad kun rjob tu'ang ldan la ma gos par bzhugs shing / rang byung gi mtshan dpe stobs dang mi 'jigs pa dang / dran pa nye bar bzhag pa gsum dang / byams pa dang snying rje chen po dang / rdo rje lta bu la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / chos kyi dbyings la sogs pa'i ye shes tshad med pa sogs rnam par dbyer med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las lhag pa ni gdod nas rang chas su bzhugs pas mi stong ngo zhes dri ma 'bral rung dang yon tan skye rung gi gzhi la yid ches pas/rnam dbyer bcas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /glo bur dag gis khams stong gi /rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /bla med chos kyis stong ma yin/ /'od gsal byas min dbyer med pa/ /'jug can gaṅgā'i klung gi ni/ /rdul las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /chos rnams kun dang ldan pa nyid/ /ces gsal gdab/ de'ang nyan thos dang rang rgyal la sogs pas ni bde ba la sdug bsngal/ rtag pa la mi rtag pa/ bdag la bdag med pa/ gtsang ba la mi gtsang bar lta ste rgyal bas gsungs pa'i tshig shes kyi don ni mi shes so/ /de la

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 191don ni 'di lta ste/ bdag med pa ni 'khor ba zhes bya'o/ /bdag ces bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /mi rtag pa ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas so/ /rtag pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku'o/ /sdug bsngal ba ni mu stegs can thams cad do/ /bde ba ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'o/ /yongs su ma dag pa ni 'dus byas kyi chos so/ /yongs su dag pa ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yang dag pa'i chos te/ rang gi sems nyid bde gshegs snying po ni phyin ci log las 'das pa'i yang dag pa'i chos bzhi po 'di dang ldan no snyam du bsam la/de ni rang bzhin dag phyir dang / /bag chags spangs phyir gtsang ba yin/ /bdag dang bdag med spros pa dag /nye par zhi ba dam pa'i bdag /yid kyi rang bzhin phung po dang / /de rgyu log phyir bde ba nyid/ /'bor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das/ /mnyam pa nyid du rtogs phyir rtag /ces gsal gdab/ de lta bu'i khyad gzhi bde gshegs snying po/ khyad chos sangs rgyas kyi bral ba'i yon tan du ma dang bcas pa da lta rang rig pa'i ye shes gsal la ma 'gag pa/ gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa 11sa bsam lhasnam ganda/ma gyis nyams sdo/ myong ba 'di nyid sbyang gzhir bzhugs pa la/ sbyang bya glo bur ba'i dri ma dag nas/sbyangs 'bras rang la bzhugs pa'i gnas lugs de nyid mngon du gyur pa der dri

192 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/bral chos sku zhes btags te/ 'khor 'das kun gyi rnam pa thams cad par 'char yang / shar tsam nyid nas gzhi las ma g.yos pa dri ma med pa'i shel gong la gzugs brnyan gyi rnam pa sna tshogs su snang yang / snang tsam nyid nas shel dang gzugs brnyan ma 'dres pa ltar/ rang rig gsal stong rjen par bud pa la 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi snang ba ci ltar shar yang / rang shar rang grol ngo bo la nam yang gos pa med pas/ lta ba dang nyes pa'i bag chags bsal bar bya ba ci'ang med cing / sngar med kyi khyad chos gsar du ci'ang bsnan ma dgos par 'phags pa'i ye shes stong pa nyid la mnyam bzhag gi dngos gzhir byas nas thun ci rigs su bsgom zhing skabs su rdo rje'i tshig gis gsal gdab pa ni/'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /ces brjod pa'am don bsam/ 'di dag kyang rje btsun sgrol mgon zhabs kyis/rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po bsgom pa dang / /khyad chos rgyal ba'i yon tan bsam pa gnyis/ / rnam rtog bral ba'i yid kyis 'og bsdus na/ /de ni nges don bde gshegs lam mchog yin/ /zhes zab gnad du gdams par mdzad pa de yin no/ /

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 193de ltar mnyam par bzhag nas mthar/ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ /'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang la gdod nas rang chas su bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs snying po rang bzhin 'od gsal ba de nyid/ yang dag pa'i lta sgom gyis glo bur dri ma bcom nas rang zhal mngon du gyur pa na mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa zhes 'bras bu'i ming du btags pa ste/ rgyu lam de dang ldan pa la yid ches kyi nges shes bskyed de/ rang bzhin 'od gsal zhes brjod gang yin nyi dang mkha' bzhin glo bur gyi/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sprin tshogs stug po'i sgrib pa yis ni bsgribs gyur pa/ /dri med sangs rgyas yon tan kun ldan rtag brtan g.yung drung sangs rgyas nyid/ /de ni chos la mi rtog rnam 'byed ye shes dag la brten nas 'thob/ /thog ma dbus mtha' med cing rnam dbyer med/ /gnyis med gsum bral dri med rnam rtog med/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gang yin rtag gnas pa/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pa yis mthong / /zhes nges pa'i shes pa bskyed nas mnyam bzhag las ldang ste/gsum pa rjes thob thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug pa na/ snying po'i man ngag legs par 'doms pa'i bla ma la chos sku'i mos gus dang / sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po can yin pas gnas skabs rang ngo 'phrod ma

194 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/'phrod ma gtogs mthar thug yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid can du shes pa'i dag snang rab 'byams dang / de ltar ma rtogs pa'i skye 'gro mtha' dag pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pa'i 'khrul snang lu gu brgyud du 'phyan pas sdug bsngal gyi 'bor lo 'ba' zhig bskor ba la mi bzod pa'i snying rje dang / de ltar na sems can thams cad rang rang gi gzhi la bzhugs pa'i bral 'bras chos sku mngon du thob pa'i phyir theg chen smon 'jug gi sems bskyed dang ldan pas rang gzhan gyi ma dag cha dang bcas pa gdod nas stong nyid du rtogs pa'i sgo nas spang ba dang / nga rgyal dang rlom sems bral bas sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa phyogs su gtogs pa bcas dge ba ci 'grub tu bsgrub pa dang / bdag dang sems can du mngon par ma zhen pa'i sgo nas dngos dang brgyud du sems can la phan ci thogs lag len du gdab pa dang / kun btags kyis bsdus pa'i phyi nang rten 'brel gyi chos thams cad snang yang bden pa'i ngo bos stong pa rmi lam dang sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang / khyad par du bsod nams ma bsags pa la log par lta ba la sogs pa'i nyes dmigs mang po 'byung zhing / yang dag pa'i lta ba rtogs par byed pa la tshogs bsag dgos par gsungs pas/ kha na ma tho ba dang bral zhing theg chen sems bskyed kyis zin pa'i dge ba'i las su 'gyur ba spyi dang / phyag bskor swātstsha mar me 'bul ba yan chad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po mthong ba'i rgyu ru bsngo ba dang / dkon mchog gsum rtag pa la yid ches pas rten bzheng mchod bstod sogs mnyes pa sgrub pa spyi dang /khyad par yan lag bdun pa grangs su ma bcad par ci nus 'bul/ skabs skabs su nges don snying po'i mdo sde nyi shu lung 'bogs pa dang / kha bton tu bgyid pa dang /don bsam zhing gzhan la 'chad/ rgyud bla ma dang / ri chos nges don rgya mtsho sogs

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 195dgongs 'grel tshad ldan rnams la'ang rtog pa bcug ste/ thos bsam gyis sgom ma 'phrog cing / sgom pas thos bsam ma bcom par rang bzhin gnas rigs mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir mnyam bzhag ye shes kyi tshogs dang / rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gong du spel ba'i phyir rjes thob bsod nams kyi tshogs zung du 'jug par bya/ zab mo'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i shes rab cung zad cig skyes kyang 'dus byas kyi dge ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa larme kyang sa chod de che bas mnyam bzhag gtso bor bton/ ting nge 'dzin ltar snang skyes pa las ni rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnam par dag pa thos bsam byung na phugs kyi gzhan don de che stabs brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur gyis lhag pas gcig go gcig gis ma 'gag par bya/spyod lam kun tu dran pa dang shes bzhin mi 'bral bar byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyis zin par bya/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i tshe kun mkhyen dol po pa'i 'pho ba'i man ngag khyad du 'phags pa ltar rnam shes gzhi'i 'od gsal la 'jug pa'i tshul lag tu thebs dgos pas da lta nas goms 'dris bya/ de ltar na rnal 'byor pa'i rig pa rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid 'od gsal ba la thim pas gdod nas bzhugs pa'i chos kyi sku glo bur dri ma'i sbubs las grol te/ shin tu ngo mtshar med du gyur pa'i sku dang ye shes yon tan mdzad pa phun sum tshogs shing tshad med gzhal du med pa'i bdag nyid nam mkha' ltar rgya che zhing / nor bu dpag bsam gyi shing ltar sems can rnams kyi 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas su gyur te/ 'khor ba ji srid rtag khyab lhun grub kyi mdzad pa rgyun mi chad du 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de ltar myur du 'grub pa'i phyi ra bzang po spyod pa sogs theg chen bsngo smon spyi dang /'di'ang thun mtshams su gdab par bya ste/

196 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/sangs rgyas las cedros cesas las 'phags pa'i dzadzhags/ /tshogs las snying po ye shes khams thob mthar/ /ye shes de thob byang chub mchog chos sogs/ / sems can don byed chos rnams dang ldan shog /rang don gzhan don don dam sku dang ni/ /de la brten pa'i kun rdzob sku nyid de/ /bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yi/ /yon tan drug cu rtsa bzhi myur thob shog /gdul bya'i khams dang 'dul ba'i thabs dang ni/ /gdul bya'i khams kyi 'dul ba'i bya ba dang / /de yi yul dang dus su gshegs pa la/ /khyab rtag lhun gyis grub par 'jug par the(ga /dkon mchog rnam par byang khams dri med byang chub yon tan phrin las te/ /don gnas rnam bdun thos bsam sgom las bdag la dge ba gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro 'dis mtha' yas 'od mnga' drang srong tshe dpag med mthong zhing / /mthong nas kyang ni chos mig dri med skyes te byang chub mchog thob shog /ces re dogs med pa'i smon lam dang 'bor gsum mi rtog pa'i bsngo bas rgyas 'debs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa lta ba de nyid sngags dang 'brel bar nyams su len pa'i tshe na'ang go bar bya rgyu dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/dang po (go bar bya rgyu )ni/ phyi 'jig rten snod bcud srid pa gsum gyi rnam

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 197par shar ba 'di dag bzhin gyi byad me long la 'phos pa bzhin du/ nang rtsa rlung thig le'i cho 'phrul du shar ba yin zhing de gsum yang gzhan mchog dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam par bzhugs la/ de thams cad kyang de kho na nyid bde gshegs snying po'i rang 'od rang mdangs chos kyi sku nyid rnam pa thams cad par shar ba mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes/ don dam chos kyi dbyings bde stong zung 'jug rang bzhin 'gyur ba med la rgyun mi chad pas rgyud kyi don du gsungs shing / de'ang gzhi'i gnas skabs dri bcas de bzhin nyid la rgyu'i rgyud dang / lam dus chos nyid kyi don rim par snang bas lam thabs kyi rgyud dang /dag pa gnyis ldan mngon du 'gyur ba na shin tu rnam dag 'bras bu'i rgyud ces bya ste/ lta ba thun mong ma yin pa de nyid kun rdzob kyi stong tshul la mchog tu 'dzin pa rnams kyis phyogs tsam mi mthong ba lta ci smos/ gong smos mdo lugs rang rkang gi lam des kyang yun ring por 'gor ba yin pas/ dbang dang dam tshig gis khyad par du byas pa'i sngags kyi lam mtha' dag las khyad par du 'phags pa rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug la mnyam par bzhag pa na dus thung ngur tshegs chung ngus bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa da21sa gzhi nyams su len pa la/ 'grel chen las/ji ltar me ni shing la rtag gnas kyang / /gcad dang dbye ba'i thabs kyis mi mthong ste/ /gtsub 3|nga gtsub gtan lag pas baji/bas pa las/ /de la gnas pa yang ni mthong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin sems kyi 'od gsal rtog pa yi/ /

198 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/sgom pa'i thabs rnams dag gis mi mthong ste/ /de nyid du ni rkyang ma dag dang ni/ /ro ma gcig tu sbyor bas mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes de nyid/ ngo bo'i cha nas rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen por bzhugs la/ de ni rtog bcas kyi sgom pa sna tshogs pas kyang mi mthong la/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang byed pa bcings pa'i thabs khyad par can gyis pra phab pa'i gzugs brnyan ltar mthong bar 'gyur bas/ thog mar sor sdud dang bsam gtan la brten 'dun pa'i rnal 'byor gyis du ba dang / smig rgyu dang / mkha' snang dang / mar me'i mtshan ma mthong la/ sprin med pa'i nam mkhar nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyis 'bar ba dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / rdo rje sgra gcan dang / mchog gi cha ste glog dang thig le'i bar du rtags bcu yongs su rdzogs pa'i stong gzugs de dag yul du byas nas nyin dang mtshan du mnyam par bzhag pas rnam pa thams cad pa'i rnyasnang pa nyid khams gsum pa'i rnam pa mtha' dag can du shar ba nyams su myong / de nas srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i yan lag la brten zhu bde drangs/ rjes dran dang ting nge 'dzin gyis mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba mthar thug pa bsgrubs/ 'pho ba'i bag chags kyi dbugs bkag pas kun rjerdob kyi 'a9spyol snang btsan thabs su 'gag nas dag pas snang ba gzhom du med pa mtha' dang mu med par mched de/ gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa'i pha rol du son pa dri bral chos sku mkha' khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas gdod nas rang

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 199la bzhugs pa de nyid mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi skabs su grogs dam tshig dang spyod pa rnam par dag pa dgos shing / de'i tshul ni chos rje yab sras kyi gsung dang bla ma'i man ngag ltar khong du chud nas rtse gcig tu bsgom par bya'o/ /gsum pa phan yon ni/ de'ang rtsod pa'i mthar snyigs pa lnga bdo bas lta ba'i snyigs ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'byung la/ sems can bsod nams chung bas nges don snying po'i mdo sde rnams la mi gus shing / de dag las gsungs pa'i don mi bsgom par snyom las su byed pa ma zad/ kha cig snying po'i mdo sde rnams la yid mi ches pas log par lta ba'i rgyu des ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa chen por lhung ste thar pa'i dpyangs thag chad par gsungs pa de las ldog pa ni phan yon yin la/ sbyin pa tshul khrims bsam gtan khyad par du 'phags pa bskal ba du mar bsgrubs pa las/ zab mo'i chos 'di thos pa'i phan yon che ba rgyud bla mar gsungs shing /spyir theg chen la mos pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo las/ gang la la zhig theg pa chen po la mos pa rab tu skyed par 'gyur ba de ni bskal pa stong phrag gcig tu ngan 'gror 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bskal pa stong phrag lngar byol song dang yi dwags su mi skye/bskal pa stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lngar lha'i 'jig rten dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro zhes dang / yum las/ gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thos nas shi 'phos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ba dang / nam 'tsho'i bar du sems can thams cad la bde ba'i yod byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur ba dang / thos pa bskal pa'i bar du byed pa las tha na se gol gtogs pa'i yun tsam sher phyin bsgom pa bsod nams che bar gsungs/ khyad par mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel las sen mo'i rdul dang ba lang gi rmig rjes kyi chu ni/ sa chen po'i rdul dang / rgya

200 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/mtsho bzhi'i chu dang bskrun na brgya stong 'bum gyi cha dang dpe dang rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /de bzhin du drang ba'i don gyi mdo sde la mos pa nas sgom pa'i rnam pa la sbyor bar byed pa'i bar gyi bsod nams kyi rnam pa gang bshad pa de ni/ nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde la mos shing sgom pa'i bsod nams kyi char yang mi nye dpe dang rgyur yang mi bzod par gsungs/ gzhan yang mdo las/nga ni mya ngan 'das phyi nas/ /mi yi nang nas la la zhig /sems can rnam pa thams cad la/ /bde gshegs snying po yod do zhes/ /mos pa rnam dag byed nus na/ /sangs rgyas bka' drin 'tshob pa yin/ /zhes dang / sor phreng gi mdor/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po ston par byed pa de ni nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'am nyon mongs pa med pa'am su yang rung ste rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya'o zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtag pa sems can thams cad la yod par shes pa'i rgyus 'jig rten na bde ba'i rnam pa mchog rnams dang phun sum tshogs pa ji snyed yod pa thams cad rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po rtag pa thos pas dus gsum du'ang phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / mtho ris dang sa steng gi bde ba thams cad rtag tu thob par 'gyur ro zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po thos pa'i bsod nams kyi rgyus nad med pa dang / 'tshe ba med pa dang / tshe ring ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad dga'

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 201bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtag pa brtan pa g.yung drung ther zug ste/yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yang 'chi ba med par thos pas thams cad 'byor zhing yun ring du sra ba dang brtan par 'gyur ro zhes dang / myang 'das chen po las/sems can thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yod do zhes ston par byed pa'i sems can de dag ni yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa ste/ dam pa'i chos 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu de dag ni sdig pa'i las grangs med pa byas pa rnams klad pa na ba dang / rims kyis btab pa dang zug rngu dang skur pa btab pa tsam gyis byang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la rtag pa'i chos can du yid ches na gang zag de ni me tog u dum wa ra bzhin shin tu dkon pa'o/ /nga mya ngan las 'das nas gang gis theg pa chen po'i mdo sde shin tu zab mo 'di thos nas dad pa'i sems skyes na/ de ni ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bskal pa brgya stong gi bar du ngan song du lhung bar mi 'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rtag go /dam pa'i chos nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun med par mi 'gyur ro snyam du shes pa la brtson par byas na /de dag kyang nga dang 'dra bar sangs rgyas kyi gnas su blta bar bya'o zhes dang /dper na nyi ma shar na lto 'ur med par 'gyur ba bzhin du snying po'i mdo 'di thos pa tsam gyis phas pham pa dang / mtshams med pa'i sdig pa'i phung po myur du byang bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhan gyi 'gran zla'am gzhan gyis byed du bcug pa'am/ rnyed bkur tshigs su bcad pa'i don du yang rung / bdag la byang chub mi dgos snyam nas sems ma bskyed kyang snying po'i mdo 'di thos pa tsam gyis de'i lus kyi ba sbu'i khung bu thams cad du byang chub kyi rgyu sos ka'i nyi rdul bzhin du 'jug pa dang / sngon

202 'jam mgon kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/sangs rgyas kyis gaṅgā'i klung gcig gi bye ma snyed la byang chub tu sems bskyed na dus ngan gyi tshe chos 'di la mi skur cing mos par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyis gaṅgā'i klung brgyad kyi bye ma snyed la sems bskyed na dus ngan gyi tshe mdo 'di 'dzin 'chang klog 'don byed cing gzhan la yang glegs bam du 'bri ba dang / 'dzin 'chang klog par bskul zhing don yang ston nus pa sogs rgya cher gsungs so/ /mdor na kun mkhyen dol po pas/ bde gshegs snying po'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis kyang sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur na/ dad cing gus pa dang mngon du byas nas bsgoms pa lta ci smos/ de'i phyir mkhas pa snying rje dang ldan pa rnams kyis rang gi srog la sogs pa dor nas kyang bstan par bya ba dang / thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyis me'i 'obs chen po las 'bogs nas kyang btsal cing nyan par bya'o zhes gdams par mdzad pa nyid snying gi thig ler bcang bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa brgyud pa ni/ kun mkhyen sgrol ba'i mgon po yan chad gzhan stong brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ltar la/ rje btsun nas rgyal tshab snar thang pa blo gros rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang phrin las/ kun bzang dbang po/ tshe dbang nor bu/ bstan pa'i nyid byed/ bdud 'dul rdo rje/ byams mgon rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ padma nyin byed dbang po'i mdun nas/ rje bcu gsum pa'i lta khrid yig cha'i steng nas byin rlabs kyi rgyun bzang dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin grol bstsal cing brgyud tshul rnam dag gzhan pa'ang yod do/ /zab mo'i lta ba gsung rab kyi/ /nges don lags mod rtogs pa nyung / /

gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta khrid/ 203rgyal tshab byams par 'o9spyol med pas/ /theg chen rgyud blar 'chad nyan mdzod/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyams len gyi/ /mthar thug yin yang sgom pa dkon/ /rgyud kyi rgyal por yid ches pas/ /dman la 'gram chu mi ldang malngardod/ /kun bzang spyod pa bgegs chung la/ /sa chod che yang tshul ldan dka'/ /gong ma'i rnam thar dpang btsugs te/ /rbersha byang bslab pas legs bsdams 'tshal /lta sgom spyod pa rnam dag na/ /rang gzhan don gnyis myur 'grub 'gyur/ /'di ni mkhas 'dod rang bzo min/ /bka' dang bstan bcos dgongs pa'i bcud/ /dge bas bdag dang sems can kun/ /nyes pa chen po lnga spangs shing / /yon tan chen po lnga thob nas/ /don dam chos dbyings mngon 'gyur shog /ces pa 'di dpal ldan jo nang pa'i bstan 'dzin mkhas grub ngag dbang mtshan can zung gi thugs bzhed ltar/ stong gzhi bde bshegs snying po la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i snyom las
ma thang 6ma pa'i shā
